Bava Batra 98a:6-98b:6: Ufeliga derav chiyyay bar yosef – deamar rav chiyyay bar yosef: chamra – mazzala demareh garem, shenneemar: "veaf ki hayyayin boged, gever yahir vegomer"
Amar rav mari: hay man dihir – afillu ainashe veteh la mikkabbal, shenneemar: "gever yahir velo yinve" – may "velo yinve"? bannave shello.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: kol hammitgae betallit shel talmid chacham, veeno talmid chacham – en machnisin oto bimchitzato shel hakkadosh baruch hu. ketiv hacha: "velo yinve", uchetiv hatam: "el neve kodshecha".

Amar rava: hay man dezabben leh chavita dechamra lechanvaa addata lesabboyeh, utekef appalga o attilleta, dina hu dimkabbel la minneh. vela amaran ella dela shanni bevarza, aval shanni bevarza – la. vela amaran ella dela meta yoma deshuka, aval meta yoma deshuka – la.
Veamar rava: hay man dekabbel chamra addata demamte leh lefarvota devol shafat", veaddemate hatam zal; dina hu dimkabbel leh.
Ibbaya lehu: hava challa, may? amar leh rav hillel lerav ashe: ki havan be rav kahana, amar lan: challa la, udela kerabbi yose berabbi chanina.
Veikka deamri: afillu challa name mekabbel. keman? kerabbi yose berabbi chanina.

Mishna hammocher makom lachavero, vechen hamekabbel makom mechavero laasot lo bet chatnut livno uvet almenut levitto – bone arba ammot al shesh, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi yishmael omer: refet bakar hi zo!
Harotze laasot refet bakar – bone arba ammot al shesh.
Bayit katan – shesh al shemone, gadol – shemone al eser, teraklin – eser al eser. rumo kachatzi orko vechachatzi rochbo. reaya laddavar – rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: kevinyan hahechol.

Gemara lema li lemitna "bet chatnut livno, uvet almenut levitto"? litne "bet chatnut livno ulevitto, uvet almenut livno ulevitto"! milleta aggav orcheh ka mashma lan, dela darka dechatna lemedar be chamu –

Kedichtiv besefer ben sira: hakkol shakalti bechaf moznayim, velo matzati kal missubbin; vekal missubbin – chatan haddar bevet chamiv; vekal mechatan – oreach machnis oreach; vekal meoreach – meshiv davar beterem yishma – shenneemar: "meshiv davar beterem yishma ivvelet hi lo uchelimma".
Berakhot 24a:15-24b:5: Amar Rabbi yitzchak: tefach baishsha erva. lemay? illema leistakkole ba, veha amar rav sheshet: lamma mana hakkatuv tachshitin shebbachutz im tachshitin shebbifnim — lomar lach kol hammistakkel beetzba ketanna shel ishsha, keillu mistakkel bimkom hattoref.

Amar rav chisda: shok baishsha erva, shenneemar: "galli shok ivri neharot", uchetiv: "tiggal ervatech vegam terae cherpatech". amar shemuel: kol baishsha — erva, shenneemar: "ki kolech arev umarech nave". amar rav sheshet: sear baishsha erva, shenneemar: "saarech keeder haizzim".
Amar rabbi chanina: ani raiti et rabbi shettala tefillav. metivi: hattole tefillav yittalu lo chayyav!
Dorshe chamurot amru: "vehayu chayyecha teluim lecha minneged", ze hattole tefillav.
La kashya ha birtzua. ha biktzitza.
Veibbaet ema: la shena retzua vela shena ketzitza — asur. vechi tela rabbi — bechista tela.
I hachi may lememra? mahu detema tive hannacha kesefer tora — ka mashma lan.
Veamar rabbi chanina: ani raiti et rabbi sheggihek ufihek venitattesh verak
Umemashmesh bevigdo, aval lo haya mitattef. ucheshehu mefahek haya manniach yado al santero.
Metivi: hammashmia kolo bitfillato — hare ze mikketanne amana. hammagbiah kolo bitfillato hare ze minnevie hashsheker.
Megahek umefahek — hare ze miggasse haruach. hammitattesh bitfillato — siman ra lo. veyesh omrim: nikkar shehu mechoar. harak bitfillato — keillu rak bifne hammelech.
Bishlama megahek umefahek la kashya: kan leonso, kan lirtzono. ella mitattesh ammitattesh kashya!

Mitattesh ammitattesh name la kashya, kan millemala, kan millematta. deamar rav zera: ha milleta ibbala li be rav hamenuna utekila li ki kulle talmuday: hammitattesh bitfillato siman yafe lo, keshem sheosim lo nachat ruach millematta, kach osim lo nachat ruach millemala.
Eruvin 21b:16-22a:2: Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: beshaa shettikken shelomo eruvin unetilat yadayim, yatzta bat kol veamra: "beni im chacham libbecha yismach libbi gam ani". veomer: "chacham beni vesammach libbi veashiva chorfi davar".
Daresh rava: may dichtiv "lecha dodi netze hassade nalina bakkefarim nashkima lakkeramim nire im parcha haggefen pittach hassemadar henetzu harimmonim sham etten et doday lach".

"Lecha dodi netze hassade" — amra keneset yisrael lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, al tedineni keyoshve cherakkim sheyyesh bahen gazel vaarayot ushevuat shav ushevuat sheker, "netze hassade" — bo vearacha talmide chachamim, sheoskin battora mittoch haddechak.
"Nalina bakkefarim" — al tikre bakkefarim ella bakkofrim: bo vearacha otam shehishpata lahen tova vehen kafru becha.

"Nashkima lakkeramim" — ellu batte chenesiyyot uvatte midrashot. "nire im parcha haggefen" — ellu baale mikra. "pittach hassemadar" — ellu baale mishna. "henetzu harimmonim" — ellu baale gemara. "sham etten et doday lach" — aracha kevodi vegodli shevach banay uvenotay.

Amar rav hamenuna, may dichtiv: "vaydabber sheloshet alafim mashal vayhi shiro chamishsha vaalef" — melammed sheamar shelomo al kol davar vedavar shel tora sheloshet alafim mashal, al kol davar vedavar shel sofrim chamishsha veelef teamim.

Daresh rava, may dichtiv: "veyoter shehaya kohelet chacham od limmad daat et haam [v]izzen vechikker tikken meshalim harebe". "limmad daat et haam" — deagmeray besimane teamim, veasbera bemay dedame lay.
"[V]izzen vechikker tikken meshalim harebe" — amar ulla amar rabbi eliezer: battechilla hayta tora doma lichfifa sheen lah oznayim, ad shebba shelomo veasa lah oznayim.
"Kevutztzotav taltallim", amar rav chisda amar mar ukeva: melammed sheyyesh lidrosh al kol kotz vakotz tille tillim shel halachot.
Shemmashkim umaariv alehen levet hammidrash. rabba amar: bemi shemmashchir panav alehen keorev.

Rava amar: bemi shemmesim atzmo achzari al banav veal bene beto keorev. ki ha derav adda bar matna hava kaazel leve rav, amara leh devethu: yanoke didach may eeved lehu? amar la: mi shelimu kurame beagma?

Ketubot 50a:11-14: Amar rabbi yose bar chanina, beusha hitkinu: haishsha shemmachra benichse melog bechayye balah umeta, habbaal motzi miyyad hallakochot. ashkecheh rav yitzchak bar yosef lerabbi avahu dahava kae beuchelusa deusha, amar leh: man mara dishmata deusha? amar leh: rabbi yose bar chanina. tena minneh arbein zimnin, vedame leh keman demannecha leh bechisteh.

"Ashre shomre mishpat ose tzedaka vechol et". vechi efshar laasot tzedaka bechol et? darshu rabbotenu shebbeyavne, veamri la rabbi eliezer: ze hazzan banav uvenotav keshehen ketannim. rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar: ze hamegaddel yatom vitoma betoch beto umassian.
"Hon vaosher beveto vetzidkato omedet laad". rav huna verav chisda, chad amar: ze hallomed tora umelammedah. vechad amar: ze hakkotev tora neviim uchetuvim umashilan laacherim.

"Uree vanim levanecha shalom al yisrael". amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi kevan shevanim levanecha" — "shalom al yisrael". dela ate lide chalitza veyibbum. rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar: kevan shevanim levanecha" — shalom al dayyayne yisrael, dela ate leinnetzoye.
Menachot 110a:6-13: "Bechol makom muktar muggash lishmi" – bechol makom salka datach? amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: ellu talmide chachamim haoskim battora bechol makom, maale ani alehen keillu maktirin umaggishin lishmi.
"Umincha tehora" – ze hallomed tora betohora, nose ishsha veachar kach lomed tora.

"Shir hammaalot hinne barchu et Adonai kol avde Adonai haomdim bevet Adonai ballelot", may "ballelot"? amar rabbi yochanan: ellu talmide chachamim haoskim betora ballayla, maale alehen hakkatuv keillu asukim baavoda.
"Leolam zot al yisrael", amar rav giddel amar rav: ze mizbeach banuy, umichael sar haggadol omed umakriv alav korban.
Verabbi yochanan amar: ellu talmide chachamim haasukin behilchot avoda, maale alehem hakkatuv keillu nivna mikdash bimehem.
Amar resh lakish: may dichtiv "zot hattora laola lammincha velachattat velaasham" – kol haosek battora keillu hikriv ola, mincha, chattat, veasham.
Amar rava: hay "laola lammincha" – "ola umincha" mibbee leh! ella amar rava: kol haosek battora eno tzarich lo ola (velo chattat) velo mincha velo asham.
Amar rabbi yitzchak: may dichtiv "zot torat hachattat" vezot torat haasham"? kol haosek betorat chattat – keillu hikriv chattat, vechol haosek betorat asham – keillu hikriv asham.
Mishnah Bava Metzia 5:9-6:1:
Lo yomar adam lachavero, haleveni chor chittin vaani etten lecha laggoren. aval omer lo, haleveni ad sheyyavo veni, o ad sheemtza mafteach. vehillel oser. vechen haya hillel omer, lo talve ishsha kikkar lachavertah ad shettaasennu damim, shemma yokiru chittim, venimtzeu vaot lide ribbit: 
Omer adam lachavero, nakkesh immi vaanakkesh immach, ador immi veedor immach, velo yomar lo nakkesh immi veedor immach, ador immi vaanakkesh immach. kol yeme garid, echad. kol yeme revia, echad. lo yomar lo charosh immi baggarid vaani echerosh immecha barvia. rabban gamliel omer, yesh ribbit mukdemet veyesh ribbit meucheret. ketzad. natan enav lilvot hemennu, vehaya meshalleach lo veomer bishvil shettalveni, zo hi ribbit mukdemet. lava hemennu vehechezir lo et meotav, vehaya meshalleach lo veamar bishvil meotecha shehayu vetelot etzli, zo hi ribbit meucheret. rabbi shimon omer, yesh ribbit devarim, lo yomar lo, da ki va ish peloni mimmakom peloni: 
Veellu ovrin belo taase. hammalve, vehallove, vehearev, vehaedim. vachachamim omrim, af hassofer. ovrim mishshum lo titten (Vayikra 25), umishshum bal tikkach meitto (sham), umishshum lo tihye lo kenoshe (Shemot 22), umishshum lo tesimun alav neshech (sham), umishshum velifne ivver lo titten michshol veyareta meelohecha ani Adonai (Vayikra 19): 
Hassocher et haummanin, vehitu ze et ze, en lahem ze al ze ella taromet. sachar et hachammar veet hakkaddar lehavi firyafrin vachalilim lakkalla o lammet, ufoalin lehaalot pishtano min hammishra, vechol davar sheaved, vechazru vahen, mekom sheen sham adam, socher alehen o matan:
Mishnah Bava Metzia 6:2-5:
Hassocher et haummanin vechazru vahen, yadan al hattachtona. im baal habbayit chozer bo, yado al hattachtona. kol hameshanne, yado al hattachtona. vechol hachozer bo, yado al hattachtona: 
Hassocher et hachamor leholichah bahar veholichah babbika, babbika veholichah bahar, afillu zo eser milin vezo eser milin, vameta, chayyav. hassocher et hachamor vehivrika, o shennaaset angarya, omer lo hare shellecha lefanecha. meta o nishbera, chayyav lehaamid lo chamor. hassocher et hachamor leholichah bahar veholichah babbika, im hechelika, patur, veim huchamma, chayyav. leholichah babbika veholichah bahar, im hechelika, chayyav, veim huchamma, patur. im mechamat hammaala, chayyav: 
Hassocher et happara lacharosh bahar vecharash babbika, im nishbar hakkankan, patur. babbika vecharash bahar, im nishbar hakkankan, chayyav. ladush bakkitnit vedash battevua, patur, ladush battevua vedash bakkitnit, chayyav, mippene shehakkitnit machalaket: 
Hassocher et hachamor lehavi aleha chittim vehevi aleha seorim, chayyav. tevua vehevi aleha teven, chayyav, mippene shehannefach kashe lammasseoy. lehavi letech chittim vehevi letech seorim, patur. veim hosif al massao, chayyav. vechamma yosif al massao vihe chayyav. sumechos omer mishshum rabbi meir, sea legamal, shelosha kabbin lachamor:
Mishnah Bava Metzia 6:6-7:2:
Kol haummanin, shomre sachar hen. vechullan sheamru, tol et shellecha vehave maot, shomer chinnam. shemor li veeshmor lach, shomer sachar. shemor li, veamar lo hannach lefanay, shomer chinnam: 
Hilvahu al hammashkon, shomer sachar. rabbi yehuda omer, hilvahu maot, shomer chinnam. hilvahu perot, shomer sachar. abba shaul omer, muttar adam lehasekir mashkono shel ani lihyot posek alav veholech, mippene shehu kemeshiv aveda: 
Hammaavir chavit mimmakom lemakom ushevarah, ben shomer chinnam ben shomer sachar, yishshava. rabbi eliezer omer, ze veze yishshava, vetameah ani im yecholin ze vaze lishshavea: 
Hassocher et happoalim veamar lahem lehashekim ulehaariv, mekom shennahagu shello lehashekim veshello lehaariv, eno rashshay lechofan. mekom shennahagu lazun, yazun. lesappek bimtika, yesappek. hakkol keminhag hammedina. maase berabbi yochanan ben matya sheamar livno, tze sechor lanu foalim. halach ufasak lahem mezonot. ucheshebba etzel aviv, amar lo, beni, afillu im atta ose lahem kisuddat shelomo vishato, lo yatzata yede chovatcha immahen, shehen bene avraham yitzchak veyaakov. ella ad shello yatchilu vammelacha tze veemor lahem, al menat sheen lachem alay ella fat vekitnit bilvad. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, lo haya tzarich lomar, hakkol keminhag hammedina: 
Veellu ochlin min hattora. haose vimchubbar lakkarka, bishat gemar melacha, uvetalush min hakkarka, ad shello nigmera melachto, bedavar sheggiddulo min haaretz. veellu sheen ochlin. haose vimchubbar lakkarka beshaa sheen gemar melacha, uvetalush min hakkarka meachar shennigmera melachto, uvedavar sheen giddulo min haaretz:
Mishnah Bava Metzia 7:11-8:4:
Kol hammatne al ma shekkatuv battora, tenao vatel. vechol tenay sheyyesh maase vitchillato, tenao vatel. vechol sheefshar lo lekayyemo vesofo, vehitna alav mittechillato, tenao kayyam: 
Hashshoel et happara veshaal bealeha immah o sachar bealeha imma. shaal habbealim o secharan, uleachar kach shaal et happara, vameta, patur, shenneemar (Shemot 22) im bealav immo lo yeshallem. aval shaal et happara veachar kach shaal et habbealim o secharan, vameta, chayyav, shenneemar (sham) bealav en immo shallem yeshallem: 
Hashshoel et happara, shealah chatzi hayyom usecharah chatzi hayyom, shealah hayyom usecharah lemachar, sachar achat veshaal achat, vameta, hammashil omer sheula meta, bayyom shehayta sheula meta, bashshaa shehayta sheula meta, vehalla omer eni yodea, chayyav. hassocher omer sechura meta, bayyom shehayta sechura meta, bashshaa shehayta sechura meta, vehalla omer eni yodea, patur. ze omer sheula veze omer sechura, yishshava hassocher shessechura meta. ze omer eni yodea veze omer eni yodea, yachaloku: 
Hashshoel et happara, veshillechah lo beyad beno, beyad avdo, beyad shelucho, o veyad beno, beyad avdo, beyad shelucho shel shoel, vameta, patur. amar lo hashshoel, shallechah li beyad beni, beyad avdi, beyad sheluchi, o beyad bincha, beyad avdecha, beyad sheluchacha, o sheamar lo hammashil, hareni meshallechah lecha beyad beni, beyad avdi, beyad sheluchi, o beyad bincha, beyad avdecha, beyad sheluchacha, veamar lo hashshoel, shallach, veshillechah vameta, chayyav. vechen beshaa shemmachazirah: 
Hammachalif para bachamor veyalda, vechen hammocher shifchato veyalda, ze omer ad shello macharti, veze omer mishshellakachti, yachaloku. hayu lo shene avadim, echad gadol veechad katan, vechen shete sadot, achat gedola veachat ketanna, hallokeach omer gadol lakachti, vehalla omer eni yodea, zacha vaggadol. hammocher omer katan macharti, vehalla omer eni yodea, en lo ella katan. ze omer gadol veze omer katan, yishshava hammocher shehakkatan machar. ze omer eni yodea veze omer eni yodea, yachaloku:
Mishnah Bava Metzia 7:3-6:
Haya ose veyadav aval lo veraglav, beraglav aval lo veyadav, afillu vichtefo, hare ze ochel. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer, ad sheyyaase veyadav uveraglav: 
Haya ose vitenim, lo yochal baanavim, baanavim, lo yochal bitenim. aval monea et atzmo ad shemmaggia limkom hayyafot veochel. vechullan lo amru ella vishat melacha, aval mishshum hashev aveda labbealim amru, poalim ochlin bahalichatan meumman leumman, uvachaziratan min haggat, uvachamor keshehi foraket: 
Ochel poel kishshut afillu vedinar, vechotevet afillu vedinar. rabbi elazar chisma omer, lo yochal poel yater al secharo. vachachamim mattirin, aval melammedin et haadam shello yehe raavtan vihe sotem et happetach befanav: 
Kotzetz adam al yede atzmo, al yede veno uvitto haggedolim, al yede avdo veshifchato haggedolim, al yede ishto, mippene sheyyesh bahen daat. aval eno kotzetz al yede veno uvitto hakketannim, velo al yede avdo veshifchato hakketannim, velo al yede vehemto, mippene sheen bahen daat:
Mishnah Bava Metzia 7:7-10:
Hassocher et happoalim laasot beneta revai shello, hare ellu lo yochlu. im lo hodian, pode umaachilan. nitparsu iggulav, nitpattechu chaviyyotav, hare ellu lo yochlu. im lo hodian, measser umaachilan: 
Shomre ferot ochlin mehilchot medina, aval lo min hattora. arbaa shomrin hen. shomer chinnam, vehashshoel, nose sachar, vehassocher. shomer chinnam nishba al hakkol, vehashshoel meshallem et hakkol, venose sachar vehassocher nishbaim al hashshevura veal hashshevuya veal hammeta, umeshallemin et haaveda veet haggeneva: 
Zeev echad, eno ones, shene zeevim, ones. rabbi yehuda omer, bishat mishlachat zeevim, af zeev echad ones. shene chelavim, eno ones. yaddua habbavli omer mishshum rabbi meir, meruach achat, eno ones, mishshete ruchot, ones. hallistim, hare ze ones. haari vehaddov vehannamer vehabbardelas vehannachash, hare ze ones. ematay, bizman shebbau mealehen, aval im holichan limkom gedude chayya velistim, eno ones: 
Meta chedarkah, hare ze ones. siggefah vameta, eno ones. alta lerashe tzukin venafla vameta, hare ze ones. heelah lerashe tzukin venafla vameta, eno ones. matne shomer chinnam lihyot patur mishshevua, vehashshoel lihyot patur milleshallem, nose sachar vehassocher lihyot peturin mishshevua umilleshallem:
Mishnah Bikkurim 3:9-4:1:
Rabbi shimon ben nannas omer, meatterin et habbikkurim chutz mishshivat hamminim. rabbi akiva omer, en meatterin et habbikkurim ella mishshivat hamminim: 
Rabbi shimon omer, shalosh middot babbikkurim, habbikkurim, vetosefet habbikkurim, veittur habbikkurim. tosefet habbikkurim, min bemino. veittur habbikkurim, min besheeno mino. tosefet habbikkurim neechelet betohora, ufetura min haddemay. veittur habbikkurim chayyav baddemay: 
Ematay amru tosefet habbikkurim kabbikkurim, bizman shehi vaa min haaretz. veim enah baa min haaretz, enah kabbikkurim: 
Lema amru habbikkurim kenichse chohen, shehu kone mehem avadim vekarkaot uvehema temea, uvaal chov notlan bechovo, vehaishsha vichtubbatah, kesefer tora. verabbi yehuda omer, en notnim otam ella lechaver betova. vachachamim omrim, notnin otam leanshe mishmar, vehem mechallekin benehem, kekadshe hammikdash: 
Anderoginos yesh bo derachim shave laanashim, veyesh bo derachim shave lannashim, veyesh bo derachim shave laanashim venashim, veyesh bo derachim eno shave lo laanashim velo lannashim:
Mishnah Bikkurim 4:2-5: Ketzad shave laanashim: metamme beloven kaanashim, vezokek leyibbum kaanashim, umitattef umistapper kaanashim, venose aval lo nissa kaanashim, vechayyav bechol mitzvot haamurot battora kaanashim:

Ketzad shave lannashim: metamme beodem kannashim, veeno mityached im haanashim kannashim, veeno over al "bal takkif" velo al "bal tashchit" velo al "bal tetamme lammetim" kannashim, ufasul min haedut kannashim, veeno nival baavera kannashim, venifsal min hakkehunna kannashim:

Ketzad shave laanashim velannashim: chayyavim al makkato veal killato kaanashim vechannashim, vehahorgo shogeg gole umezid neherag kaanashim venashim, veyoshevet alav dam tame vedam tahor kaanashim vechannashim, vecholek bekadshe kodashim kaanashim vechannashim, venochel lechol hannechalot kaanashim vechannashim, veim amar "hareni nazir shezze ish veishsha" hare ze nazir:

Ketzad eno shave lo laanashim velo lannashim: en chayyavim lo al makkato velo al killato lo kaanashim velo kannashim, veeno neerach lo kaanashim velo kannashim, veim amar "hareni nazir shezze lo ish velo ishsha" eno nazir. rabbi meir omer: anderoginos beriyya bifne atzmah hu velo yachlu chachamim lehacheria alav im hu ish o ishsha. aval tumtum eno ken, peamim shehu ish peamim shehu ishsha:
Mishnah Kelim 30:3-4:
Kos shennifgam rubbo, tahor. nifgam bo shalosh berubbo, tahor. rabbi shimon omer, im mefazzer hu et rov hammayim, tahor. nikkav, vaasao ben bevaatz ben bezefet, tahor. rabbi yose omer, bevaatz, tame, uvezefet, tahor: 
Tzelochit ketanna shennittal piha, temea. ugedola shennittal piha, tehora. shel palyaton shennittal piha, tehora, mippene shehi sorachat et hayyad. leginin gedolim shennittal pihen, temein, mippene shehu metakkenan lichvashin. vehaafarkes shel zechuchit, tehora. amar rabbi yose, ashrayich kelim, shennichnast betuma, veyatzat betohora:
Mishnah Oholot 1:1-2:
Shenayim temeim bemet, echad tame tumat shiva veechad tame tumat arev. shelosha temein bemet, shenayim temein tumat shiva veechad tame tumat arev. arbaa temein bemet, shelosha temein tumat shiva veechad tame tumat arev. ketzad shenayim. adam hannogea bemet, tame tumat shiva. veadam hannoge bo, tame tumat arev: 
Ketzad shelosha. kelim hannogim bemet, vechelim bakkelim, temein tumat shiva. hashshelishi, ben adam uven kelim, temein tumat arev:
Mishnah Oholot 1:3-7:
Ketzad arbaa. kelim nogin bemet, veadam bakkelim, vechelim baadam, temein tumat shiva. harvii, ben adam ben kelim, tame tumat arev. amar rabbi akiva, yesh li chamishi, hashshappud hattachuv baohel, haohel vehashshappud veadam hannogea bashshappud vechelim baadam, temein tumat shiva. hachamishi, ben adam ben kelim, tame tumat arev. amru lo, en haohel mitchashshev: 
Adam vechelim mittammein bemet. chomer baadam mibbakkelim vechelim mibbaadam. shehakkelim shelosha vehaadam shenayim. chomer baadam, shekkol zeman shehu vaemtza, hen arbaa. vesheeno vaemtza, hen shelosha: 
Adam uvegadim mittammeim bezav. chomer baadam mibbabbegadim, uvabbegadim mibbaadam. shehaadam hannogea bezav metamme vegadim, veen begadim hannogin bezav metammein begadim. chomer babbegadim, shehabbegadim hannosin et hazzav metammein adam, veen adam hannose et hazzav metamme adam: 
Adam eno metamme, ad shettetze nafsho. vaafillu meguyyad, vaafillu goses. zokek layyibbum ufoter min hayyibbum, maachil batteruma ufosel batteruma. vechen behema vechayya enan metammein, ad shettetze nafsham. huttezu rashehem, af al pi shemmefarkesim, temeim, kegon zanav shel letaa shehi mefarkaset: 
Haevarin en lahen shiur, afillu pachot mikkazzayit min hammet, ufachot mikkazzayit min hannevela, ufachot mikkaadasha min hashsheretz, metammein tumatan:
Mishnah Oholot 1:8-2:3: Matayim vearbaim ushemona evarim baadam, sheloshim befissat haregel, shishsha vechol etzba, asara vakkursal, shenayim bashshok, chamishsha vaarkubba, echad bayyarech, shelosha vakkatlit, achat esre tzelaot, sheloshim befissat hayyad, shishsha vechol etzba, shenayim bakkane, ushenayim bammarpek, echad bazzeroa, vearbaa vakkatef. mea veechad mizze umea veechad mizze. ushemone esre chulyot bashshidra, tisha varosh, shemona vatztzavvar, shishsha vammafteach shel lev, vachamishsha vinkavav. kol echad veechad metamme vemagga uvemassa uveohel. ematay, bizman sheyyesh alehen basar karauy. aval im en alehen basar karauy, metammein bemagga uvemassa, veen metammein beohel:

Ellu metammein beohel. hammet, vechazzayit min hammet, vechazzayit netzel, umelo tarvad rakav, hashshidra, vehaggulgolet, evar min hammet veevar min hachay sheyyesh alehen basar karauy, rova atzamot merov habbinyan o merov hamminyan. verov binyano verov minyano shel met, af al pi sheen bahem rova, temein. kamma hu rov minyano, mea veesrim vachamishsha:

Reviit dam, ureviit dam tevusa mimmet echad. rabbi akiva omer, mishshene metim. dam katan sheyyatza chullo, rabbi akiva omer, kol shehu. vachachamim omrim, reviit. kazzayit rimma, ben chayya ben meta, rabbi eliezer metamme chivsaro, vachachamim metaharim. efer serufim, rabbi eliezer omer, shiuro verova, vachachamim metaharin. melo tarvad veod afar kevarot, tame, rabbi shimon metaher. melo tarvad rakav sheggevalo vemayim, eno chibbur letuma:

Ellu metammein bemagga uvemassa veenan metammein beohel. etzem kasseora, veeretz haammim, uvet happeras, evar min hammet veevar min hachay sheen alehen basar karauy, hashshidra vehaggulgolet shechasaru. kamma hu chesron bashshidra, bet shammay omrim, shete chulyot. uvet hillel omrim, afillu chulya echat. uvaggulgolet, bet shammay omrim, kimlo makdeach. uvet hillel omrim, kede sheyyinnatel min hachay veyamut. beeze makdeach amru, bakkatan shel rofim, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, baggadol shel lishka:
Mishnah Oholot 2:4-7: Haggolel vehaddofek metammein bemagga uveohel, veenan metammein bemassa. rabbi eliezer omer, metammein bemassa. rabbi yehoshua omer, im yesh tachtehen afar kevarot, metammein bemassa. veim lav, enan metammein bemassa. ezehu haddofek, et shehaggolel nishan alav. aval dofek dofkin, tahor:
Ellu sheim chasru tehorin. kazzayit min hammet, vechazzayit netzel, umelo tarvad rakav, ureviit dam, veetzem kasseora, veevar min hachay shechasar atzmo:

Hashshidra vehaggulgolet mishshene metim, ureviit dam mishshene metim, verova atzamot mishshene metim, veevar min hammet mishshene metim, veevar min hachay mishshene anashim, rabbi akiva metamme, vachachamim metaharin:

Etzem kasseora shennechelak lishnayim, rabbi akiva metamme, verabbi yochanan ben nuri metaher. amar rabbi yochanan ben nuri, lo amru atzamot kasseora, ella etzem kasseora. rova atzamot shenniddakdeku veen bechol echad veechad etzem kasseora, rabbi shimon metaher, vachachamim metammein. evar min hachay shennechelak lishnayim, tahor. rabbi yose metamme. umode sheim nittal chatzaim shehu tahor:
Mishnah Oholot 3:1-5:
Kol hametammein beohel shennechleku vehichnisan letoch habbayit, rabbi dosa ven harekinas metaher, vachachamim metammeim. ketzad. hannogea bechishne chatzaye zetim min hannevela o nosan. uvammet, hannogea bechachatzi zayit umaahil al kachatzi zayit, o noge bechachatzi zayit vechachatzi zayit maahil alav, maahil al kishne chatzaye zetim, maahil al kachatzi zayit vechachatzi zayit maahil alav, rabbi dosa ven harekinas metaher, vachachamim metammein. aval hannogea bechachatzi zayit vedavar acher maahil alav veal kachatzi zayit, o maahil al kachatzi zayit vedavar acher maahil alav veal kachatzi zayit, tahor. amar rabbi meir, af baze rabbi dosa ven harekinas metaher, vachachamim metammein. hakkol tame, chutz min hammagga im hammassa, vehammassa im haohel. ze hakkelal, kol shehu mishshem echad, tame. mishshene shemot, tahor: 
Melo tarvad rakav shennitpazzer betoch habbayit, habbayit tame. verabbi shimon metaher. reviit dam shennivlea vetoch habbayit, habbayit tahor. nivlea vichsut, im mitkabbeset veyotze mimmenna reviit dam, temea. veim lav, tehora, shekkol habbalua sheeno yachol latzet, tahor: 
Nishpach baavir, im haya mekomo ketafres veheehil al miktzato, tahor. haya ashboren, o shekkarash, tame. nishpach al haaskuppa vehi ketafres, ben mibbifnim ben mibbachutz, vehabbayit maahil alav, tahor. haya ashboren o shekkarash, tame. kol shebbammet, tame, chutz min hashshinnayim vehassear vehatztzipporen. uvishat chibburo, hakkol tame: 
Ketzad. hammet mibbachutz usearo vifnim, habbayit tame. etzem sheyyesh alav kazzayit basar, hichnis miktzato mibbifnim vehabbayit maahil alav, tame. shene atzamot vaalehen kishne chatzae zetim basar, hichnis miktzatam mibbifnim vehabbayit maahil alehem, tame. hayu techuvim bide adam, tahor, sheen chibbure adam chibbur: 
Ezehu dam tevusa. hammet sheyyatza mimmennu sheminit bechayyav usheminit bemoto, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi yishmael omer, reviit bechayyav ureviit bemoto, nittal mizze umizze reviit. rabbi elazar berabbi yehuda omer, ze vaze chammayim. ezehu dam tevusa. tzaluv sheddamo shotet venimtza tachtav reviit dam, tame. aval hammet sheddamo menattef venimtza tachtav reviit dam, tahor. rabbi yehuda omer, lo chi, ella hashshotet, tahor. vehamenattef, tame:
Mishnah Oholot 3:6-4:2:
Kazzayit min hammet, pitcho vetefach, vehammet, pitcho vearbaa tefachim, lehatztzil hattuma al happetachim. aval lehotzi hattuma, befoteach tefach. gadol mikkazzayit, kammet. rabbi yose omer, hashshidra vehaggulgolet, kammet: 
Tefach al tefach al rum tefach, merubba, mevi et hattuma, vechotzetz bifne hattuma. ketzad. biv shehu kamur tachat habbayit, yesh bo foteach tefach veyesh bitziato poteach tefach, tuma vetocho, habbayit tahor. tuma vabbayit, ma shebbetocho tahor, shedderech hattuma latzet veen darkah lehikkanes. yesh bo foteach tefach veen bitziato foteach tefach, hattuma vetocho, habbayit tame. tuma vabbayit, ma shebbetocho tahor, shedderech hattuma latzet veen darkah lehikkanes. en bo foteach tefach veen bitziato foteach tefach, tuma vetocho, habbayit tame. tuma vabbayit, ma shebbetocho tame. echad chor shechararuhu mayim o sheratzim, o sheachalattu mallachat, vechen mirbach shel avanim, vechen sevar shel korot. rabbi yehuda omer, kol ohel sheeno asuy bide adam, eno ohel. umode vishkifim uvislaim: 
Migdal shehu omed baavir, tuma vetocho, kelim shebbeavyo tehorim. tuma veavyo, kelim shebbetocho tehorim. rabbi yose omer, mechetza lemechetza. haya omed betoch habbayit, tuma vetocho, habbayit tame. tuma vabbayit, ma shebbetocho tahor, shedderech hattuma latzet veen darkah lehikkanes. kelim shebbeno leven haaretz, shebbeno leven hakkotel, shebbeno leven hakkorot, im yesh sham poteach tefach, temein. veim lav, tehorin. tuma sham, habbayit tame: 
Tevat hammigdal, yesh bah poteach tefach veen bitziatah poteach tefach, tuma vetochah, habbayit tame. tuma vabbayit, ma shebbetochah tahor, shedderech hattuma latzet veen darkah lehikkanes. rabbi yose metaher, mippene shehu yachol lehotziah lachatzaim o lesarfah bimkomah:
Mishnah Shabbat 1:1-4:
Yetziot hashshabbat shetayim shehen arba bifnim, ushetayim shehen arba bachutz. ketzad. heani omed bachutz uvaal habbayit bifnim, pashat heani et yado lifnim venatan letoch yado shel baal habbayit, o shennatal mittochah vehotzi, heani chayyav uvaal habbayit patur. pashat baal habbayit et yado lachutz venatan letoch yado shel ani, o shennatal mittochah vehichnis, baal habbayit chayyav veheani patur. pashat heani et yado lifnim venatal baal habbayit mittochah, o shennatan letochah vehotzi, shenehem peturin. pashat baal habbayit et yado lachutz venatal heani mittochah, o shennatan letochah vehichnis, shenehem peturin: 
Lo yeshev adam lifne hassappar samuch lammincha, ad sheyyitpallel. lo yikkanes adam lammerchatz velo labburseki velo leechol velo ladin. veim hitchilu, en mafsikin. mafsikim likrot keriat shema, veen mafsikim lattefilla: 
Lo yetze hachayyat bemachto samuch lachashecha, shemma yishkach veyetze. velo hallavlar bekulmoso. velo yefalle et kelav, velo yikra leor hanner. beemet amru, hachazzan roe hechan tinokot korim, aval hu lo yikra. kayyotze vo, lo yochal hazzav im hazzava, mippene hergel avera: 
Veellu min hahalachot sheamru vaaliyyat chananya ven chizkiyya ven guryon keshealu levakkero. nimnu verabbu bet shammay al bet hillel, ushemona asar devarim gazru vo vayyom:
Mishnah Shabbat 1:10-2:2:
En tzolin basar, batzal, uvetza, ella kede sheyyitztzolu mibbeod yom. en notnin pat lattannur im chashecha, velo charara al gabbe gechalim, ella kede sheyyikremu faneha mibbeod yom. rabbi eliezer omer, kede sheyyikrom hattachton shellah: 
Meshalshelin et happesach battannur im chashecha. umaachizin et haur bimdurat bet hammoked. uvaggevulin, kede sheyyeechoz haur berubban. rabbi yehuda omer, befechamin, kol shehu: 
Bamme madlikin uvamma en madlikin. en madlikin lo velechesh, velo vechosen, velo vechalach, velo viftilat haidan, velo viftilat hammidbar, velo viroka sheal pene hammayim. velo vezefet, velo veshaava, velo veshemen kik, velo veshemen serefa, velo vealya, velo vechelev. nachum hammadi omer, madlikin bechelev mevushshal. vachachamim omrim, echad mevushshal veechad sheeno mevushshal, en madlikin bo: 
En madlikin beshemen serefa beyom tov. rabbi yishmael omer, en madlikin beitran, mippene chevod hashshabbat. vachachamim mattirin bechol hashshemanim, beshemen shumshemin, beshemen egozim, beshemen tzenonot, beshemen dagim, beshemen pakkuot, beitran uveneft. rabbi tarfon omer, en madlikin ella veshemen zayit bilvad:
Mishnah Shabbat 1:5-9:
Bet shammay omrim, en shorin deyo vesammanim vecharshinim, ella kede sheyyishshoru mibbeod yom. uvet hillel mattirin: 
Bet shammay omrim, en notnin unin shel pishtan letoch hattannur, ella kede sheyyahbilu mibbeod yom, velo et hatztzemer layyora, ella chede sheyyiklot haayin. uvet hillel mattirin. bet shammay omrim, en porsin metzudot chayya veofot vedagim, ella chede sheyyitztzodu mibbeod yom. uvet hillel mattirin: 
Bet shammay omrim, en mochrin lannachri veen toanin immo veen magbihin alav, ella kede sheyyaggia lemakom karov. uvet hillel mattirin: 
Bet shammay omrim, en notnin orot leabbedan velo chelim lechoves nachri, ella kede sheyyeasu mibbeod yom. uvechullan bet hillel mattirin im hashshamesh: 
Amar rabban shimon ben gamliel, nohagin hayu bet abba shehayu notnin kele lavan lechoves nachri shelosha yamim kodem lashshabbat. veshavin ellu vaellu, shettoanin korot bet habbad veiggule haggat:
Mishnah Shabbat 2:3-6:
Kol hayyotze min haetz en madlikin bo ella fishtan. vechol hayyotze min haetz eno mittamme tumat ohalim ella fishtan. petilat habbeged shekkippelah velo hivhavah, rabbi eliezer omer, temea, veen madlikin bah. rabbi akiva omer, tehora, umadlikin bah: 
Lo yikkov adam shefoferet shel betza vimalenna shemen veyittenenna al pi hanner bishvil shettehe menattefet, afillu hi shel cheres. verabbi yehuda mattir. aval im chibberah hayyotzer mittechilla, muttar, mippene shehu cheli echad. lo yemalle adam et hakkeara shemen veyittenenna vetzad hanner veyitten rosh happetila vetochah, bishvil shettehe shoevet. verabbi yehuda mattir: 
Hamechabbe et hanner mippene shehu mityare mippene goyim, mippene listim, mippene ruach raa, veim bishvil hachole sheyyishan, patur. kechas al hanner, kechas al hashshemen, kechas al happetila, chayyav. verabbi yose poter bechullan chutz min happetila, mippene shehu osah pecham: 
Al shalosh averot nashim metot bishat ledatan, al sheenan zehirot bannidda uvachalla uvehadlakat hanner:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 7:1-4:
Melachot shechayyavin alehen sekila vecharet bemezid o karban chattat bishgaga. mehen avot umehen toladot. uminyan kol avot melachot arbaim chaser achat. veellu hen. hacharisha. vehazzeria. vehakketzira. vehaimmur. vehaddisha. vehazzeriyya. vehabberira. vehattechina. vehaharkada. vehallisha. vehaafiyya. vehaggeziza. vehallibbun. vehannipputz. vehatztzevia. vehatteviyya. vaasiyyat hannirin. vehanesachat hammassecha. vehaariga. vehabbetzia. vehakkeshira. vehahattara. vehattefira. vehakkeria. vehabbinyan. vehassetira. vehakkaa befattish. vehatztzida. vehashshechita. vehahafshata. vehahaavada. umechikat haor. vechittucho. vehakketiva. vehammechika. vehassirtut. vehahavara. vehakkibbuy. vehahotzaa mershut lirshut: 
Kol ellu hammelachot vechol shehu meinyanam hem hannikrain avot melachot. ketzad hu inyanan. echad hachoresh o hachofer o haose charitz hare ze av melacha. shekkol achat veachat mehen chafira bakkarka veinyan echad hu: 
Vechen hazzorea zeraim o hannotea ilanot o hammavrich ilanot o hammarkiv o hazzomer. kol ellu av echad hen meavot melachot veinyan echad hu. shekkol achat mehen letzammeach davar hu mitkavven: 
Vechen hakkotzer tevua o kitnit o habbotzer anavim o haggoder temarim o hammosek zetim o haore teenim. kol ellu av melacha achat hen. shekkol achat mehen laakor davar miggiddulav mitkavven. veal derech zo shear haavot:
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 2:1:
Hassolet im hashshemen shel nesachim enan meakkevin et hayyayin velo hayyayin meakkevan. velo hannesachim meakkevin et hazzevach ella mevi adam karbano hayyom unesachav achar asara yamim echad yachid veechad tzibbur. vehu shello kadshu hannesachim bichli sharet aval im netanan lichli sharet im lanu yippaslu belina:
En meviin nesachim ella min hachullin. lo yeviem lo min hatteruma velo mimmaaser sheni velo min habbikkurim. vaafillu toda shemmevi lachmah min hammaaser lo yevio nesachim ella min hachullin:

Kol shiure hannesachim haemurin besefer yechezkel uminyan otan hakkarbanot vesidre haavoda hakketuvim sham kullam milluim hen veen nohagin ledorot ella hannavi tzivva uferesh ketzad yihyu makrivin hammilluin im chanukkat hammizbeach bime hammelech hammashiach kesheyyibbane bayit shelishi:
Ucheshem shehikrivu hannesiim bachanukkat hammizbeach devarim sheen kemotan ledorot vehikrivu beshabbat kach hannasi makriv chanukkato beshabbat leatid kaasher meforash sham. vechen karbanot shehikrivu bime ezra habbaim mehashshevi milluim hayu veenan nohagin ledorot. aval devarim hannohagim ledorot hem divre tora shepperashnu kemo sheheetikum mippi moshe rabbenu en lehosif alehem veen ligroa:
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 2:9:
Berutze hammiddot shel solet chol sheen gav haissaron kodesh. uverutze hayyayin vehashshemen kodesh lefi shehu yored al gav hakkeli. uchele hallach nimshechu mibbifnim umibbachutz. velamma yitkaddeshu habberutzin af al pi sheen kavvanat hammoded ella lema shebbakkeli bilvad kede shello yomru motziin mikkele sharet lechol:
Ma hayu osin babberutzin. im yesh sham zevach acher yakrivu immo. veim lanu yippaslu belina. veim lav mekayyetzin bahen hammizbeach:
Ketzad lokchin bahem olot. habbasar lashshem vehaorot lakkohanim:
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 3:1:
Shennayim sheratzu lehavi shelamim o ola beshuttafut meviin ben beneder ben bindava. vaafillu of yavo beshuttafut:
Veechad anashim veechad nashim o avadim meviin kol hakkarbanot. aval haakkum en mekabbelin mehen ella olot bilvad shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 25)</small> "umiyyad ben nechar lo takrivu et lechem elohechem". afillu olat haof mekabbelin min hannachri af al pi shehu oved avoda zara. aval en mekabbelin mehen shelamim velo menachot velo chattaot vaashamot. vechen olot sheenan baot beneder unedava en mekabbelin otan min hannachri kegon olat yoledet vechayyotze bah meolot sheenan baot mishshum neder velo mishshum nedava:
Nachri shehevi shelamim makrivin otan olot shehaakkum libbo lashshamayim. nadar shelamim unetanam leyisrael al menat sheyyitkapper bahen leyisrael ochlin otan hayyisreelim keshalme yisrael. vechen im netanan lakkohen kohen ochlan:
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 3:4:
Yisrael shehu mumar laavoda zara o mechallel shabbat befarhesya en mekabbelin mimmennu karban kelal. afillu haola shemmekabbelin otah min hannachrim en mekabbelin otah min hammumar hazze shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 1 b)</small> "adam ki yakriv mikkem" mippi hashshemua lamdu mikkem velo kullechem lehotzi et hammumar. aval im haya mumar lishar averot mekabbelin mimmennu kol hakkarbanot kede sheyyachazor bitshuva. haya mumar laavera vehu mefursam veyadua laasotah vehurgal bah ben lehacheis ben leteavon en mekabbelin mimmennu karban leotah avera. ketzad. kegon shehaya ragil leechol chelev ben lehacheis ben leteavon veshagag veachal chelev vehevi chattat en mekabbelin otah mimmennu: 
Olot haakkum en meviin immahen nesachim shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 13)</small> "kol haezrach yaase kacha". aval niskehem kerevin mishshel tzibbur shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 12)</small> "kacha taasu laechad kemisparam". veenan teunot semicha sheen semicha ella beyisrael baanashim lo benashim:
Niddah 20a:14-16: Rabbi amme bar abba amar: vechullan, amok mikken — tame, dehe mikken — name tame, chutz mishshachor. ella may ahani shiure derabbanan? leappoke dehe dedeha.
Veikka deamri, rame bar abba amar: vechullan, amok mikken — tahor, dehe mikken — tahor, chutz mishshachor, ulehachi mahane shiure derabbanan.

Bar kappara amar: vechullan, amok mikken — tame, dehe mikken — tahor. chutz mimmezeg, sheamok mikken — tahor, dehe mikken — tahor. bar kappara adihu leh — vedakki, aamiku leh — vedakki. amar rabbi chanina: kamma nefish gavra delibbeh (kameshameateyh) [kishmateh]!

Zohar, Shmini 10: Patach hahu ravya veamar, (Mishlei 29:4) melech vemishpat yaamid aretz vegomer. man melech. da kudesha berich hu. bemishpat da yaakov, deihu kelala daavahan. veish terumot, terumat ketiv, kema deat amer (Shemot 25:3) vezot hatteruma. veish terumot, da esav, devae al terumot veal maasrot kol yoma, vela avid midi. veish terumot delav ihu mishpat. deha teruma istalkuta derachame, begin da la atya bemmishpat, kema deat amer (Mishlei 13:23) veyesh nispe belo mishpat, veal da, veish terumot yehersenna.

Vei tema, ha david malka ish teruma hava, ella berachame. velo od ella (sefer acher david malka ish teruma hava veara itkayyeyma begineh hachi hu vadday. aval kolla berachame hava) deha ketiv (Yeshayahu 55:3) chasde david hanneemanim, kema deitdevak behay, itdevak behay.

Ta chaze, kol yomoy dedavid malka, hava mishtaddal (begin) dehay teruma, yitkeshar bemmishpat, veyizdavvgun kachada. (begin deyitkayyem beara) ata shelomo vezivvivg lon kachada, vekayyeyma sihara beashlemuta, vekayyeyma ara bekiyyuma. ata tzidkiyyahu veafrish lon, veishtearat ara bela mishpat, veitpegimat sihara, veitcharivat ara, keden veish terumat yehersenna.
Zohar, Shmini 15: Veta chaze, kol man deachil meinnun maachale daasire, itdevak besitra ochora, vegail nafsheh vegarmeh, veruach mesaav sharya aleh, veachze garmeh delet leh chulaka beelaha illaa, vela ate missitreh, vela itdevak beh. vei yippuk hachi mehay alma, achidan beh kol innun daachidan bistar (sefer acher deatyayn missetar) dimsaava, umesaavin leh vedayynin leh kebar nash deihu gaala demareh, gaala behay alma, vegaala bealma deate.

Veal da ketiv, venitmetem bam bela 1, dela ishtechach asuvta legiuleh, vela nafik mimmesaavuteh lealmin. vavy lon, vavy lenafshayyhu, dela yitdabbekun bitzrora dechayye lealmin, deha isteavu. vavy legarmayyhu, alayyhu ketiv (Yeshayahu 66:24) ki tolatam lo tamut vegomer, vehayu deraon lechol basar. may deraon. sirchona. man garim leh, hahu setar deitdabbak beh.

Yisrael atyayn missitra dimina, i itdabbekan bistar semala, ha pagmin listar da, ufagmin legarmayyhu, ufagmin lenafshayyhu, pegimin bealma den, ufegimin, bealma deate. kol shekken man deitdabbak bistar dimsaava, decholla achid da beda, uchetiv (Devarim 14:2) ki am kadosh atta laAdonai elohecha vegomer.

Ribbi yose patach veamar, (Kohelet 6:7) kol amal haadam lefihu vegomer. istakkalna bemille dishlomo malka, vechullehu achidan bechachma illaa. kol amal haadam lefihu, hay kera, beshaata dedayynin leh lebar nash behahu alma ketiv, kol hahu dina, vechol may desavil behahu alma, venakmin minneh nikmata dealma. lefihu: begin pihu, dela natir leh, vesaiv leh lenafsheh, vela itdevak besitra dechayye, besitra dimina. vegam hanefesh lo timale, la tishtelim dinaha lealam ulealme almin. davar acher lo timale, la tishtelim lesalleka leatraha lealmin, begin deha isteavat, veitdabbekat besitra ochora.

Ribbi yitzchak amar, kol man deisteav behu, keillu palach leavoda zara, deihu (Devarim 17) toavat Adonai, uchetiv lo tochal kol toeva. man defalach leavoda zara, nafik missitra dechayye, nafik mershuta kaddisha, veayil birshuta ochora. uf man deisteav behane mechle, nafik missitra dechayye, venafik mershu kaddisha, veayil birshuta ochora. velo od, ella deisteav behay alma, uvealma deate. veal da venitmetem bam ketiv bela 1.

Uchetiv, velo teshakketzu et nafshotechem babbehema uvaof uvechol asher tirmos haadama asher hivdalti etchem letamme. may letamme. letamme leammin ovde avoda zara, deha innun misavin, umissitra dimsaava ka atyayn. vechol chad itdabbak beatreh.

Ribbi elazar hava yativ kame deribbi shimon avoy, amar leh, ha detanenan zammin kudesha berich hu ledakkaa lehu leyisrael, bemma. amar leh, bemma dichtiv, (yechezkel 36:25) vezarakti alechem mayim tehorim utehartem vegomer. kevan deitdakkean mitkaddeshan, veyisrael deitdabbekan beh bekudesha berich hu, kodesh ikrun, dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 2:3) kodesh yisrael laAdonai reshit tevuato, uchetiv (Shemot 22:30) veanshe kodesh tihyun li, zakkain innun yisrael, dekudesha berich hu kaamar alayyhu, vihyitem kedoshim ki kadosh ani Adonai, begin dichtiv (Devarim 10) uvo tidbak, uchetiv (Tehillim 147:20) lo asa chen lechol goy umishpatim bal yedaum haleluyah.

Zohar, Shmini 2: Ribbi elazar hava azil beorcha, ashkacheh leribbi pinchas ben yair dehava ate, gaa chamareh. amar ribbi pinchas, vadday betakula (nusach acher bekala) dechedvevta dachamara, chamena (chamit) anpin chadtin yishtakkechun hacha, kevan denafak mibbatar anpoy detura, chama leh leribbi elazar dehava ate, amar vadday takula (nusach acher kala) dechedvevta ishtelim. nachat ribbi elazar legabbeh, venashik leh, amar leh i tufesa dearcha, chad legabbach, nezil venitchabber kachada. vei lav tol archach vezil. amar leh, vadday lokovlach azilna, kevan deashkachna lach, ezil avatrach venitchabbar kachada.

Patach ribbi pinchas veamar, (Tehillim 128:5) yevarechcha Adonai mitztziyyon uree betuv vegomer. yevarechcha Adonai mitziyyon, may tama mitztziyyon. begin deha mitamman sharan birchan leishtattefa (sefer acher leishtakkecha). hada hu dichtiv ki sham tzivva Adonai et habberacha chayyim ad haolam. uvegin kach yevarechcha Adonai mitziyyon deha mittamman nafke birchan lecholla. uree betuv yerushalam, divgine tziyyon yerushalam itbarcha, dechevan detziyyon itmele birchan, keden yerushalam itbarcha, veishtechachu bah rachamim. vechad yerushalam itbarcha, kol amma itbarcha.

Kol yeme chayyecha, dela yitchaze keshet beyomach, kema leavuch. veal da uree betuv yerushalam kol yeme chayyecha. uree vanim levanecha, dachale chattaa, chasidin, kaddishin, keden shalom al yisrael. may shalom al yisrael. ella, keman deamar shelama al resheh demalka, dela yechsar kolla. kach shalom al yisrael, bezimna detzaddikayyay yishtakkechun bealma.

Patach ribbi elazar veamar, (Mishlei 17:6) ateret zekenim bene vanim vetiferet banim avotam. banim ha okimna. bene vanim, illen (35 amud alef) shear kitre malka, kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 54:13) vechol banayich limmude Adonai. uchetiv (Eicha 4:2) bene tziyyon hayekarim, kema deat amer vetiferet banim avotam, la mitatteran benin ella baavahan. mikkan olifna, divnin la mitattere, vela mishtakyayn mishshakyu denachala, ella bezimna daavahan mitatteran umitbarchan, hada hu dichtiv vetiferet banim avotam.
Zohar, Shmini 6: (Vayikra 10:9) yayin veshechar al tesht atta uvanecha ittach vegomer. amar ribbi yehuda, miggo parsheta da shamenan, denadav vaavihu revi chamra havo, middeazhar lechahane beha. ribbi chiyyay patach, (Tehillim 104:15) veyayin yesammach levav enosh vegomer, i bae kahana lemechde uleishtakkecha binhiru deanpin yattir mikkolla, amay asir leh chamra, deha chedu beh ishtechach, nehiru deanpin beh ishtechach.

Ella sheruta dechamra chedvavta. sofeh atzivu. veod deyyayin missitra delevae ate, meatar dechamra share, deha orayyta vechamra deorayyta, missitra digvura hu. (sefer acher sefeh atzivu, vechahana sheruta vesiyyuma bae chedvata unehiru deanpin, yayin ate missitra delevae) vesitra dechahana mayin tzelilin nehirin.

Ribbi yose amar kol chad ozif lechavreh, vechalil kolla da beda, uvegin kach, chamra share chedvavta, begin dechalil miggo mayya, ulevatar ahdar leatreh, veatziv veragiz vedain dina. (vechahana sheruta vesiyyuma bae chedvata unehiru deanpin)

Ribbi abba amar, meatar chad nafku, yayin veshemen umayim. mayim veshemen limina, natle kahane veyarte lon, veshemen yattir mikkolla. deihu chedvavta sheruta vesiyyuma, dichtiv, (Tehillim 133:2) kashshemen hattov al harosh yored al hazzakan zekan aharon. veyayin lismala, yarte levae, learma kala ulezammera, vela lishtuk, deha chamra la shatik lealmin, veshemen bachashay hu tadir.

Ma ben hay lehay. ella, shemen deihu bachashay bilchishu tadir, ate missitra demachashava, deihu bilchishu tadir vela ishtema, vehu bachashay, veal da hu mimina. veyayin deihu (korach 176) learma kala, vela shatik lealmin, ate missitra deimma, veyartin levae listar semala, vekayyme lezammera learma kala, vekayyme bedina. uvegin kach ketiv, (Devarim 21:5) veal pihem yihye kol riv vechol naga.

Begin kach, kahana kad yiul lemakdesha lemiflach pulechana, asir leh lemishte chamra, deha ovadoy bachashay innun, uvachashay (sefer acher itchaze) atan veitkevvavn, (sefer acher uvachashay itkevavn bema deitkavvevn) vezivvivg leman dezivvivg, venagid birchan lealmin kullehu, vecholla bachashay, (veod) deovadoy kullehu beraza. vechamra megalle razin hu, deha kol ovadoy learma kala kaim.

Ribbi yehuda veribbi yitzchak havo azle bearcha, mibbe mironya letzippori, vahava ravyay chad shechiach begavvavn (sefer acher legabbayyhu), bechamra bekinta deduvesha amar ribbi yehuda nema milla deorayyta venezil.

Patach ribbi yitzchak veamar, (Shir hashshirim 7:10) vechikkech keyen hattov holech ledodi lemesharim vegomer. vechikkech keyen hattov, da yena deorayyta, deihu tav. deha yena ochora lav ihu tav, veyena deorayyta, tav lecholla. tav lealma da, vetav lealma deate. veda hu yena denicha leh lekudesha berich hu yattir mikkolla, uvizchu da, man dimravvi miyena deorayyta, yittear lealma deate, veyizke leachayay, kad yokim kudesha berich hu letzaddikayyay. amar ribbi yehuda, dovev sifte yeshenim, ha tanenan deafillu behahu alma, yizke lemile beorayyta, hada hu dichtiv dovev sifte yeshenim.
Amar hahu ravya, i ketiv vechikkech miyyen hattov, havina amre hache. aval keyen hattov ketiv, vela miyyen. ashgechu beh, amar ribbi yehuda, beri ema millach, deshappir ka amrat.

Amar, ana shemana, deman deishtaddal beorayyta, vedavik ba, vehahi milla deorayyta ishtema befumeh, vela lachish lah bilchishu, ella arim kaleh ba. deorayyta hachi baya learma kala, dichtiv, (Mishlei 1:21) berosh homiyyot tikra, learama rinna deorayyta, vela bilchishu. keyen hattov, kachamar tav dela shatik. vehu atid learama kala, kad yippuk mehay alma. holech ledodi lemesharim, dela yiste limina velismala, la yishtekach deyimche bidoy. dovev sifte yeshenim, afillu behahu alma shifvavteh merachshan orayyta.

Tu shemana vechikkech keyen hattov, hay kera likkeneset yisrael ittemar, uvetushebachta ittemar. i hachi, man hu dimshabbach lah behay. i kudesha berich hu, mahu holech ledodi, holech elay mibbae leh.

Ella vadday kudesha berich hu ka meshabbach lah likkeneset yisrael, kema dehi ka meshabbachat leh, dichtiv chikko mamtakkim, kach kudesha berich hu meshabbach le likkeneset yisrael. (dichtiv) vechikkech keyen hattov, yen hattov: dehu chamra demintera. holech ledodi: da yitzchak, deikre yedid mibbeten. lemesharim: kema deat amer, (Tehillim 99:4) atta konanta mesharim, leitkallela semala bimina. veda hu mesharim, divgin chedvavta dehahu chamar tav, itkelil semala bimina, vechaddan kolla. (dovev sifte yeshanim) deha kolla mitare bechedvavn uvirkan, vealmin kullehu mishtakkeche bechedu, umitare learka birchan letatta.

Atu ribbi yehuda veribbi yitzchak venashsheku leh resheh, vechaddu immeh, amru leh ma shemach. amar leho yesa. amru ribbi yesa tehe. yattir tehe shechiach bealma merabbi yesa chavrana, deistallak mibbenana. amru leh uman avuch. amar leho, aftar mealma, vahava olif li kol yoma 3 millin deorayyta, uvelelya 3 millin dechachmeta deaggadta. vehane mile olifna meabba, vehasheta diuri bechad bar nash, vesalik li meorayyta. vaana azil kol yoma laavidta, uvechol yoma ahadarna innun millin deolifna meabba.

Amru leh hahu bar nash yada beorayyta. amar lon lav. sava hu, vela yada levarcha leh lekudesha berich hu, veit leh benin, vela shavvi lon beve rav. amar ribbi yehuda (nusach acher i lav hachi hava) i la hava hachi, hava ailna legabbe hay kefar lemallela alach, hasheta asir lan lemecheze anpoy. shede chamara minach, veat zil legabban. amru leh man hu avuch. amar ribbi zeera dichfar ramin.

Shama ribbi yehuda uvacha, amar ana havina beveteh, veolifna minneh 3 millin bechassa divracha, veolifna minneh bemaase bereshit tere. amar ribbi yitzchak, uma mehay ravya bereh olifna, minneh la kol shekken. azlu veachidu bideh. chamu chad chakal veyatvu tamman. amru leh ema chad milla, meinnun deolif lach avuch bemaase bereshit.
Zohar, Yitro 32: (Shemot 20:8) zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho da ihu raza divrit kaddisha. uvegin dibbehay berit kayymin kol mekorin deshayyfe gufa, veihu kalal kolla. kegavvna, da shabbat ihu kelala deorayyta, vechol razin deorayyta beh talyayn, vekiyyuma deshabbat, kekiyyuma dechol orayyta, man denatir shabbat, keillu natir orayyta kulla.

Raya mehemna pikkuda 24, lemehevi dachir yom hashshabbat, kema deat amer zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho. raza deshabbat, ha okimna bechol innun duchete, yoma ducherana denayycha dealma veihu kelala deorayyta. uman denatir shabbat, keillu natir orayyta kolla. veha ittemar, ducherana deshabbat, lekaddesha leh bechol zine kidushin. man deidkar lemalka, itztzetrich levarcha leh, man deidkar shabbat, tzarich lekaddesha leh veha ittemar.
Zachor lidchura ihu. shamor ihu lenukeba. (veda belo piruda) yom shabbat, raza dechol mehemanuta, detalya meresha illaa, ad sofa dechol dargin, shabbat ihu kolla.

Telat dargin innun, vechullehu ikrun shabbat. shabbat illaa. shabbat deyoma. shabbat delelya. vechullehu chad veikre kolla shabbat. vechol chad, kad ihu shalta, natil lechavroy, vezamin lon bahadeh, behahu shuletanu dileh. vechad hay ate lealma, kullehu atyayn uzeminin bahadeh.

Kad ate lelya, zamin bahadeh leshabbat dimama, vezamin leh behechaleh, veittammar bahadeh. kevan dehay atya, shabbat illaa itmeshach aleh, vchullehu genizin behechla delelya uvegin da seudata delelya chamur mibbeymama (sefer acher kadebaymamea.)

Kad ate yemama, zamin bahadeh litren illen acharanin, darga illaa vedarga tattaa, da deanhir leh, veda deitnehir minih. vecholla kachada ikre shabbat, veshaltin beyoma deshabbat. veillen telat dargin, innun kelala vraza dechol orayyta, tora shebbichtav, neviim uchetuvim. man denatir shabbat, natir orayyta kulla.

rashi: El moshe veel aharon. lemoshe amar sheyyomar leaharon:

Lemor alehem. amar sheyyomar leelazar uleitamar; o eno ella lemor leyishorael? keshehu omer dabberu el bene yishorael hare dibbur amur leyishorael, ha ma ani mekayyem lemor alehem? labbanim — leelazar uleitamar (sifra):
ohc: El moshe veel aharon. amar veel aharon, ulay shennitkavven laasot shenehem yachad shelichut mitzva zo el yisrael, vechen gamar omer dabberu el bene yisrael, vechen amar befarashat bo (Shemot 12:1) "el moshe veel aharon vegomer dabberu" vegomer, ki leinyan hakedama sheyyakdim moshe lomar leaharon kodem yisrael kevar lamadnu ze mimmakom acher.

Lemor alehem. razal amru (torat kohanim) "alehem" – perush sheyyomar leelazar uleitamar, vehakkavvana baze kede lehakedimam ballimmud kodem, kidtanya (eruvin ned.) beseder hallimmud. veulay shennitkavven lehatzericham lehorot bene yisrael al derech (Malachi 2:7) "ki sifte chohen" vegomer, vaasher al ken samach laze "dabberu" vegomer. od yitbaer amro lemor alehem lefi ma shepperashti bimkomot acherim (Shemot 20:1) ki taam amro "lemor" ki haddibbur hayyotze mippi el elyon haya notzar mimmennu malach vehu haya medabber im moshe, uferush "lemor" hu haddibbur yomar lemoshe, uchemo chen amar kan "lemor alehem" – perush haddibbur yomar lemoshe uleaharon. veen perush ze machchish divre razal sheamru (torat kohanim 1) lo haya haddibbur ella lemoshe velo leaharon, ki gam ledarkenu lo haya shomea divre Adonai ella moshe, ella shehammalach hammithavve mehaddibbur haya medabber leshon rabbim, umoshe haya maggia haddevarim leaharon.

rashi: Vayyitav beenav. hoda velo vosh lomar lo shamati (zevachim 101):
ohc: Vayyishma moshe vayyitav vegomer. yesh ladaat ech nitallema mimmennu halacha peshuta kazo lechallek ben kadshe dorot lekadshe shaa. veim haya lo eze tzad lomar sheen laasot chilluk ze, lamma kibbelo meaharon velo dan alav lesatro. vehinne lefi ma shepperashti lemala ki gam moshe haya tzarich laamod al haddavar im leachla im lisrefa, velo haya lo muchlat haddavar laachila, vehakepadato al aharon uvanav hayta letzad shechashav shesserafuhu belo taam nachon, o letzad shemma era lah eze meora kemaamar razal (fesachim sav., zevachim ka.) sheamar lahem shemma era bo pesul behakeravat damo o nitma o yatza chutz limkomo, vechol elle haddevarim hem letzad miut zerizutam, veal ze hayta hahakpada, ma sheen ken achar sheamar lefanav aharon haddin sheddan bo usherafo, kibbel moshe hattaam veraa shello saraf ella achar sheddan din tzedek, vein hache namme im lo haya dan aharon vehaya dan moshe kaze haya dan baddavar vesorfo, velo yibbatzer mimmennu kol davar, veamro vayyitav beenav, perush et asher asu bisrefato, velo hikpid al asher samchu al atzman velo shealuhu. o yirtze vayyitav beenav aharon ki tov hu, veyore yore yadin yadin.

O yirtze vayyishma moshe, perush, hattora meida shechilluk ze shemao moshe mippi hakkadosh baruch hu, vayyitav beenav haddavar asher asa aharon. veim tomar im shama ken mippi hakkadosh baruch hu ma makom lehakepadato? ulay letzad shello amaro adayin leaharon, chash sheddan bo taam acher sheeno tzodek userafo. o efshar ki beotah shaa neemra lo nevua zo, ki metzuya hayta nevua lemoshe, keamro (Bamidbar 9:8) "imdu veeshmea ma yedabber Adonai", uchemo chen kan techef "vayyishma moshe" mippi Adonai hammishpat, "vayyitav beenav" asher tzadak aharon bemishpato.

Verazal amru bammidrash (torat kohanim kan) veze leshonam: amar rav yehuda, chananya ben yehuda haya doresh kol yamav kasha hahakpada sheggarma lemoshe litot, achar mitato ani meshiv lo al devarav, vechi mi garam lo shehikpid, ella shettaa, ad kan. taam amro "kol yamav", gam taam chananya shello amar kerav yehuda shehu hayyoter muvan mippeshate hakkatuv, gam tamo shel rav yehuda shello chalak ella achar moto – yerae ki chananya verav yehuda kol echad mitkavven ledabber tov al moshe, letzad sheyyesh lefanenu shete derachim: ha hashshichcha asher amar lo Adonai vehu shello min hammusar leneeman bayit, 2 shennitkaes al bene aharon vedibber lahem kashot kannizkar, vegam letzad aharon katzaf bederech nistar. uva chananya uvachar litlot kemoshe shigyon hakkaas sheshshagag bo, vehu sibba letaut, millomar chas veshalom sheshshachach devar Adonai shehu dofi gadol. uchemo chen matzinu besifre (mattot 31:21) sheamar rabbi elazar ben azarya bishlosha mekomot ba moshe lichlal kaas uva lichlal taut vechulei, kayyotze baddavar "vayyiktzof moshe al elazar" vegomer ad kan. mikkan atta lamed shehaddavar shealav hikpid lo (mitztzad) hattaut. veim tomar, im ken lamma hikpid im lo taa, behechreach lomar shehikpid al asher danu bedatam vesamchu al horaatam mibbeli sheelat rabbam, veal ze nitallema hemennu halacha veamar "achol tochlu", vesover ki behechlet hu omer kefi haddin sherauy leachlah, lo kemo shepperashti sheen devarav behechlet ella sheomer tzad hannegdi lemaasehem. uva rav yehuda vechalak ki en litlot bemoshe hahakpada behechlet, ki yesh bahakepada tzad lomar shehi gerua mehelem davar, veefshar litlot shettaa veshagag baddin uletzad shigyono hikpid al hammaase shennaasa shello kirtzono yitbarach, aval zulat hattaut lo yakpid al kevodo.

Vehinne daat zo lo hayta muchraat lerav yehuda ella shekula, sheyyesh panim lehakel bivchinat hahakpada, veyesh panim lehakel bivchinat hattaut, velaze lo chalak al chananya ella achar moto, sheamad bidrasha zo velo amar pan haacher sheyyeshno bemishkolet hahaskel, mashma ki muchra etzlo haddavar ki hikpid, uvaze chalak alav, velaze dikdek lomar, achar mitato ani meshiv. uvenosach sifra shellefanenu amru "hareni kemeshiv al devarav", umimma sheamar "kemeshiv" mashma velo meshiv, vichavven gam ken lidvarenu. o efshar lomar ki rav yehuda bachar behechlet lomar tamo shel moshe hu letzad shettaa millomar shehikpid, shehu maase bilti hagun, ki hattaut yachol adam litot behessach haddaat, ma sheen ken hahakpada shehu maase mezid, veod im nomar shettaa hare lo yatzta takkala mittaut, veim nomar shehikpid hare yatzta takkala mittachat yado shehare hikpid venitkaes. velaze bachar rav yehuda lomar, mi garam lo shehikpid ella shettaa. vetaam amro achar moto, lomar sheafillu kol yamav darash vaafillu kevar met haddoresh lo nimnati millachlok letzad amittut haddavar etzli, o nitkavven lomar shello chalak immo befanim veshatak ella leachar moto, sheefshar sheim haya bechayyim chayyuto haya meshiv al haddavar lehochiach kemoto, verazal emet yehge chikkam.

rashi: El tocho. en keli cheres mittamme ella meaviro (chullin 24):
Kol asher betocho yitma. hakkeli chozer umetamme ma shebbaaviro:
Veoto tishboru. limmed sheen lo tohora bammikve:

Hashshoretz al haaretz. lehotzi et hayyattushin shebbakkelisin veshebbappolin, veet hazzizin shebbaadashim, shehare lo shartzu al haaretz ella betoch haochel, aval mishsheyyatzu laavir veshartzu hare neesru (sifra; chullin 67):
Lo yeachel. lechayyev al hammaachil kaochel; veen karuy sheretz ella davar namuch, ketzar raglayim, sheeno nire ella kerochesh venad:

Hu asher dibber vegomer. hechan dibber? venoadti shamma livne yishorael venikdash bichvodi (Shemot 29), al tikre bichvodi ella bimchubbaday; amar lo moshe leaharon, aharon achi, yodea hayiti sheyyitkaddesh habbayit bimyuddaav shel makom, vehayiti savur o vi o vecha, achshav roe ani shehem gedolim mimmenni umimmecha (sifra):
Vayyiddom aharon. kibbel sachar al shetikato, uma sachar kibbel? shennityached immo haddibbur — shenneemra lo levaddo parashat shetuye yayin (Vayikra Rabba 12):
Bikrovay. bivchiray:

Veal pene chol haam ekkaved. keshehakkabba ose din batztzaddikim mityare umitalle umitkalles, im ken beellu, kol shekken barshaim; vechen hu omer nora elohim mimmikdashecha (tehillim 68), al tikre mimmikdashecha ella mimmekuddashecha:
ohc: Hu asher dibber Adonai vegomer. tzarich ladaat kavvanat amro hu. 2, amro "lemor" mashma shetztzivva Adonai lemor, im ken lamma lo amar ad atta? veshiggayon ze dome leshigyon azharat shabbat shello tzivva bishato ad achar kach amar (Shemot 16:23) "hu asher dibber Adonai", vesham matzinu lo teamim maspikim bainyan, ki lo neemar lo "lemor", kemo sheddikdek lomar "hu asher dibber Adonai shabbaton" vegomer velo amar "lemor", ma sheen ken bema shellefanenu sheamar "lemor".

Verazal matzinu lahem sheamru (torat kohanim hacha): haya aharon omed vetohe veomer "oy li, kach avera beyadi uveyad banay shekkach higgiatni". nichnas moshe etzlo vehaya mefayyeso, amar lo: "aharon achi, missinay neemar li 'atid ani lekaddesh habbayit beadam gadol, vehayiti omer o bi o becha habbayit mitkaddesh, achshav nimtzeu banecha gedolim mimmenni umimmecha" vechulei, ad kan. davar acher "vayyomer moshe vegomer hu asher dibber" vegomer – dibbur ze neemar lemoshe besinay velo yedaah ad shebba maase leyado, vechevan vechulei amar lo moshe leaharon: "lo metu banecha ella bishvil kedushshat shemo shel makom", shenneemar (Shemot 28:43): "venoadti shamma livne yisrael venikdash bichvodi". kevan sheshshama aharon shebbanav yedue hammakom hen, shatak, ad kan.

Hinne ladderech harishon mefaresh tevat hu al ze hadderech: leheyot shehaya mitztaer al hassibba shehu sibbev levanav shemmetu, laze amar lo moshe ki hu ze taam mitatam, letzad asher dibber Adonai vegomer, velo letzad avono haya haddavar. vetevat "hu" kefi ze chozeret el hassovev. ulederech sheni tevat hu chozeret el haddibbur hassatum shello yadu, veatta yada ki hu ze mechuvvan haddibbur hanneemar lo kodem "venikdash bichvodi", gam lo neemar lo sham davar velo lemor, dok vetashkach, venisharu haddevarim bilvav moshe setumim ad sheat maase vehevinam veamar "hu asher dibber Adonai elay", uma dibber? "venikdash bichvodi". veamro lemor vegomer, perush: kavvanat divre Adonai beamro "venikdash bichvodi" hu lomar al ze hadderech, beamro "venikdash" retzono lomar "bikrovay ekkadesh", veamro "bichvodi" hu "veal pene chol haam ekkaved". ulederech ze nityashshevu kol haddikdukim, ella lederech rishon adayin kashe ma shehikshenu. velaamod al omek devarav yesh lehair amro "o bi o becha" shello haya lo lomar ella "bi o becha" o yomar "becha o bi", ki lo yutzdak lomar "o" bitchilla.

Velaze nire leyashshev, ki letzad sheyyesh bainyan shene devarim: haechad hu bechinat hammaala, vehashsheni bechinat hammeora shehu hammita. ucheshebba lomar et asher hevin mi hu hakkarov asher yikdash bo, im haya matchil lomar "bi" o "becha", haya nishma bidvarav ki hu hakkarov lifne Adonai beyoter maala vechavod, velaze hizkir atzmo bifshitut vehizkir aharon besafek "o". laze amar "o bi" sheggam hu besafek, veim haya omer "becha o bi" yavo hammechush ki ratza lehalebish hammeora hara beaharon ki hu yamut behasheraat shechina veet atzmo asa besafek. laze nitchakkem moshe veamar "o bi", hikdim atzmo letzad bechinat kabbalat happureanut velo behechlet, kede shello yikkanes bachashad ki maarich atzmo beerech gadol meaharon, veamar "o" derech safek kederech hassafek sheasa beaharon beamro "o becha".

Ella sheadayin kashe, kevan shello neemar meAdonai ella echad mehem, velo nichnas lo hassafek ella eze echad mehem, im ken lamma metu shenayim? veod, minnayin lo lomar shehem gedolim mimmoshe veaharon, kevan shello amar Adonai ella echad mehem umetu shenehem nichnesu bimkom echad mehem, veeno yachol lomar ella tovim hashshenayim meechad mehem (Kohelet 4:9).

Achen hakkavvana hu shekkesheamar lo Adonai "venikdash bichvodi" (Shemot 29:43), yada moshe ki yamut mehatztzaddikim, ella shessavar beshiur mashmaut haddevarim beamro "venikdash bichvodi" hu sheyyitkaddesh habbayit beoto shehu kevodi mechubbadi shehu hatztzaddik. ulefi ze en kan ella tzaddik echad, ki chen mashma "kevodi" leshon yachid, venafal lo hassafek mi hu ze hayyachid, im hu moshe im hu aharon, vehu amro "o bi o becha" uchemo shepperashnuha. veachshav kesheraa ki metu shenayim, chazar lehavin kavvanat amro "venikdash bichvodi" sheen hakkavvana sheyyitkaddesh, uvamme – bichvodi, shehu leshon yachid, ella hakkavvana hu al ze hadderech "bikrovay ekkadesh" vehu amro "venikdash", veamro "veal pene chol haam ekkaved" hu kavvanat amro "bichvodi" perush bishvil kevodi. uchefi perush ze lo amar Adonai leshon yachid batztzaddikim, ki hatztzaddikim nirmezu beamro "venikdash", veamro "bichvodi" hu bishvil kevodi, veharaya shekkach hu kavvanat amirato yitbarach shehare metu shenayim, vehu amro "hu asher dibber" teshuva leaharon shello yitatztzev vechulei, uferush divre Adonai shehem "lemor" perush kavvanat amirato hi al ze hadderech "bikrovay vegomer veal pene" vegomer lishlol perush acher sheyyitchayyev mimmennu lomar shello yamut ella echad.

O efshar shemoshe hevin gam ken derech ze sheamar kan "bikrovay" vegomer "veal pene" vegomer, vehu ma sheramaz bidvarav "o bi" vechulei, ki amro "o" yaggid shekkadma chalukka acheret, vehu shenehem yachad, vehu derech shetztzadak levassof, o bi levad, o becha levad, veachar maase huchra safek hashshakul shekkavvanato lomar "bikrovay" vegomer "veal pene" vegomer, velaze metu shenayim.

Uvaze nityashshevu haddikdukim sheddikdaknu bakkatuv. venishar leyashshev mikkol makom mi amar lemoshe lehacheria ken, dilma leolam hakkatuv kifshuto, venikdash habbayit betzaddik echad hannirmaz betevat "kevodi", uma shemmetu shenayim, ki zechut shenehem matim leshiur echad mehem, moshe o aharon? hinne behasekil al taam haddavar neda sheen zo kushya, ki taam haddavar hu letzad shechash Adonai shekkesherau yisrael et elohehem shachan shemo betocham veen gedullato umorao nikkar kasseder shehu nikkar baelyonim, shello yihye morao alehem kammitztarech velo yitnahagu keshiur hakkavod hammitchayyevim bo. veyoter yesh lachush ligdole yisrael sheyyachshevu bedatam shehem kerovim el Adonai veyirtzu lihyot niggashim umitkarvim. asher al ken asa mishpat baggadol shebbechullan sheen geder lemala mimmennu lachush lo, lomar shebbeerech bechinato lo timmana mimmennu hakkeriva laAdonai, venishar kol haam shomrim kevodo yitbarach, keamro "veal pene chol haam" vegomer. umeatta lichshennomar ki moshe bifne atzmo gadol minnadav o avihu, aharon bifne atzmo gadol mikkol echad mehem gam ken, im ken hinniach Adonai haderaga sheen aleha mora. uletzad hitchabberutam, halo lo yoil zechuto vehassagato shel echad lachavero lahachino leosher lehitkarev lashshechina, veen hagebalat kavod laAdonai ella legeder shel kol echad mehem velo legeder gadol meechad mehem. velichshennachchish bechilluk ze vetirtze lomar ki yitztaref zechut shenayim, im ken adayin yechsar hagedalat kevodo yitbarach beerech moshe veaharon yachad, o shelosha kenadav vaavihu, o Adonai sheyyitztaref zechutam leyoter mizzechut nadav vaavihu, ella vadday ki lo yatzdik hatztzeruf kan. veod timtza sheen neerach zechut hannifrad lizchut hannismach bivchinat hammargaliyyot vaavanim tovot, sheshshenayim ketannim hagam sheyyihyu gedolim behitztarfutam yachad meachat gedola, lo tikkanes immahem haggedola behashevaat haerech, vehaddevarim peshutim.

rashi: Uveer tzara. eshtereyna belaaz:
targum: Metul degumetza amika zanyeta uvira deaka nuchereta:

rashi: Veet habbasar veet haor vegomer. lo matzinu chattat chitzona nishorefet ella zo veshel milluim, vechullan al pi haddibbur:
Vaychatteehu. asahu kemishpat chattat:
Karishon. kaegel shello:
ohc: Vayyakrev et karban haam. zo hakeravat bechinat haorot hannetuot beyisrael mimmekor haor, asher nishtannu beemtzaut hachet velo yihyu bivchinat hannishtevan lehitkarev, ki hashshinnuy bannefesh yechayyev haharchaka, ki yease sheeno mino, uveemtzaut haavoda sheasa aharon yaggid hakkatuv ki hikriv karban haam, perush, shehikriv kol harechakotam. vehinne meharauy haya sheyyichtov pasuk ze besof maase hakkarban, vetaam shehitchil bo, lomar shehappeulla naaset bema shekkivven bammaase kodem asohu, ki lo hammaase hu haikkar ella hakkavvana hatztzericha bo, vehu asher asa aharon bitchillat maasav, vehaven.

Veermoz lecha perat echad katan sheramaz hakkatuv beamro vayyakrev et haola vayyaase kammishpat. kevar ramazti lecha ki zichron haola yirmoz al keneset yisrael, uveemtzaut harechakat yisrael mehayyosher hem moridim haola lematta chas veshalom, uveemtzaut hitkarvutam lo millevad shello teshullach befisham ella yosifu lehaalot aliyya achar aliyya ad shettaamod begeder hammishpat kayyadua lammaskil, vehu "vayyaase kammishpat". shamati:

Mimmaale vegomer umimmafrise vegomer. rabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (torat kohanim; bechorot 6.) shebba leesor afillu maale umafris im nimtzeu bime temea. ufeshat hakkatuv hu al ze hadderech: "mimmaale haggera" – ze haggamal, "umimmafrise" vegomer – ze hachazir, o ze o ze kaamar, velaze diyyek lomar "umimmafrise" vegomer, velo amar "umafrise", vehaven:

rashi: Ulehorot. limmed sheasur shikkor behoraa, yachol yehe chayyav mita, tal atta uvanecha ittach, velo tamutu, kohanim baavodatam bemita, veen chachamim behoraatan bemita (sham):
Zera zerua. zeria shel mine zeronin; zerua shem davar hu, kemo veyittenu lanu min hazzeroim (Daniel 1):
Tahor hu. limmedcha hakkatuv shello huchshar venitkan likkarot ochel lekabbel tuma ad sheyyavou alav mayim:
Vayyamtziu. leshon hoshata vehazemana:
Ki ani Adonai elohechem. keshem sheani kadosh sheani Adonai elohechem, kach vehitkaddishtem — kaddeshu atzmechem lematta:
Vihyitem kedoshim. lefi sheani akaddesh etchem lemala uvaolam habba:
Velo tetammeu vegomer. laavor alehem belavin harebe, vechol lav malkut, vezehu sheamru battalmud (makkot 16:), achal putita loke arba, nemala loke chamesh, tzira loke shesh:
ohc: Ki ani Adonai elohechem. perush, umeshunna umma yisreelit likdushsha vetahara, shello bachar Adonai likkare eloah ella leyisrael, laze tzarich leharechik min hattumea.

Vehitkaddishtem vegomer. perush, im attem mitkaddeshim ani akaddesh etchem leval yikkanes legufechem devar shikkutz, al derech amram (chullin 5.) en hakkadosh baruch hu mevi vechulei, vechol shekken tzaddikim atzman, veheemidu hattosafot maamar ze bidvar issur hannichnas legufo shel adam, ki hakkadosh baruch hu yishmerehu baze.

Od yirtze vehitkaddishtem – taasu gedarim useyagim leval tittammeu, uvaze ani mavtichachem shettihyu kedoshim. vechazar uferesh beeze davar yihyu kedoshim, veamar ki kadosh ani – hinne ma shettole taam keriatam kedoshim shehu letziddo, ha lamadta ki hishra shechinato al happerushim velaze yikkaru al shemo. veamro velo tetammeu vegomer – perush millevad devarim sheatta maale al datecha lishmor atzmecha mehem, od ani mavtichacha shello yeunne lecha kol min hara, vehu amro "bechol hashsheretz haromes" vegomer. od yirmoz shebbeemtzaut shemirat mitzva zo lo yishletu akkum beam bene yisrael, akkum yikkaru sheratzim ushekatzim haromsim al haaretz.

rashi: Vechok banecha. en labbanot chok bakkodashim (sham):
Ki chen tzuvveti. baaninut yochluha (sham; zevachim 101):
Vayhi bayyom hashshemini. lammilluim; hu rosh chodesh nisan shehukam hammishkan bo vayyom venatal eser atarot hashshenuyot beseder olam:
Ulezikne yisrael. lehashemiam sheal pi haddibbur aharon nichnas umeshammesh bichhunna gedola velo yomru meelav nichnas (tanchuma):
ohc: Vayhi bayyom hashshemini. tzarich ladaat ma taam amar "vayhi", uvemassechet megilla (Megila 10.) amar rabbi levi: davar ze masoret beyadenu meanshe keneset haggedola – kol makom shenneemar "vayhi" eno ella leshon tzaar. umakshe: vehakketiv "vayhi bayyom hashshemini", vetanya: oto hayyom hayta simcha lifne hakkadosh baruch hu keyom beriat shamayim vaaretz, ketiv hacha "vayhi" vegomer uchetiv hatam (Bereshit 1:5) "vayhi erev vayhi voker" vegomer. umetaretz: ha metu nadav vaavihu. umakshe od: "vayhi vishmonim shana" (Melachim 1 6:1), "vayhi kaasher raa yaakov" (Bereshit 29:10) vegomer, "vayhi erev vayhi voker" vegomer. umetaretz rav ashe: kol "vayhi" ikka hachi veikka hachi, "vayhi bime" eno ella leshon tzaar, ad kan.

Hachay yitten el libbo lammakshe mippasuk "vayhi bayyom hashshemini" vehelim ayin mimma shellefanav "vayhi erev vayhi voker" shemmimmennu lamad "vayhi bayyom hashshemini", velaze yacholni lomar shemmakshe mishshenehem yachad, ulehagdil kushyato hosif gam pasuk "vayhi bayyom hashshemini" lomar ki rabbim "vayhi" shehem leshon simcha. o efshar shennitkavven lomar lo sheadrabba lehefech, kol makom shenneemar "vayhi" eno ella leshon simcha, kederech shellamad hattanna mivayhi bayyom hashshemini" mivayhi erev", im ken kol "vayhi" lo yigra enah mizze. gam baze lo yuchal lidchot ki devarav hem min hassetam velo bimkomot sheggilla hakkatuv beferush, ki hare hattanna lamad mivayhi erev" vegomer. ella tigdal hattemiha al hammetaretz, ki ma metaretz "hare metu nadav vaavihu", terutz ze moil levayhi bayyom hashshemini" velo levayhi erev vayhi voker" shemmimmennu lamad "vayhi bayyom hashshemini". veen lomar shehaya lo eze inyan lomar sheggam bo bayyom haya eze tzaar, shehare matzinu keshechazar hammakshe vehiksha mimmennu chazar laachorav vehoda chatzi hodaa. veod meikkara lamma lo natan lev rabbi levi meatzmo lakketuvim shemmochichim sheyyesh "vayhi" shehu simcha, vehaya lo lechallek meatzmo.

Achen nire ki kavvanat rabbi levi gam ken lo hayta ella kedivre rav ashe, velaze lo amar "ella amar rav ashe" sheyyihye nishma shessoter devarim harishonim, sheggam yuseblu divre rav ashe bedivre rabbi levi, shehare mikraot "vayhi" rabbim venichbadim, ella shehammakshe savar ki lechol "vayhi" hu omer, venitchakkem lehakeshot mivayhi bayyom hashshemini" ki en hefresh ben "vayhi bime" levayhi bayyom", veratza listor hakkelal afillu bemakom sheyyomar "vayhi bime", vehammetaretz teretz ki sham metu nadav vaavihu, ki lo ratza lechallek ben "vayhi bime" levayhi bayyom", ki en hefresh, veen hochacha mitteshuva zo shessover afillu "vayhi" levad hu leshon tzaar, ki lo huchrach letaretz ze ella letzad shehiksha mivayhi bayyom".

Veachar kach chazar lehakeshot afillu mivayhi" levad, venitchakkem hammakshe lehakedim pasuk "vayhi bishmonim shana" legallot al "vayhi erev" shemmillevad shello haya sham tzaar haya bo simcha. vahagam shemmiddivre habbarayta shehevi lemala muchach shehaya simcha lefanav, eno ella divre hattanna, aval en hochacha mehakkatuv ella shello haya tzaar aval simcha minnayin, laze hikdim pasuk "vayhi bishmonim shana" shezze vadday simcha yaggid bevinyan bet hammikdash (taanit 26.) dichtiv (Shir HaShirim 3:11) "beyom simchat libbo", veze yaggid al "vayhi kaasher raa yaakov" "vayhi erev" vegomer sheenam ella simcha. veamar rav ashe "vayhi" ikka veikka vechulei, vechen hayta daat hammetaretz rishon ella shekkadam rav ashe veteretz. veulay gam metaretz rishon rav ashe hu vehizkir shemo bammaskana, o tere setame detalmud hem, ushelosha derachim ellu hem sheanu holchim bahem bishvile hattalmud. nimtzeta omer ki afillu lerav ashe "vayhi bayyom" hu kevayhi bime", vehatztzaar hu shemmetu nadav vaavihu sheen kemotam bechol yisrael, vezulat ze lo haya omer hakkatuv "vayhi", vegam amro (Shemot 19:16) "vayhi vayyom hashshelishi", gam sham hare parcha nishmatam shel kol yisrael keamram zichronam livracha (shabbat pach:) vezulat ze lo haya omer "vayhi vayyom".

Veulay nire od ki hatztzaar sheyyaggid hakkatuv hu shel moshe hammuzkar bakkatuv, ki raa gedullato ugedullat zaro beyad aharon uvanav. vetze ulemad tzaar hakkina middavar tov ma ose, mimmaase banav shel shimon hatztzaddik (menachot kat:), veyishtanne ma shellefanenu shehayta lo ulezaro acharav. uletzad shehiftzir bishlichut paro chara appo bo bayyom hahu vaazavo mihyot kohen leolam, ucheshehiggia yom happekudda nitztaer al asher parach mimmennu oz tiferet kehunnat olam. vahagam ki atzam meod betzidkut uvaanava, halo kol lev chay margish uvifrat bidvar mitzva yikrat haerech umuflaa kazot. veulay ki tzaar ze remazo hakkatuv bappasuk (Bamidbar 7:1) "vayhi beyom kallot moshe" shehu atzmo yom ze, umitat nadav vaavihu ramaz kan bappasuk "vayhi bayyom hashshemini".

Bayyom vegomer kara moshe leaharon vegomer. da ki haose davar kaze sheyyitten gedulla hannodaat lo lezulato, velu yihye achiv, kaasher yitchayyev laasotah, lo yishlot benafsho asotah beshalosh shelemuyyot: haachat sheyyaasenna bimhirut, vehashsheniyya betzeruf bechinat hahadragot sheyyeshnam baddavar, hashshelishit asiyyat haddavar befirsum lifne rabbim. vehodia hakkatuv ki shelashtam yachad shalat moshe benafsho vaasaam. keneged hammehirut amar "bayyom hashshemini", perush bihyot habboker tehor lev lo ikkev, ella techef kara leaharon latet lo hakkehunna velo nitatztzel. 2, asa haddavar betzeruf bechinat hahadragot shennatan hakkehunna leaharon ulevanav yachad, hagam ki baze yigdal haitztzavon belibbo sheyyire gedulla moshechet leaharon uvanav, vaasher yeatzev el libbo yaase haddavar behaderagot – bitchilla yikra leaharon veachar kach levanav, ki lo haya hechreach bikriat habbanim az im aharon. hag, bematztzav kol hazzekenim dichtiv ulezikne yisrael, laasot haddavar befumebi bifne rabbim venichbadim, veze yore al shelemut haratzon laasot retzono yitbarach, vechafa haregashotav.

rashi: Senappir. ellu sheshshat bahem (chullin 59):
Kaskeset. ellu kelippin hakkevuim bo (kemo shenneemar 0, veshiryon kaskassim hu lavush):

ohc: Vayyikchu vene aharon nadav vaavihu vegomer. yirtze lehodia mekom tautam shehi lishte sibbot: haechad – lihyotam kohanim shealehem teot haavoda, vezehu shehitchil lomar "bene aharon". 2 – heyotam gedolim bemaase ushekulim hem kemoshe veaharon, keamram zichronam livracha (torat kohanim hacha achare 53) ucheamram besefer hazzohar hakkadosh (achare 56) shehayu bemadrega gedola mitztzad maasehem, veze amro "nadav vaavihu". uvechina zo enah beelazar veitamar, shehagam shehem bene aharon en lahem madrega mitztzad atzmam kenadav vaavihu. vechen timtza sheddarshu zichronam livracha (torat kohanim Vayikra 10:16) bema shekkatuv "vayyiktzof moshe al elazar vegomer hannotarim" vegomer yeuyyan sham divrehem. uvechoach ze nichnesu, vedikdeku likkanes shenehem yachad lehagedil zechutam, velo ratzu lakachat meesh hammizbeach. amru: ulay en rauy lakachat mimmenna ella liktoret hachiyyuv, laze heviu mibbachutz.
Vayyasimu aleha. velo amar "alehen" keamro "vayyittenu vahen" vegomer, "vayyasimu alehen", chozer el haesh shehizkir besamuch, lihyot shehakepada hi al esh zara, laze kinna bah hammaase.

Zara asher lo tzivva. perush, uma hi zarutah? shello tzivva Adonai otah. veulay sheim hayu lokchim esh meal hammizbeach lo haya Adonai makpid al haddavar kol kach, o efshar shehaya makpid meofen acher. od yirtze al ze hadderech "esh zara asher lo tzivva otam" laasot ken, veze hi zarutah.

rashi: Mafreset parsa veshesa enenna shosaat. kegon gamal, shepparsato seduka lemala aval lematta hi mechubberet, kan limmedcha shennivlat behema temea metammea, uvainyan shebbesof happarasha peresh al behema tehora:
Hachasida. zo dayya levana, 170, velamma nikra shemah chasida? sheosha chasidut im chavroteha bimzonot (sham):
Haanafa. hi dayya ragzanit, venire li shekkorin oto hayraven:

Hadduchifat. tarnegol habbar, vecharbalto chefula, uvelaaz 292, velamma nikra shemo duchifat? shehodo chafut" vezo hi karbalto, venaggar tura nikra al shem maasav, kemo sheppershu rabbotenu bemassechet gittin beferek mi sheachazo (gittin daf 68):
