Mikkol haochel asher yeachel. musav al mikra haelyon: "kol asher betocho yitma mikkol haochel asher yeachel" asher bau alav mayim vehu betoch keli cheres hattame yitma (vechen kol mashke asher yishshate bechol keli vehu betoch keli cheres hattame yitma). lamadnu mikkan devarim harebe, lamadnu sheen ochel muchshar umetukkan lekabbel tuma ad sheyyavou alav mayim paam achat, umishshebbau alav mayim paam achat mekabbel tuma leolam vaafilu naguv, vehayyayin vehashshemen vechol hannikra mashke machshir zeraim letuma kammayim, shekkach yesh lidrosh hammikra: asher yavo alav mayim o chol mashke asher yishshate bechol keli, yitma haochel, veod lamdu rabbotenu mikkan sheen velad hattuma metamme chelim shekkach shaninu (fesachim 80), yachol yehu chol hakkelim mittammein meavir keli cheres tal kol asher betocho yitma mikkol haochel — ochel (umashke) mittamme meavir keli cheres veen kol hakkelim mittammein meavir keli cheres — lefi shehashsheretz av hattuma vehakkeli shennitma mimmennu velad hattuma, lefichach eno chozer umetamme chelim shebbetocho, velamadnu od shehashsheretz shennafal laavir hattannur vehappat betocho velo naga hashsheretz bappat, hattannur rishon vehappat sheniyya, velo nomar roin et hattannur keillu male tuma utehe happat techilla, sheim atta omer ken, lo nitmaatu chol hakkelim millittamme meavir keli cheres, shehare tuma atzmah naga bahen miggabban, velamadnu od al biat mayim sheenah machsheret zeraim ella im ken naflu alehen mishshennitleshu, sheim atta omer mekabbelin hechsher bimchubbar, en lecha shello vau alav mayim, umahu omer asher yavo alav mayim? velamadnu od sheen ochel metamme acherim ella im ken yesh bo kabbetza, shenneemar asher "yeachel" — ochel hanneechol bevat echat, veshiaru chachamim en bet habbelia machazik yoter mibbetzat tarnegolet (sifra; yoma 80):
Anakke. herayon:
Halletaa. 549:
Chomet. 171:
Tinshemet. talepaa:
Vayyasimu et hachalavim al hechazot. leachar hattenufa netanan kohen hammenif lechohen acher lehaketiram, nimtzeu haelyonim lematta (menachot 62):

ohc: Vehu gera lo yiggar. perush, tenay hu haddavar lizman shehu lo yiggar, aval leatid lavo yaale gera veyachzor lihyot muttar, velo sheyyishshaer belo gera veyuttar, ki tora lo teshunne.

rashi: Vaydabber aharon. en leshon dibbur ella leshon az, shenneemar vaydabber haam vegomer (Bamidbar 21), efshar moshe katzaf al elazar veal itamar veaharon medabber? ha yadata shello hayta ella midderech kavod; amru: eno vaddin sheyyehe avinu yoshev veanu medabberim lefanav, veeno vaddin sheyyehe talmid meshiv et rabbo; yachol mippene shello haya veelazar lehashiv? tal vayyomer elazar hakkohen el anshe hatztzava vegomer (sham 31), hare kesheratza, dibber lifne moshe velifne hanneshiim, zo matzati besifre shel panim sheni:

Hen hayyom hikrivu. mahu omer? ella amar lo moshe: shemma zeraktem damah onnin, sheonen sheavad chillel? amar lo aharon vechi hem hikrivu shehem hedyotot? ani hikravti sheani chohen gadol umakriv onen (zevachim 101):
Vattikrena oti kaelle. afilu lo hayu hammetim banay, ella shear kerovim sheani chayyav lihyot onen alehem keellu, kegon kol haamurim befarashat kohanim shehakkohen mittamme lahem (sifra).
Veachalti chattat. veim achalti hayyitav vegomer:
Hayyom. aval aninut layla muttar, sheen onen ella yom kevura (sifra; zevachim 100):
Hayyitav beene Adonai. im shamata bekadshe shaa en lecha lehakel bekadshe dorot:
ohc: Vaydabber aharon el moshe. razal (torat kohanim) amru en dibbur ella leshon az, yore al devarim kashim. tzarich ladaat ech yutzdak inyan ze beaharon im moshe. veulay ki letzad sheamar moshe levanav hannotarim shehu dibbur dome liklala, vehu adayin becherdat lev al shene banav shekkevar metu bo bayyom vehassatan mekatreg. uma gam kesheshshama akimat sefatav shel moshe bedimyon hakkelala, laze charad libbo vedibber bekol gadol lifne moshe ki nichmeru rachamav el banav.

Hen hayyom. razal darshu (zevachim ka.) shertzono lomar: vechi beyom ze hikrivu elazar veitamar sheasurim lehakeriv baaninut, sheatta omer shemma hikravtem oto baaninut velaze seraftem? ani hu shehikravti, vechohen gadol makriv onen.

Ufeshat hakkatuv hu al ze hadderech: hen hayyom hikrivu – perush, nadav vaavihu et chattatam veet olatam lifne Adonai vechulei, shekkavvanato ki hu onen ki vo bayyom metu. veachalti chattat hayyom – perush, chattat shel yom shehu seir rosh chodesh, vechan ramaz lo sheyyishtanne ze mimmincha shehu kadshe shaa, aval chattat hayyom hu kadshe dorot – hayyitav beene Adonai leachlo?

Vehaya nire lehochiach mikkan safek echad, im muttar letalmid lehorot leatzmo horaa bimkom rabbo, sheraiti leharosh zichrono livracha (eruvin 63.) shekkatav leesor zulat sar sakkina sheen kefeda kol kach. vehinne mimma sherainu shehora aharon halacha zo leatzman vesarfu hachattat mashma shemmuttar. veen lecha rav muvhak kemoshe leaharon. veulay yesh lidchot, ki en horaa zo horaa, kefi ma sheamru beyoma (Rashi sham daf 5:) sheddan aharon kal vachomer mimmaaser hakkal amra tora "lo achalti veoni" kodesh chamur lo kol shekken, ad kan. vechevan shenneemar lo mippi moshe din maaser keillu amar lo moshe lisrof velo hora hu leatzmo kelum, ki bichlal maaser chattat bekal vachomer uchegon ze muttar letalmid lehorot, vekal hu mibbeata bechutecha. veayyen bedivre hattosafot sham (eruvin sav:) perush horaat beata bechutecha.

rashi: Ki sove vezolel yivvaresh. "yitmasken" (targum yonatan):
Ukeraim talbish numa. haatzlut vehattenuma talbish otcha begadim keruim:
targum: Metul derave veaset mitmasken uvizata nalbesh niuma:

rashi: Dod aharon. uzziel achi amram haya shenneemar uvene kehat vegomer (Shemot 6):
Seu et achechem vegomer. keadam haomer lachavero, haaver et hammet millifne hakkalla shello learbev et hassimcha:
Mafreset. ketargumo sedika:
Parsa. 170 belaaz:

Veshosaat shesa. shemmuvdelet millemala umillematta bishte tzipparnayn, ketargumo umattillefan tilfin, sheyyesh shepparsotav sedukot millemala veen shesuot umuvdalot legamre, shemmillematta mechubbarot:
Maalat gera. maala umekia haochel mimmeeha umachazeret oto letoch piha lechatsho uletochono hadek:
Gera. kach shemo; veyittachen lihyot miggizrat mayim hanniggarim (Shmuel 2 14), shehu nigrar achar happe; vetargumo fishra, sheal yede haggera haochel nifshar venimmoach:
Babbehema. teva yetera hi lidrasha — lehattir et hashshelil hannimtza vime immo (sifra; chullin 69):
Otah tochelu. velo vehema temea, vahalo veazhara hi? ella laavor aleha baase velo taase (sifra; zevachim 34):
ohc: Kol mafreset vegomer maalat gera. yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (chullin 59.) kol behema shemmafreset parsa hi maalat gera, chutz min hachazir, vehu amro kol mafreset vegomer maalat gera, perush beyadua shehi maalat gera, umiet achar kach hachazir sheyyatza mehakkelal. veulay mimma shello hotzi min hakkelal samuch lehodaat hakkelal ramaz sheafillu hachazir bakkelal, al derech amram zichronam livracha (rabbenu bechayye beshem tanchuma) lamma nikra shemo chazir sheatid lachzor lihyot muttar, umeatta kelal "kol mafreset" vegomer hi "maalat" vegomer lo yatza mikkelalo davar, veal zeman mehazzemannim amar hachazir shehu mafris vechulei lo yiggar.

rashi: Yayin veshechar. yayin derech shichruto (sifra):

Bevoachem al ohel moed. en li ella bevoachem lahechol, begishtam lammizbeach minnayin? neemar kan biat ohel moed veneemar bekiddush yadayim veraglayim biat ohel moed, ma lehallan asa gishat mizbeach keviat ohel moed, af kan asa gishat mizbeach keviat ohel moed (sham):
Kach lecha egel. lehodia shekkipper lo hakkabba al yede egel ze al maase haegel sheasha (sham):
ohc: Kach lecha egel. beyoma daf 3 dikdeku: achar sheamar "veel bene yisrael" vegomer, "kach lecha" lamma li? muvan hu shehaegel lo. vedarshu shebba lomar sheyyikkach mishshello velo mishshel tzibbur.

Od nire lomar ki amro "lecha", ki ze yihye lo leot olam ki lo asa hu haegel bechavvana chas veshalom, velo taa acharav, ella shebba al yado belo chavvana uvelo machshava raa. uletzad ze yoil lechapper baegel, ma sheen ken yisrael, letzad shemmaasehem baegel hu bechinat hammezid velo yavo haegel lechattat lahem, vehu adrabba kategor. vetimtza (Vayikra Rabba 21:10) shehikpid Adonai al aharon leval yikkanes levet Adonai penima beyom hakkippurim bevigde zahav, letzad sheasa zehav haegel.

Veyesh lehair baze, lamma tzivva Adonai sheyyavi egel ben bakar lechattat, vahalo hachattat baa lechappara veen lecha sanegor baolam kaze. venire ki haadon baruch hu shafat betzedek haddavar, letzad ki aharon lo asa shum peulla bivchinat maase haegel, ki lo tziyyero velo hachino, veen tzarich lomar shello heemin bo velo taa acharav chas veshalom, kemaamaro lemoshe (Shemot 32:24) "vayyetze haegel", perush, meatzmo yatza al yede maase asher asu shene mechashshefe erev rav yenus veyomberus kemaamaram zichronam livracha (tanchuma, tissa 19). umeatta hammaase sheasa hu bivchinat hazzahav sheamar lahem (sham) "lemi zahav hitparku", velakach miyyadam vayyatzar oto bacheret, umaase ze asahu bidia shelema. vahagam shettaamo haya letzad yira miyyisrael leval yaharguhu kechur, gam haya meabbed lahen hazzeman ad sheyyavo moshe, af al pi chen hare asa maase bilti hagun. asher al ken amar Adonai sheyyavi haegel lechapper al haddavar sheyyatza al yado shello bechavvana. aval hazzahav shemmaase sheasa bo haya bechavvanat hamechuvvan, amar Adonai lo yerae bo lifnay velifnim shello yease kategor sanegor. ma sheen ken yisrael shechatu baegel enam yecholin lehavi egel lechappara, laze tzivva Adonai sheyyaviu seir izzim.

Od nire lomar behair ech anu omrim (rosh hashshana 26.) "en kategor naase sanegor" beinyan hazzahav, vahalo amru (arachin 16.) arbaa bigde zahav shel kohen gadol mechapperim al arbaa mine averot vechulei, im ken kategor naase sanegor? uvehechreach leyashshev ki yishtanne kapparat chutz mikkapparat penim, shekkapparat penim malbenet hachataim kashsheleg, veze lecha haot lashon shel zehorit (yoma 67.), vedavar ze hu mufla vetzarich shello yimmatze bo roshem heavon kelal. vaasher al ken habbegadim lihyotam bachutz mechapperim, hagam heyotam min zahav, ma sheen ken kapparat penim. vegam lefi chilluk ze yishtanne chet shel aharon bazzahav mechetam shel yisrael baegel, ki aharon mechapper bachutz bevigde zahav veyisrael enam mitkapperim baegel, ki chet aharon bazzahav shogeg gamur haya bilkichato uvintinato bacheret, ma sheen ken yisrael, velaze lo yitkapperu baegel afillu bachutz, vehaven:

rashi: Lo haya lah yaled. meoto hayyom vahala:
targum: Ulemichal bat shaul la hava la velad ad yom motah:

rashi: Lemi oy lemi avoy. leshon tzeaka vilala:
Lemi midyanim lemi siach. lemi sheyyesh lo midyanim im habberiyyot vesicha yetera, lo oy vaavoy, ki berov devarim rov pesha (Mishlei 10:19):
Lemi chachlilut enayim. merov yayin maadimim enav, ugenay hu (tanchuma, shemini 5):
targum: Leman vay leman deva uleman tagre uleman shucha uleman pudeata magan uleman sumekanot aynoy:

rashi: Vechol sheretz haof vegomer. ba velimmed sheim yesh lo chamesh tahor (sifra):
ohc: Asher lo arba raglayim. betorat kohanim darshu shebba lehattir mi sheyyesh lo chamesh. venire shehu haddin mi sheyyesh lo shesh vesheva velav davka chamesh, vetzarich ladaat leeze inyan hittir bat chamesh min haddiyyuk, velo amar beferush "kol sheretz haof sheyyesh lo chamesh raglayim" o al ze hadderech "mearba raglayim vamala tochelu". veulay shehutzrach lehashemia gam ken din hetter tzir chagavim temeim, sheddarshu zichrono livracha (torat kohanim) meamro befasuk ze "sheketz hu" perat leeruvav shehu tzir kemaamaram sham, velaze bachar lehashemienu hetter bat chamesh raglayim beofen ze.

rashi: Vayyosef od david. leesof:
Et kol bachur beyisrael sheloshim alef. lefi shenneesfu alav keshehimlichuhu bechevron, vezo hayta asifa sheniyya, lechach neemar vayyosef od:
targum: Veosif od david yat kol bechure yisrael telatin alfin:

rashi: Al tere yayin ki yitaddam. al titten bo enecha:
Ki yitten bakkos eno yithallech bemesharim. hammarbe shichrut, kol averot domot lo lemishor, kol hadderachim yesharim beenav:
Bakkos. bakkis ketiv, kelomar: hashshote noten ayin bakkos vehachenvani – bechiso shel ze (yoma ad:-75.):
targum: La techeme chamra desimok veyahev vechasa ayneh umehalech teritzait:

rashi: Vehannose et nivlatah. chamura tumat massa mittumat magga, shehannose metamme vegadim, vehannogea en begadav temein, shello neemar bo yechabbes begadav:

Vehaochel minnivlatah. yachol tetammeennu achilato? keshehu omer benivlat of tahor (Vayikra 22) "nevela uterefa lo yochal letama vah", vah — otah metamma vegadim baachilatah veen nivlat behema metamma vegadim baachilatah belo massa, kegon im techavah lo chavero bevet habbelia, im ken ma tal haochel? litten shiur lannose velannogea kede achila, vehu kazzayit (sifra; nidda 42):
Vetame ad haarev. af al pi shettaval tzarich haarev shemesh:
ohc: Vehaochel minnivlatah vegomer. betorat kohanim amru shello ba hakkatuv ella litten shiur lenogea ulenose shehu kede achilat kazzayit. veen kavvanat hakkatuv kifshuto shettetammeennu bevet habbelia, shehare matzinu sheamar benivlat of hattahor (Vayikra 22:8) "lo yochal letama vah", bah atta mittamme bevet habbelia vei atta mittamme benivlat behema bevet habbelia. vetzarich ladaat lamma lo amra hattora haddavar beferush. veulay ki nitkavven hakkatuv leharebe dinim sheyyeshnam bedin achila millevad shiur kazzayit. gam amru (chullin 71.), besar hashsheretz shennifsad vehivish venifsal milleechol hakkelev tahor, ad kan, vedavar ze nilmad middin achila kemo shekkatvu hattosafot (bechorot 23.) mimma sheamar hakkatuv (Melachim 2 9:10) "bechelek yizreel yochlu hakkelavim", alma achilat kelavim shemah achila vechulei. veim ken letzad shennitkavven hakkatuv lehashevot hattuma ledin achila, ben lashshiur ben lishar devarim, laze im haya ba lelammed kol perate haddinim tzarich lehosif devarim rabbim, vechesef nivchar leshon tzaddik.

rashi: Vayyaronnu. ketargumo:
Shellecha. pershu rabbotenu ze hashshole dagim min hayyam, veze shettirgem unkelos veshale nuna (chullin 63):
Kos veyanshof. hem tzaveaytash hatztzoakim ballayla, veyesh lahem lesatot keadam, veod acher dome lo shekkorin yybav:
Uleelle. haatidin leamer bainyan lematta.
Tittammau. kelomar bingiatam yesh tuma:
ohc: Uleelle tittammau. betorat kohanim pershu amro uleelle al haatidim leamer bainyan lematta. vekashe li, lamma amar "uleelle" betosefet vav, kevan sheen lo shayyachut din ze im ma shellemala mimmennu velo shellemala immo.

Veulay nitkavven litten haelyon kattachton, perush, shekkol min behema vechayya – ben temeim sheenam lo maale gera velo mafrise parsa shello nirshemu kan bakkatuv, uven tehorim shemmaalim gera umafrisim parsa veshosaat shesa shello nirshemu gam ken bakkatuv uremazam beamro "lechol habbehema", uchelal ze chozer lema sherasham befarashat simane behema, velaze amar "uleelle" beVav. kede shello tite litten kol haamur lemala, laze peret sheen devarav ella bivhema vechayya.
O yirtze lehasemich din tuma ledin achila haamur bapparasha shellefaneha vegomer, ma achila bechazzayit gam tuma bechazzayit.

Uvetorat kohanim heemidu hakkatuv shello ba ella letumat ever min hachay shel behema temea uvehema tehora, vedarshu tuma bechazzayit mippasuk acher, dichtiv (Vayikra 11:40) "vehaochel minnivlatah yechabbes begadav vetame ad haarev", veze leshonam: lo ba ella litten shiur lannogea velannose bechazzayit kemo haochel. veefshar lomar od sheramaz bismichut ze lomar sheim yalda kemin behema hassamuch lah, dino shave.

Veraiti lerabbi avraham ibben ezra zichrono livracha shekkatav shelledato nire shemmillat "elle" chozeret al kol hannizkarim lemala, vedacha daat haomer "elle lechol habbehema" vechulei. vaani omer sheyyoter haya lo shello lomar davar sheeno nishma velo yachlok al mekabbele tora, ki mi yishma lidvarav kan vaafillu lelamdam vehem hefech kabbalat torat moshe, uma gam bifshat hakkatuv sheafillu be rav zutar ken yavin bitchillat hahaskel, umimmi nedar et asher rau enav veyoter mehemma, uma kocho lachlok immahen gam belo hechreach, vaafillu im yihye hammenaggedo kayyotze bo, umikkol shekken gedolim mimmennu, vechol shekken vekal vachomer asher katannam ava mimmatnav, vetze ulemad ma sheamru haamoraim al gedolim shekkedamum (shabbat 112:) "im harishonim" vechulei. ulelammed al harav zichrono livracha zechut ulay shepperush ze lo ketavo ella lesibba yedua lo, venahag minhag shivim zekenim (Megila 9.) sheshshinnu bechamma mekomot, vegam laze Adonai yechapper baado.

rashi: Vechol hannose minnivlatam. kol makom shenneemra tumat massa, chamura mittumat magga, shehi teuna chibbus begadim (sifra):

Mibbaale yehuda. hi kiryat yearim, kemo shenneemar bihoshua (Yehoshua 15:9): "vetaar haggevul veala baala hi kiryat yearim", vechen bedivre hayyamim (divrei hayamim 1 13:6): "vayyaal david vechol yisrael baalata hi kiryat yearim". uvaal leshon 'mishor:
Vayyakam vayyelech david vegomer mibbaale yehuda. shenneesfu sham lehaalot mishsham et haaron vegomer:
Asher nikra shem shem. asher nikra lo laaron shem, umahu hashshem, shehaya shem Adonai tzevaot alav:
targum: Vekam vaazal david vechol ama di imeh mikirvaya midvet yehuda leasaka mittaman yat arona dayya deitkere shema shema dayya tzevaot dishchinte sharya el min keruvaya alohi:

rashi: Vehamechasse. chelev hamechasse et hakkerev:
Veze lachem hattame. kol tumot hallalu enan leissur achila ella letuma mammash — lihyot tame bemaggaan, veneesar leechol teruma vekadashim velikkanes bammikdash:
Hacholed. maveshateylea:
Vehatztzav. 115 sheddome litzfardea:
ohc: Veze lachem hattame. taam amro "veze", lefi ma sheppershu betorat kohanim bapparasha shellefaneha, shebba letumat ever min hachay, amar "veze" lehashevot lema shellefanav, sheggam hu medabber bedin tumat ever min hachay, shehaever hu shemmetamme velo habbasar happoresh, ben bishratzim ben bivhema vechayya.

Od nire ki vav haamura kan battechilla, lo lehasemich baa, ella lirmoz tosefet tuma bashsheretz, shehu tumat damo sheyyihye metamme kivsaro, ma sheen ken bivhema temea, kemaamar razal betorat kohanim (kan), ucheillu amar "veod tosefet tuma baze".

Veamro lachem darshu zichronam livracha (torat kohanim kan) shebba lemaet shello yachshir hazzeraim, dedavka letuma velo lehacheshirah, vehu amro lachem hu tame velo machshir. od yirtze lachem hu shehem temeim aval lo laggoyim, sheen haggoyim mekabbelim tuma kabbehemot.

Veyesh lachkor zot, ech lo mana hakkatuv hannachash shehu av hattuma lechol tumat hashsheratzim vedomehem? veulay shettumat hannachash hu benafsho velo begufo, uvemoto yishshaer hagguf rekam mikkol kaafar haaretz, ki en tuma deveka begufo letzad sheen bo velo kelum. vechayyotze baze timtza sheamru zichronam livracha (bava metzia 114:) goyim en metammeim beohel, veyisrael metammeim beohel, vehu mehattaam atzmo. vetumat hashsheratzim begufam yoter mibbenafsham, velaze yetammeu bemotam velo bechayyehem. ha lamadta ki hannachash tumato yoter mittumat hashsheratzim.

Leminehu. peshat "leminehu" yaggid ki yesh harebe mine tzav, vechol sheyyesh bo minim harebe o afillu min echad levad yomar hakkatuv "leminehu". ella shebbehaor veharotev (chullin 122:) tanya veze leshonam: "hattemeim" – lerabbot orotehen kivsaran, yachol afillu kullan? talmud lomar "elle", veha "elle" akkulehu ketiv? amar rav: "leminehu" hifsik, ad kan. vekashe, minnayin lerav lomar ki "leminehu" baa lehafesaka velo legufah lomar sheyyesh bo minim? venire ki rav eno machchish mashmaut hakkatuv, vechavvanato hi ki letzad sheyyesh lefanenu ribbuy shel "hattemeim" lerabbot orotehen, veamar hakkatuv samuch leribbuy ze miut dichtiv "elle", veim lo hayta tevat "leminehu" beeze derech nachalok otan shebba alehem haribbuy veotan shemmiet. umeamro "leminehu", hagam shebbaa legufah, toil gam ken lehaferid ben hammitrabbim betumat orotehen, kevan shehakkatuv gilla sheyyesh chalukka benehem leinyan tuma, hare ze mare ki "leminehu" ba gam ken lesammen hachalukka. uvaze nityashsheva kushyat hattosafot sham bedibbur hammatchil "leminehu" vechulei: tema kevan dehifsik bainyan, "elle" lamma li? ad kan. uledarkenu lo kashe. gam ledivre tanna dematnitin sham dimtamme orotehen mishshum deazel batar gishta, en lehakeshot alav "leminehu" lamma li, sheal kol panim itzterich "leminehu" legufah kannizkar.

rashi: Hen lo huva vegomer. sheillu huva, haya lachem lesharfah, kemo shenneemar (Vayikra 6), vechol chattat asher yuva middamah vegomer (fesachim 82):
Achal tochlu otah. haya lachem leachlah af al pi sheattem onnim:
Kaasher tzivveti. lachem bammincha:
Vayvarchem. birkat kohanim — yevarechcha, yaer, yissa (sota 38):
Vayyered. meal hammizbeach:
ohc: Vayyissa aharon vegomer. betorat kohanim parasha 29 amru: mikra mesoras, rauy lomar "vayyered measot" vegomer "vayyissa aharon" vegomer, shebbiridato nasa kappav vechulei. vetzarich ladaat lamma yedabber hakkatuv bederech ze velo bederech hayyashar. veulay ki biroto aharon shello yarda shechina, chashav ulay ki adayin chaser kapparato al maase haegel shebbeemtzauto hevi kelala al sone yisrael, velaze "vayyissa vegomer vayvarech" vegomer, uvaze yarad measot tashlume hachattat vechulei. veulay ki gam birkat yisrael, letzad shehi kapparat cheto shel aharon, tuchelal bichlal hachattat, ki gam lah yityaches shem chattat. veamro vayyered, ulay ki hu leshon yerida ki hukkar lo pechituto, letzad sheraa sheggamar measot hakkol velo yarda shechina. vetimtza sheamru zichronam livracha betorat kohanim parasha 19 shetztzaak aharon lifne moshe sheamar lo likrav lammizbeach uva lide busha vechulei, venichnas moshe immo uvikshu rachamim veyarda shechina.

rashi: Vechi yuttan mayim al zera. leachar shennitlash, sheim tomar yesh hechsher bimchubbar, en lecha zera shello huchshar (chullin 118):
Mayim al zera. ben mayim ben shear mashkin, ben hem al hazzera ben zera nofel letochan, hakkol nidrash betorat kohanim:
Venafal minnivlatam alav. af mishshennuggav min hammayim, shello hikpida tora ella lihyot alav shem ochel, umishsheyyarad lo hechsher kabbalat tuma paam achat, shuv eno neekar hemennu:
Sheretz haof. hem haddakkim hannemuchim harochashin al haaretz, kegon zevuvim utzerain veyattushin vachagavim:

ohc: Tedabber lemor. tzarich ladaat ma taam yedabber kan aharon leyisrael velo moshe haragil? veulay ki letzad sheamar lahem "lemi zahav hitparaku" vegomer, laze yetzav Adonai elav ki yedabber lahem lehavi kappara seir izzim, happe sheasar hu happe shehittir. uchevar katavnu bechamma mekomot divre razal ki hachet yafil haggenay bimkomo vehattikkun tzarich lihyot mechuvvan kenegdo. vehu amro tedabber lemor, perush, tedabber dibbur sheyyesh bo maala uzechut keneged dibbur shehaya bo hashepala asher para bo et haam.

Od nire, ki letzad sheala aharon bammaala hanniflaa hallaz mittoch kol yisrael bo bachar Adonai, laze amar elav moshe sheyyedabber leyisrael amirot rakkot, vehu amro lemor. vechen timtza sheamar ki hayyom Adonai nira alechem, perush, kol hammussag vechol haratzon eno ella letzad yisrael, keamro "alechem" velo "li". uchederech shemmatzinu sheamar moshe leyisrael, halo kol zeman shehayu yisrael nezufim lo dibber Adonai im moshe, ki chol hammussag eno ella letzad maalat yisrael.

rashi: Al teshakketzu. baachilatan, shehare ketiv nafshotechem veen shikkutz nefesh bemagga, vechen velo tetammeu baachilatam:
Venitmetem bam. im attem mittammein bahem baaretz, af ani metamme etchem baolam habba uvishivat mala (yoma 39):
ohc: Al teshakketzu vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma chazar od letzauot laze? verabbotenu zichronam livracha (betorat kohanim) amru lerabbot et sheppershu laaretz vechazru. uderasha zo emet ella sheenah tzericha, kevan sheppershu, vechi bishvil shechazru yihyu muttarim? veyesh leyashshev divrehem zichronam livracha. veulay shebba hakkatuv lehodia ki haochel mehashsheratzim tease nafsho atzmah sheretz, vehu amro al teshakketzu et nafshotechem, perush, lo taasu nafshotechem sheketz, uvamme? bechol hashsheretz hashshoretz al haaretz keshettochlu otah. velech na ree ma shekkatavnu befarashat bereshit beremez pasuk (Bereshit 1:26) "veyirdu vidgat hayyam" vegomer. vetimtza maamaram zichronam livracha (fesachim mat:) sheamru al amme haaretz, hem sheretz uvenotehem sheketz vegomer, vechol divrehem zichronam livracha beruach hakkodesh neemru vehem devarenu atzmam.

Veamro velo tittammeu bahem, ulay sheyyechavven lomar shetztzerichin yisrael lehizzaher leval yikkansu lefihem afillu behesseach haddaat, ki hahefresh shebben hashshogeg lammezid bimtziut ze keshogeg kemezid, ki hattiuv yaase maasehu benefesh adam afillu behesseach haddaat, ella sheyyishtanne happegam bemaase mezid taase nafsho sheketz uveshogeg titma nafsho vetittamtem, vehu amro velo tittammeu venitmetem bam. vetzarich haadam lizzaher betosefet zehirut uzerizut bechol davar asher yikkanes begeder safek shikkutz ze, uma gam bizmannim ellu shennizham haavir vehaaratzot kullan yachad veen lecha giddule karka sheen bahem mehashshikkutz, shomer nafsho yishmor et haddavar.

Vayyikchu vegomer asher tzivva moshe. amar asher tzivva moshe, yechavven el aharon gam ken shellakach et asher tzivvahu, veeno yotze mimmashmaut maase yisrael, shehagam shemmippi aharon neemru lahem haddevarim, aharon atzmo mippi moshe amaram, veillu amar hakkatuv "asher tzivva aharon" en bammashma ella lekichat yisrael velo lekichat aharon. od ulay shennitkavven beamro asher tzivva moshe ki letzad mitzvat moshe levad asu haddavar, hagam shello hayta hahavtacha harshuma bammaamar.

rashi: Bechuttonotam. shel metim; melammed shello nisrefu vigdehem ella nishmatam, kemin shene chutin shel esh nichnesu letoch chatmehem (sifra):

Hannotarim. min hammita, melammed sheaf alehen niknesa mita al avon haegel, hiv shenneemar (Devarim 9), uveaharon hitannaf Adonai meod lehashemido, veen hashemada ella chilluy banim, shenneemar (Amos 2), vaashmid piryo mimmaal, utefillato shel moshe bittela mechetza, shenneemar (Devarim 9), vaetpallel gam bead aharon baet hahi:
Kechu et hammincha. af al pi sheattem onnin vekadashim asurim leonen:
Et hammincha. zo minchat shemini uminchat nachshon (sifra):
Veichluha matztzot. ma tal? lefi shehi minchat tzibbur uminchat shaa veen kayyotze vah ledorot, hutzrach lefaresh bah din shear menachot (sham):
Bedabber sefatecha mesharim. al yede shechacham libbecha:
targum: Venirvezan chilyotay kad yemallun sifvatayich teritzata:

rashi: Ki shamtu habbakar. ki shematuhu habbakar venineuhu, vechen tirgem yonatan: "are meraguhi torayya", kemo shemmetargem (Devarim 19:5): "veniddecha yado vaggarzen", "vetitmerig yedeh befarzela":
targum: Vaato ad atar metaken veoshit uza yedeh baarona dayya vaachad beh are meragohi toraya:

rashi: Sheretz. bechol makom mashmao davar namuch sherochesh venad al haaretz:
ohc: Sheketz hem lachem. perush, uletzad ze sheketz yihyu lachem. vetaam amro vesheketz betosefet vav, yitbaer al derech amram bechulin (5.) en hakkadosh baruch hu mevi takkala vechulei, vechol shekken al yede tzaddikim atzman, vechatvu hattosafot (sham) ki davka beinyan issur achila genay hu latztzaddikim sheyyavo letoch gufan devar issur, perush vaafilu beshogeg, veze hu sheramaz kan beamro vesheketz yihyu lachem, perush lerabbot afilu beshogeg shello titkavvenu leachlam, af al pi chen yeshakketzu et hannefesh. od yirmoz ki hem yeshakketzuhu visabbevuhu leharim tolaim bemoto, vehu amro sheketz yihyu lachem, perush leatzmechem yaasu etchem sheketz.

rashi: Vaymalle chappo. hi kemitza (sham):
Millevad olat habboker. kol elle asha achar olat hattamid:

Yafrish. leshon akitza, 165 belaaz, "bemalmad habbakar" (Shoftim 3:31) targum: "befarash tore" (targum yonatan), uvaggemara (bava metzia 80.): denakit parsha, 106 belaaz. veyesh potrin: mafrisho min hachayyim:
targum: Veachrita hech chivya nachet uchechuremana defareach:

ohc: Veet haarnevet. taam zichron hammin bilshon nekeva, letzad shebbechinat hattuma lifamim tihye hannekeva lemala mizzachar veyihye hazzachar tafel lah, vetizzacher hannekeva mehattaam atzmo sheyyizzacher hazzachar tamid velo hannekeva, shehu hattaam ki hi haikkar. vetimtza sheamru bazzohar (pinchas 231:) besod yoteret hakkaved ki hannukeba notenet yoteret lazzachar, uchevar katavnu shekkol min hanneesar hi bechinat hakkelippa hammushlal mehachayyim vehattov.

rashi: Ki kemo shaar benafsho. shaar ze nakud chetzyo pattach vechetzyo kamatz vetaamo lematta, lechach hu poal velo shem davar; sheim haya shem davar haya kamatz vetaamo lemala kechol shaar shebbammikra. ufitrono: keillu shafach haochel hazze mera benafsho shel ra haayin ken hu shaar min leshon "hatteenim hashshoarim" (Yirmeyahu 29:17) hammarim:
targum: Metul deech tara rame hachen hu ram benafsheh achel veishte amar lach velibbeh nachil tzidach:

rashi: Veet chaze hattenufa. shel shalme tzibbur.

Tochlu bemakom tahor. vechi et harishonim achlu bemakom tame? ella harishonim shehem kadshe kodashim huzkeka achilatam bemakom kadosh, aval ellu en tzerichim toch hakkelaim aval tzerichim hem leachel toch machane yisrael shehu tahor millikkanes sham metzoraim; mikkan shekkadashim kallim neechalin bechol hair (sham 55):

Atta uvanecha uvenotecha. atta uvanecha bechelek aval benotecha lo vechelek, ella im tittenu lahem mattanot rashshaot hen leechol bechaze veshok, o eno ella af habbanot bechelek? talmud lomar ki chakcha vechak banecha nittenu — chok labbanim veen chok labbanot (sifra):
Vesheketz yihyu. leesor et eruvehen im yesh bahem benoten taam (sifra):
Mibbesaram. eno muzehar al hassenappirim veal haatzamot (sham):
Veet nivlatam teshakketzu. lerabbot yavchushin shessinnenan; yavchushin 922 109 (chullin 67):
Al arba. al arba raglayim:

Mimmaal leraglav. samuch letzavvaro yesh lo kemin shete raglayim levad arba raglav, uchesherotze lauf velikpotz min haaretz mitchazzek beotan shene cheraayim uforeach, veyesh harebe — keotan shekkorin lanegaveshatea — aval en anu vekiin bahen, shearbaa simane tohora neemru vahem arba raglayim vearba kenafayim vekarsulin — ellu cheraayim hakketuvim kan — uchenafav chofin et rubbo, vechol simanin hallalu metzuyim beotan shebbenotenu, aval yesh sheroshan aroch veyesh sheen lahem zanav, vetzarich sheyyehe shemo chagav, uvaze en anu yodim lehavedil benehen:
ohc: Asher lo cheraayim. kevar heerachti bechibburi al tur yore dea (siman pe) shehaikkar keferush Rashi baze shetztzarich sheyyihyu lo keraayim haaruchim semuchim letzavvaro. vehattoim lehattirah ki en min ze bannimtza, af ani hashivoti oto gam en metzuyim ella min echad mehaarbaa shehem shemona asher rasham Adonai battohora (chullin 65.), gam enam metzuyim lefanenu minim hattemeim sheen lahem hakkeraayim bederech ze, vehem harabbim, lema shekkadam lanu (chullin 63.) ki lo yimne hakkatuv ella hammuatim, vechan mana hattehorim im ken hattemeim hem hammerubbin, umeatta en reaya mimma sheen matzuy min ze lomar sheenennu baolam shehare yesh minim harebe vadday veenam metzuyim kol ikkar etzlenu. lachen kol yare vechared yira veyifchad leval yoshit yado lesheketz ze, veyimche besholche yad. vehinne miyyom shennishmeu devaray bammaarav ufershu mehem harabbim lo naga Adonai od bemakka zo velo niru ze yoter mishshetem esre shana, ki tora umaasim tovim kitris bifne happuranut.

rashi: Kerav el hammizbeach. shehaya aharon bosh veyare lageshet, amar lo moshe, lamma atta vosh? lechach nivcharta (sifra):
Et chattatcha. egel ben bakar:
Veet olatecha. haayil:
Korban haam. seir izzim veegel vecheves; kol makom shenneemar "egel" ben shana hu umikkan atta lamed (sham):
ohc: Vechapper baadcha uvead haam. mashma ki kapparat aharon nogaat gam laam. vehattaam hu letzad ki chet aharon – yisrael hayu lo sibba lachato, sheamru lo (Shemot 32:1) "kum ase lanu" vegomer, vechol od shello nitkapper aharon yeshno hachet leosehu velamsabbev osehu, veachar shennitkapper nitkapperu shenehem, laze amar lo "vechapper baadcha uvead haam".

rashi: Emet kene. veim lo timtza lilmod bechinnam lemod besachar, veal tomar: keshem shellamadti besachar, kach alammedenna besachar (bechorot 29.):
targum: Kusheta kene vela tezabben chachmeta umarduta uveyuna:

rashi: Dabberu el bene yisrael. et kullam hishva lihyot sheluchim bedibbur ze, lefi shehushvu baddemima vekibbelu alehem gezerat hammakom meahava:

Zot hachayya. leshon chayyim, lefi sheyyishorael devukim bammakom ureuyin lihyot chayyim, lefichach hivdilam min hattuma vegazar alehem mitzvot, velaummot lo asar kelum, mashal lerofe shennichnas levakker et hachole kulei kidita bemidrash rabbi tanchuma:

Zot hachayya. melammed shehaya moshe ochez bachayya umare otah leyishorael zot tochlu vezot lo tochlu (chullin 42), et ze tochlu vegomer (pasuk 9), af beshirtze hammayim achaz mikkol min vamin vehera lahem, vechen baof veet elle teshakketzu min haof (pasuk 13), vechen bashsheratzim veze lachem hattame (pasuk 29):
Zot hachayya … mikkol habbehema. melammed shehabbehema bichlal chayya (sifra; chullin 70):
ohc: El bene yisrael lemor. amar tevat lemor, yirtze ki mitzva zo hi bechinat hammaala vehakkavod lahem, lehishshamer middevarim hattemeim, ucheamram bazzohar (Vayikra Rabba 13:2) amar rabbi shimon bar yochay bappasuk (Chavakuk 3:6) "amad vaymoded eretz", madad Adonai et kol haummot velo matza umma shehi reuya vechulei, uferush tevat "lemor" kan hu al derech (yeshaya 3:10) "imru tzaddik" vegomer. od yirtze al ze hadderech "lemor zot" vegomer, perush, sheyyikchu beyadam kol min chayya veyomru lahem zot tochlu vezot lo tochlu, velo yaspik lomar lahem beal pe.

Zot hachayya vegomer. taam shemmechanne shem chayya behema, kevar katavti bechamma mekomot ki bechinat hara lo yityaches elav bechinat hachayyim, vehu amro zot hachayya perush sheyyesh bah bechina hannikret chayya, lishlol shear behemot sheen lahem kedushsha shehi bechinat hachayyim:

rashi: Pittecha. sheachalto beveto, sof shettekienna mippene habbusha:
Veshichatta devarecha hanneimim. channot shehechezakta vedibbarta lo devarim rakkim, hakkol ibbadta:
targum: Velachma daachelta metivat leh umechabbelat milach devasiman:

ohc: Ze haddavar vegomer. tzarich ladaat ma hu haddavar. verashi peresh al hakeravat aharon. veen ze peshat maamar hakkatuv sheamar "taasu". venire sheyyechavven lomar al hammaase shehizkir hakkatuv besamuch dichtiv "vayyikrevu kol haeda vayyaamdu lifne Adonai", dikdek hakkatuv lomar lifne Adonai velo amar "lifne ohel moed", gam lo haya tzarich lomar shehare amar besamuch "vayyikchu vegomer el pene ohel moed", ella yirtze lomar shehechinu atzmam beerech hashshelemut vehammusekol vehaarachat amidatam shehi lifne Adonai, uvechina zo hi hassagat tachlit hashshelemut, kemaamar david (Tehillim 16:8) "shivviti Adonai lenegdi tamid" ki baze lo yimmot mimino shehi hattora, ki en yeshivat haadam utenuotav vechulei kishivato vechulei lifne melech umikkol shekken lifne melech malche hammelachim. ucheshehiskil moshe bemaase ze amar lahem "ze haddavar asher tzivva Adonai taasu", perush, tzivva Adonai shettaasu oto, shettihyu tamid maarichim bedatechem ki attem omdim lifne Adonai, veyera alechem kevod Adonai. od yechavven bichlal amro lifne Adonai shello haya masach mavdil benam leven Adonai, kedichtiv (Yeshayahu 59:2) "avonotechem hayu mavdilim" vegomer, veze yaggid shehayu shelemim im Adonai, uchefi ze yeduyyak al nachon amro "ze" al maase haamur besamuch.

Achar shekkatavti ze, ba leyadi midrash chazal (Bamidbar Rabba 12:8), veze leshonam: "ze haddavar" – ma hu "ze haddavar"? al hammila, kema detema "ze haddavar asher mal yehoshua" (Yehoshua 5:4), ad kan. vedivre hammidrash setumim vachatumim, vechi beoto yom mal otam moshe, o beoto yom tzivva al hammila?

Achen hakkavvana hi al arlat libbam, shehu davar hammavdil ben yisrael uven avihem shebbashshamayim, gam marchik emato millibbam, vetzivva lamul arlat levavam uvaze yerae lahem kevod Adonai, vehem devarenu atzmam.

Shuv ba leyadi midrash acher (torat kohanim hacha) bayyalkut, veze leshonam: "ze haddavar" – amar lahem moshe leyisrael: oto yetzer hara taaviru millevavchem, vetihyu kullechem beyira achat uveetza achat lesharet lifne hammakom vechulei, vetihye avodatchem meyuchedet lefanav, dichtiv "umaltem et arlat levavchem" vegomer (Devarim 10:16), veim asitem ze – "veyera alechem kevod Adonai" ad kan, vehem devarenu atzmam.

rashi: Oved edom. levi haya, kemo shekkatuv bedivre hayyamim (divrei hayamim 1 15:18), "umin hashshoarim haya" (sham):
targum: Vela ava david leafnaa levateh yat arona dayya lekarta dedavid veafneh david levet oved edom gittaa:

rashi: Ki im yesh acharit. im ze meshammesh bilshon asher, kelomar: asher baavur ze yesh acharit tikva elecha:
targum: Metul deteheve lach acharita tavta vesakkuyach la nigmar:

rashi: Ki hayyom Adonai nira alechem. lehasherot shechinato vemaase yedechem, lechach karbanot hallalu bain chova leyom ze:

Vattetze esh. Rabbi eliezer omer lo metu vene aharon ella al yede shehoru halacha bifne moshe rabban, rabbi yishmael omer shetuye yayin nichnesu lammikdash, teda, sheachar mitatan hizhir hannotarim shello yikkansu shetuye yayin lammikdash, mashal lemelech shehaya lo ven bayit vechulei, kidita bevayyikra rabba:
ohc: Vayyamutu lifne Adonai. ulay sheyyirmoz taam mitatam, shehu lehafechid liro min hammishkan birotam et ellu shekkarvu lefanav metu. od yirmoz ki mitatam haya al ma shekkadam mehem laAdonai, al derech maamaram zichronam livracha (Vayikra Rabba 13:10) shemmitatam haya lema shekkadam "vayyechezu et haelohim" vegomer (Shemot 24:10), vehem hem atzile bene yisrael.

rashi: Af hi kechetef. pitom:
Uvogdim beadam tosif. merabba beyisrael bogdim laAdonai, veal haafikorsin medabber:
targum: Vehech metaref enaha chemana vetzaer avne shabbere:

rashi: Achad harekim. (targum:) "chad min serikayya":
targum: Vetav david levaracha yat enash beteh unefakat michal bat shaul lokodamut david vaamarat ma ityakar yoma den malka deyisrael deitgele yoma den leene amhat avdohi kema dechalitz umitgele chad min serikaya:

rashi: Hannetz. asheparevayr:
El tifrau. al tegaddelu sear, mikkan sheavel asur betisporet, aval attem al tearbevu simchato shel makom (moed katan 14):
Velo tamutu. ha im taasu tamutu (sifra):
Vaachechem kol bet yisrael. mikkan shetztzaratan shel talmide chachamim muttelet al hakkol lehitabbel bah (moed katan 28):
ohc: Rashechem al tifrau vegomer veal kol haeda vegomer. perush: im yaasu kemotchem, sheattem davka hu sheyyeshnam baazhara, aval al kol haeda yiktzof im yaasu chen, ella chayyavin likroa alehem. veulay sheshshafat bahem mishpat av bet din shechayyavin likroa alav kol yisrael (moed katan 22:). uma gam lema sheamar shehem gedolim mimmoshe veaharon chayyavim kol yisrael likroa alehem.

Veamro vaachechem vegomer yivku, lemitzva, veim lo bachu en alehem ketzef kemishpat hakkeria. vedikdek lomar asher saraf Adonai, yitbaer al derech amru zichronam livracha (shabbat 105:) shekkol habboche umitabbel al adam kasher mochalin lo kol avonotav velo yivke od, vehu ma sheramaz beamro "asher saraf" vegomer, perush, im yivku hasserefa en lahem ella ma shekkevar saraf mikkodem, lishlol shello tihye serefa acheret od. od yirtze beamro velo tamutu veal kol vegomer, perush ki beemtzaut mitat hatztzaddikim maggia ketzef lichlalut yisrael, ki chozek yisrael vechayyutam hem gedolehem hatztzaddikim, uvifrat kohane Adonai hammechapperim bead haam.

Zot torat habbehema vehaof. kol hakkatuv meyuttar. uvetorat kohanim amru (chullin 27:) ki va lomar mishpat shechitat haof bema shessidder haof ben habbehema uven haddagim shehem nefesh hachayya, lomar chetzyo behema vechetzyo dag, laze tzarich siman echad baof o rubbo. ulefi ze matzanu taam nachon shehutzrach hakkatuv lemaet haddagim min hashshechita, dichtiv (Bamidbar 11:22) "yeasef", ki minnayin yaale al haddaat shetztzericha, shehutzrach lemaet, ella letzad shehutzrach lichtov dege hayyam latet beno uven habbehema haof, chash letaut ki kavvanat hakkatuv hu shehishva hakkatuv haofot vehaddagim labbehema shekkullan tzerichin shechita shene simanim, laze amar baddagim asifa. uvaze tavin kavvanat Adonai bappasuk shello ba ella laof lehatzericho siman echad kannizkar.

Veim tomar, im ken lamma hutzrach lehazekir kan "nefesh hashshoretzet", shehem hachagavim? veyesh lomar shechash hakkatuv letaut mippasuk shemmiet shechita bedagim, dichtiv "yeasef" vegomer (Bamidbar 11:22), ki lo miet ella dagim velo chagavim, laze sidderam achar haddagim lomar sheenam tzerichin shechita kemishpat haddagim:
Chassalat parashat shemini

rashi: Ulehavdil. kede shettavdilu ben avoda kedosha limchullelet, ha lamadta sheim avad avodato fesula (sham):
Mimsach. mimmezeg, vehu shem davar kemo "mimkar" (Vayikra 25:14):
Lachkor mimsach. shechokrin uvodkin hechan mochrin yayin tov:
targum: Lehalen demavcharin al chamra veazlin umeakve bet mizga:

rashi: Shema atta veni vachacham veashsher badderech libbecha. meachar shettitchakkem tuchal lalechet bedarche libbecha, ki lev chacham lo yashshiacha laavera:
targum: Shema at beri veitchakkem vetaretz libbach learcha:

rashi: Kol asher en lo vegomer. ma tal? sheyyachol en li sheyyehe muttar ella hammaale simanin shello layyabbasha, hishshiran bammayim minnayin? tal kol asher en lo senappir vekaskeset bammayim, ha im hayu lo bammayim af al pi shehishshiran baaliyyato muttar (sifra):
Unekalloti od. lefanav, yoter mizzot shehakilloti beatzmi atta:
Immam ikkaveda. enam mevazzin oti, ella chashuv ani beenehem al zot:
targum: Vezaerna od mida vaehi makkich beene nafshi mibbechen veim amhata di at amart beenehon ehe yakir:

rashi: Lehavedil. lo bilvad hashshone, ella shettehe yodea umakkir uvaki bahen (sifra):
Ben hattame uven hattahor. tzarich lomar ben chamor lefara, vahalo chevar meforashim hem? ella ben temea lecha lithora lecha — ben nishchat chetzyo shel kane lenishchat rubbo:
Uven hachayya hanneechelet. tzarich lomar ben tzevi learod vahalo chevar meforashim hem? ella ben shennoldu vah simane terefa keshera lenoldu vah simane terefa pesula (sifra):
Benivlatah. velo vaatzamot vegidin velo vakkarnayim utelafayim velo vaor (sifra):
Al ishshe hachalavim. mikkan shehachalavim lematta bishat tenufa, veyishshuv hammikraot shello yachchishu ze et ze kevar perashti et shelashtan betzav et aharon:

Seir hachattat. seir musefe rosh chodesh; ushelosha seire chattaot karvu vo vayyom, seir izzim useir nachshon useir rosh chodesh, umikkullan lo nisraf ella ze; venechleku vaddavar chachme yishorael, yesh omrim mippene hattuma shennaga vo nisraf, veyesh omrim mippene aninut nisraf, lefi shehu kadshe dorot, aval bekadshe shaa samchu al moshe sheamar lahem bammincha veichluha matztzot (sifra; zevachim 101):
Darosh darosh. shete derishot: mippene ma nisraf ze? umippene ma neechlu ellu? kach hi betorat kohanim:
Al elazar veal itamar. bishvil kevodo shel aharon hafach panav keneged habbanim vechaas (sifra):
Lemor. amar lahem hashivuni al devaray (sham):
ohc: Darosh darash moshe vegomer. omer ani ki moshe lo hechlit bedato lehattiro baachila, veharaya mimma shello amar lahem dino kemo sheamar lahem bammincha (Vayikra 10:12) "kechu et hammincha" vegomer, sheim haya bedato bifshitut lehattir haya lo lomar "kechu et hachattat". ma tomar, sheamar din hammincha vechashav ki en hefresh benehem kol ikkar, ulerov peshitut shehaya lo haddavar lo hutzrach lomar? im ken lo haya lo lidrosh, ki minnayin nichnas lo hammechush lidrosh alav ma haya bo? ella vadday shello amar ella happashut etzlo shehi hammincha shehi kadshe shaa, umimmenna lisir nachshon useir izzim shehayu kadshe shaa, aval seir rosh chodesh shehu kadshe dorot adayin haya haddavar omed etzlo besafek, vehaya doresh bedato im yattirennu kemo chen o lo, vedarash alav ma haya bo. velaze kafal lomar darosh darash, achat lemishpato veachat leatzmo ma haya bo, "vehinne" vegomer, vayyiktzof al asher asu davar middatam, sheafillu hu adayin lo yada et asher yetzavve lahem asot. vahagam sheamar levassof "tochlu otah kaasher tzivveti", perush: yoter haya lachem ledammotah lammincha asher tzivviti leachlah velo lesarfah belo taam hefech ma shetztzivviti bammincha. uvetorat kohanim amru: "darosh darash" – mippene ma nisraf, umippene ma (lo) neechlu ellu? uveyishshuv hakkatuv haddevarim rechokim, ki achar hadderishot hu shenniglet hasserefa, veech yidrosh kodem lamma nisraf? veyesh leyashshev.

Hannotarim lemor. amro lemor, yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (Vayikra Rabba 93): "hannotarim" – amar rabbi pinchas: ulevay shello nishartem, ad kan. vehu amro "hannotarim lemor" – perush hannotarim lemor inyan acher, vehu divre rabbi pinchas. uvetorat kohanim amru: "lemor" – amar lahem: hashivuni al devaray, perush hirsham lahashivo shello yimmanu letzad reoto beketzef alehem. od yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 153) befasuk "tzon lavan hannotarot" shehu leshon pechitut, vehu amro hannotarim lemor keillu amar lemor hannotarim, perush keraam bemaamaro notarim, leshon pechitut.

rashi: Vayyaaseha kammishpat. hameforash beolat nedava bevayyikra:
Maddua lo achaltem et hachattat bimkom hakkodesh. vechi chutz lakkodesh achaluha, vahalo serafuha, uma hiv omer bimkom hakkodesh, ella amar lahem shemma chutz lakkelaim yatza venifsela:
Ki kodesh kodashim hiv. venifselet beyotze, vehem amru lo lav. amar lahem hoil uvimkom hakkodesh hayta, maddua lo achaltem otah:
Veotah natan lachem laset vegomer. shehakkohanim ochlim uvealim mitkapperim:
Laset et avon haeda. mikkan lamadnu shesseir rosh chodesh haya, shehu mechapper al avon tumat mikdash vekadashav, shechattat shemini vechattat nachshon lo lechappara bau:
Tannur vechirayim. kelim hammittaltelin hem, vehen shel cheres veyesh lahen tavech, veshofet al nekev hechalal et hakkedera, ushenehem pihem lemala:
Yuttatz. sheen lichle cheres tohora bitvila:
Utemeim yihyu lachem. shello tomar metzuvve ani lenattzam, talmud lomar utemeim yihyu lachem — im ratza lekayyeman betumatan rashshay:
Ach mayan uvor mikve mayim. hamechubbarim lakkarka en mekabbelin tuma, veod yesh lecha lilmod, yihye tahor — hattovel bahem mittumato:

Venogea benivlatam yitma. afillu hu betoch mayan uvor venogea betumatam yitma; shello tomar kal vachomer: im metaher et hattemeim mittumatam kal vachomer sheyyatztzil et hattahor millittamme lechach neemar venogea benivlatam yitma (nedarim 75):
Bechol atze veroshim. shemmetakkenim mehem kele zemer:
targum: Vedavid vechol bet yisrael meshabbechin kodam Adonai bechol ae birvavn uvechinarin uvinvalin uvetuppin uvirviin uvetzeltzelin:

rashi: Holech al gachon. ze nachash, uleshon gachon shechiyya, sheholech shach venofel al meav:
Kol holech. lehavi hashshilshulin veet haddome laddome:
Holech al arba. ze akrav:
Kol. lehavi et hachippushit, ashekarebavet belaaz, veet haddome laddome:
Marbe raglayim. ze naddal, sheretz sheyyesh lo raglayim merosho vead zenavo lechan ulechan, vekorin tzaynatepaydash (sifra):
Mecharker. merakked:
Efod bad. meil butz, 455 109, veyonatan tirgem: "kardot", vechen tirgem yonatan 'meilim detamar achot avshalom (Shmuel 2 13:18), "kardotin":
targum: Vedavid meshabbach bechol tekof kodam Adonai vedavid asir kardut devutz:

ohc: Vayyikrav aharon el hammizbeach. yirmoz ledivrehem zichronam livracha sheamru (yerushalmi makkot 2:6) shaalu lannevua: "chote ma ansho?" amra: "hannefesh hachotet hi tamut", uletzad rachame Adonai amar: "yavi karban", sheikkar maase hakkarban hi machshevet hammakriv, ki hu hachayyav bechol hammaase asher yease bakkarban hahu lizzavach ulehissaref al haishshim, vehayta lo machshava zo lechappara. vehu amro vayyikrav aharon el hammizbeach, perush, hu atzmo hechin lasum asham nafsho, vekarav lammizbeach, perush, lizvicha laishshim, veasa hashshechita bimkomo laegel letzad rachame Adonai shennitratztza lehavi chalifato.

Veraiti latet lev bainyan lefi ma shekkadam lanu (tanchuma, Shoftim) ki nishba Adonai lehaamid haolam uveruav bemishpat, vechol haomer hakkadosh baruch hu vatran yivvatteru bene meav (yerushalmi shekalim 85 hei), im ken im hannefesh hachotet mishpatah hi tamut kemaamar hannavi (Yechezkel 18:4), ech yavi karban veyippater? venire ki taam nachon yesh baddavar al pi hammishpat, ki keshehaadam chote en bechinato bechinat adam, al derech amram zichronam livracha (sota 3.) en adam over avera ella im ken nichnas bo ruach shetut, venaase behema, uveyom shechazar bitshuva ruach hi veenosh veala mimmadregat behema lemadregat adam. haim rauy hu lehamit adam ze tachat behema? laze yavi dugmat hachote shehu behema veyishtattef immah betzaar hachoshev ki rauy hu laasot bo mishpat ze, uchefi ze chelek ruach hammargish hu matztzil et haadam beheara zo, vehu ma sheamar hakkatuv (tehillim 36:7) "adam uvehema toshia Adonai", ki chelek habbehemi shebbaadam behitztarfuto im haadam shehi bechinat hahaskel nosha bo, perush letziddo, kede shello yeanesh vehu eno rauy leonesh, uvaze afillu bedin hakeravat hakkarban bead hachet hu al kav hammishpat, keamro (sham) "mishpatecha tehom rabba adam uvehema toshia Adonai":

Hattemeim. lattanna sheeno doresh tumeat orotehen mehattemeim" lema itzterich, amru zichronam livracha (torat kohanim, shemini, parasha 7) shebba lerabbot betzat hashsheretz sherakma. gam darshu (torat kohanim sham; meila 17.) sheyyitztarfu letumea dam bedam dam bevasar ben bemin echad ben bishne minim.

Vetzarich ladaat tevat elle ma ba lemaet ledarko. venire lefarshah al derech ma shekkatav harambam beferek 4 mehilchot avot hattumot, dam hashsheretz kivsaro umitztaref lechaadasha kol zeman shehu mechubbar livsaro, laze amar "elle" lemaet im perash haddam min hashsheretz lo yitztaref im habbasar.

rashi: Al hashshal. al hashshegaga, shehaya lo lidrosh kal vachomer, nosav nasa bayyarden, hu atzmo lo kol shekken:
targum: Utekef rugeza dayya beuza umechahi taman memra dayya al deishtele umit taman im arona dayay:

rashi: VaAdonai heniach lo. amar, hare nitkayyem (Devarim 12:10): "veheniach lachem mikkol oyvechem vegomer", ma ketiv acharav, "vehaya hammakom asher yivchar vegomer", meatta alenu livnot bet habbechira:
targum: Vahava kad yatev malka beveteh vayay aniach leh mischor sechor mikkol baale devavohi:

rashi: Lo yeachlu. lechayyev et hammaachilan liktannim, shekkach mashmao lo yehu neechalin al yadcha, o eno ella leasran bahanaa? tal lo tochlum — baachila asurin bahanaa muttarin; kol of shenneemar bo leminah, lemino, leminehu, yesh beoto hammin sheen domin ze laze lo vemarehem velo vishmotam vechullan min echad:

ohc: Veet haayya leminah. (haayya) haamura kan kolel harebe minin shekkullam min ayya, vetimtza sheamru rabbotenu zichronam livracha (chullin 63:) ki 120 mine ofot hayu yeduim lahem shekkullam min ayya, veefshar sheyyihyu od kahenna, vechen bemino shel orev yimmatzu kamma vechamma hagam sheenam domin ushemam meshunne kesinunit levana (torat kohanim; chullin sav.) shehi min orev.

rashi: Uvisde yetomim. beleket shichcha ufea harauy lahem:
targum: La tashne techuma demin alma uvechelka deyatme la teol:

rashi: Bammayim yuva. veaf leachar tevilato tame hu litruma:
Ad haerev. veachakka vetaher behaarev hashshemesh:
Al kappav. kegon kelev vedov vechatul:
Temeim hem lachem. lemagga:

El agala chadasha. taa bedavar sheafilu tinokot shel bet rabban yodin oto, "ki avodat hakkodesh alehem bakkatef yissau" (Bamidbar 7:9), ulefi sheamar (tehillim 119:54): "zemirot hayu li chukkecha bevet meguray", neenash lavo lide kach, umet uzza al yado, lefichach kesheheviu mibbet oved, heviu bakkatef, shenneemar (divrei hayamim 1 15:12-13): "vayyomer lahem attem rashe haavot lalviyyim hitkaddeshu attem vaachechem vehaalitem et aron vegomer. ki lemibbarishona lo attem paratz Adonai elohenu banu ki lo derashnuhu kammishpat":
targum: Vaachitu yat arona dayya beeglata chadta unetalohi mibbet avinadav di begivata veuza veachyo vene avinadav madberin yat eglata chadta:

rashi: Al yekanne libbecha bachattaim. behatzelachatam, lihyot rasha kemotam (berachot 7:):
targum: La nitan libbach bechatae ela bidchalta delaha kol yoma:

rashi: Mibbesaram lo tochelu. en li ella ellu, shear behema temea sheen lah shum siman tohora minnayin? amarta kal vachomer, uma ellu sheyyesh bahen ketzat simane tohora asurot vechulei (sifra):
Mibbesaram. al besaram beazhara velo al atzamot vegidin vekarnayim utelafayim (sham):

Uvenivlatam lo tiggau. yachol yehu yisrael muzharim al magga nevela, tal emor el hakkohanim vegomer — kohanim muzharin veen yisrael muzharin — kal vachomer meatta: uma tumat met chamura lo hizhir bah ella kohanim, tumat nevela kalla lo chol shekken, uma talmud lomar lo tiggau? baregel (sham; rosh hashshana 16):
Im aron haelohim. hare ze mikra katzar, vehem baim im aron haelohim:
targum: Unetalohi mibbet avinadav di begivata im arona dayya veachyo azel kodam arona:

rashi: Vayvarech Adonai vegomer. ishto ushemone kalloteha yaldu shishsha banim becheres echad, shenneemar (divrei hayamim 1 26:5): "feultay hashshemini", "shishshim ushenayim leoved edom":
targum: Ushera arona dayya bevet oved edom gittaa telata yarchin uvarich Adonai yat oved edom veyat kol beteh:

rashi: Ki ani Adonai hammaale etchem. al menat shettekabbelu mitzvotay heeleti etchem; davar acher, ki ani Adonai hammaale etchem: bechullan ketiv "hotzeti" vechan ketiv "hammaale", tana deve Rabbi yishmael illemale lo heeleti et yishorael mimmitzrayim ella bishvil sheen mittammein bishratzim kishar ummot dayyam, umaalyuta hi gabbayhu, zehu leshon maala:
ohc: Ki ani Adonai hammaale vegomer. noten hochacha leenehem ki Adonai yishmor otam mehikkashel beavon hahu, ki hu heela uverar nafshot yisrael shehayu netunim biklippat mitzrayim, kemo shepperashnu bimkomo, veim yizzonu mehattiuv hinne hinnam chozrim leshakkea nafsham bakkelippa kevarishona, vaasher al ken kesheyyitkaddeshu hu yigmor baadam leshamram. od yirtze lomar ki en hakkadosh baruch hu kivyachol yachol leyached shemo ulehashrot shechinato ella al hammushelal mimmin hara hahu, velaze lo yiched shemo alehem ad shehotziam meeretz mitzrayim, veim lo yishmeru atzmam mehattiuv hinne hinnam chozrim lihyot kemot shehayu kodem alotam meeretz mitzrayim, veyihyu mushelalim mibbechina zo.

rashi: Tinshemet. hi 133 shaveraytz, vedoma leachbar happorachat ballayla, vetinshemet haamura bashsheratzim hi doma lah veen lah enayim, vekorin lah 120:
Veeshpar. echad mishshishsha befar (fesachim lo 2):
Ashisha echat. garba dechamra (sham):
targum: Ufaleg lechol ama lechol hamona deyisrael migvar vead itteta ligvar geritzta dilchem chada ufelug chad umanata chada vaazal kol ama gevar leveteh:

rashi: Vayyavo moshe veaharon vegomer. lamma nichnesu? matzati befarashat milluim, bevarayta hannosefet al torat kohanim shellanu, lamma nichnas moshe im aharon? lelammedo al maase hakketoret, o lo nichnas ella ledavar acher? hareni dan, yerida uvia teuna veracha, ma yerida meen avoda af bia meen avoda, ha lamadta lamma nichnas moshe im aharon lelammedo al maase hakketoret; davar acher kevan sheraa aharon shekkarvu kol hakkarbanot venaasu chol hammaasim velo yarda shechina leyisrael, haya mitztaer veomer, yodea ani shekkaas hakkabba alay uvishvili lo yarda shechina leyisrael, amar lo lemoshe, moshe achi, kach ashita li shennichnasti venitbayyashti? miyyad nichnas moshe immo uvikkeshu rachamim veyarda shechina leyisrael (sifra):

Vayyetzu vayvarchu et haam. amru vihi noam Adonai elohenu alenu, yehi ratzon shettishre shechina vemaase yedechem; lefi shekkol shivat yeme hammilluim sheheemido moshe lammishkan veshimmesh bo uferko vechol yom lo sharta vo shechina, vehayu yisrael nichlamim veomrim lemoshe, moshe rabbenu, kol hattorach shettarachnu shettishre shechina venenu veneda shennitkapper lanu avon haegel, lechach amar lahem ze haddavar asher tzivva Adonai taasu veyera alechem kevod Adonai — aharon achi keday vechashuv mimmenni, sheal yede karbenotav vaavodato tishre shechina vachem vetedu shehammakom bachar bo:
ohc: Vayyetzu vayvarachu vegomer. ulay ki chen nitztauu binvua. o beracha zo bimkom tefilla hayta kede shettishre shechina. vahagam shekkevar bercham aharon, tovim hashshenayim letzad hasekamat shete madregot harmuzim bishte bechinot haachim, kehunna uleviyya, shehem chesed ugevura:

targum: Kavel min avuch den yaldach vela teshut metul desevat imach:
La teheve beilen daasitun bevisra uveilen deravyan chamra:
Vaamar malka lenatan neviya chaze chean di ana yatev beveta di metalel bechiore arzaya vaarona dayya share bemashkena vego yeriata:
Aul libbach lemarduta veudenach lememri didiata:
Medutz nedutz avuy detzadika uman demolid chakkima nechede veh:
Veaytiu yat arona dayya vaakimu yateh beatreh bego mashkena di feras leh david veasik david alavan kodam Adonai venichsat kudeshin:
Beudne desichla la temalel metul dishyet lesikkula demilaych:
Ant beshivta machayat leh venafsheh mefaltat min shiol:
Vahava kad netalu natle arona dayya shitta zugin uneches tor uppatim:
La timna min talya marduta metul dein machayat leh beshivta la maet:
Vahava arona dayya ata lekarta dedavid umichal bat shaul istechiat min charakka vachazat yat malka david meraked umeshabbach kodam Adonai uvesarat alohi belibbah:
Vedavid vechol bet yisrael maskin yat arona dayya beyabbava uvekal shofara:
Utekef ledavid al ditra Adonai tirata beuza ukera leatra hahu atra demit beh uza ad yoma haden:
Vaamar natan lemalka kol di velibbach ezel aved are memra dayya besaadach:
Yechede avuch veimach vetedutz tuledatach:
Metul di ferokhon takif vehu nedun yat dinhon imach:
Vaamar david lemichal kodam Adonai di itree vi meavuch umikkol beteh lefakada yati lemeheve malka al ama dayya al yisrael veshabbechit kodam Adonai:
Hav li beri libbach veaynach tinteran archatay:
Udechil david min kodam Adonai beyoma hahu vaamar echden yeul levati arona dayay:
Veshetze david milasaka alata venichsat kudeshaya uvarich yat ama bishma dayya tzevaot:
Beri im chakkim libbach af ana chade ana velibbi:
Veitchava lemalka david lememar barich Adonai yat bet oved edom veyat kol dileh bedil arona dayya vaazal david veassek yat arona dayya mibbet oved edom lekarta dedavid bechedva:

bart: Kos. shel zechuchit:
Shennifgam rubbo tahor. dachashiv shever keli:
Nifgam bo shalosh berubbo. shehashshalosh pegimot omdot berubbo shel kos velo vemiuto:
Tahor. af al pi sheeno mefazzer et rov hammayim:
Im mefazzer hu et rov hammayim tahor. aval bemiut, tame. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Bevaatz. bivdil:
Rabbi yose omer bevaatz tame. dehakkol holech achar hammaamid, vachashiv kichle mattachot. veen halacha kerabbi yose:

Hassocher. vehitu ze et ze. echad min haummanin sheshshelacho baal habbayit liskor et chaverav vehita otam, kegon sheamar lo baal habbayit liskor kol echad bearbaa dinarim leyom, vehalach hu usecharam bishlosha, en lahem alav ella taromet, deha savur vekavil bishlosha, ella sheyyecholim lomar lo let lecha al timna tov mibbealav. perush acher, hitu ze et ze, shechazru bahem velo ratzu lalechet laasot melachto shel baal habbayit kemo shessachru immo, o baal habbayit chazar bo kegon sheamar lahem i efshi bachem, babboker kodem sheyyelchu etzel hammelacha:
Veet hakkarar. beresh garsinan, kelomar baal hakkaron:
Piryafrin. etzim meshuppin laasot appiryon:
Chalilim. lemet o lechatan:
Hammishra. mayim sheshshorin bahen pishtan:
Mekom sheen sham adam. shehu eno motze poalim liskor, vehappishtan aved:
Socher alehem. bene adam keshiur secharan. aval lo beyoter mishshiur secharan:
O matan. omer sheyyitten lahem zuz yater, veeno noten ella ma shehitna mittechilla:
Metamme vegadim. kol zeman shello ferash, dichtiv (Vayikra 15) vehannogea bivsar hazzav yechabbes begadav, alma shehu metamme begadim bishat maggao bazzav:
Veen begadim hannogim bezav metammein begadim. lefi shehazzav av hattuma vehabbegadim hannogim bo naasim rishon veen metammein begadim acherim, sheen adam vechelim mekabbelim tuma ella meav hattuma:

Shehabbegadim hannosin et hazzav metammein adam. kegon mishkav umoshav shel zav metammein adam, lefi shehen naasim av hattuma kazzav atzmo, dichtiv (sham) vechol hannogea bechol asher yihye tachtav yitma ad haarev:
Veen adam hannose et hazzav metamme adam. vaafillu veshaa shehu nose oto kodem sheferash, sheeno ella rishon lattuma, veen rishon metamme adam:
Ben shomer chinnam uven shomer sachar yishshava. ka salka [dateh] yishshava shello pasha veyippater:

Rabbi eliezer omer ze veze yishshava vechulei. kelomar, af ani shamati merabbotay kerabbi meir deze veze yishshava, aval tameah ani al ze veal ze heach niftarin bishvua, deshomer sachar heach patur bishvua delo pasha, ha belo feshia nammi chayyav, sheen ze ones ella dumeya digneva vaaveda shehen kerovim lifshia uleones. veod, i shello bimkom midron nishbera, afillu shomer chinnam hechi matze mishtava shello pasha, ha vadday peshia hi. verabbi meir savar, shevua zo lo min haddin hi ella takkanat chachamim hi, sheim i atta poter hammaavir chavit mimmakom lemakom min hattashlumin al yede shevua zo, en lecha adam sheyyaavir chavit lachavero mimmakom lemakom lefichach tiknu sheyyishshava shello vechavvana shevartiha veyippater:

Lo yeshev adam lifne hassappar. vaafillu bechol, umishshum devae lemitne lo yetze hachayyat bemachato vechulei‏ shemma yishkach veyetze dedami ligzera delo yeshev adam lifne hassappar samuch lammincha, shemma yishkach velo yitpallel, mishshum hachi tana lehu hacha, veayde dezuteran millayhu pasik vetane lehu beresha, vahadar mefaresh mille deshabbat umaarich bahen:

Samuch lammincha. mincha gedola mishshesh shaot umechetza ulemala, vesamuch lammincha hayenu mittechillat shaa sheviit, veaf al pi sheonatah merubba, gezera shemma yishshaver hazzug shel sapparim achar shehitchil lehistapper, vetaavor onat hattefilla kodem sheyyetakkenennu veyashlim hattisporet:
Velo yikkanes lammerchatz. samuch lammincha, shemma yitallef:
Velo labburseki. mekom ibbud haorot, dilma chaze peseda vekilkul baorot im lo yeniem mimmekomam vitakkenem, veyimshoch bimlachto ad shettaavor onat hattefilla:
Velo leechol. afillu bisuda ketanna, shemma yimshoch basseuda:
Velo ladin. afillu bigmar din, shekkevar shamu teanot baale dinin velo nishar alehen ella lifsok haddin bilvad, dilma chazu tama veyisteru ma shehayu rotzim lifsok, vechozer lihyot techillat haddin:

Veim hitchilu. bechad mikkol hane deamrinan, en mafsikin, ella yigmor veachar kach yitpallel, vehu sheyyesh shehut bayyom ligmor kodem sheyyaavor zeman hattefilla. vehatechalat hattisporet mishsheyyaniach maaforet shel sapparim ben birkav, hu hassudar shennoten hammitgalleach al birkav kede shello yippol hassear al begadav. vehatechalat hammerchatz mishsheyyifshot habbeged hassamuch livsaro, veit dimfarshe mishsheyyasir hassudar shealav shehu rishon lehafeshatat begadav. vehatechalat habburseki mishsheyyachgor ben ketefav et batte zerootav kede lehitassek baorot. vehatechalat achila mishsheyyittol yadav. vehatechalat haddin mishsheyyitattefu haddayyanin betallitan lashevet laddin beema uveyira, veim hayu meuttafim veyoshvim baddin uva lifnehem din acher samuch lammincha, haveya hatechalat oto haddin mishsheppatchu baale haddin betaanotam:
Mafsikin likriat shema. milleta achariti nakat, vehachi kaamar, chaverim haoskim battora, mafsikim toratan likriat shema, dizmannah kavua, dichtiv (Devarim 6) uveshachbecha uvekumecha:

Veen mafsikin lattefilla. sheen lah zeman kavua deorayta. velo shanu ella kegon rabbi shimon ben yochay vachaverav shettoratan ummanutan, aval anu hoil veanu mafsikin toratenu leummanutenu kol shekken shennafsik litfilla:
Shenayim temeim bemet echad tame tumat shiva. kulla matnitin mefaresh la veazel:
Adam hannogea bemet, tame tumat shiva. dichtiv (Bamidbar 19) hannogea bemet lechol nefesh adam vetame shivat yamim, lefi shehu naase av hattuma, shehammet avi avot hattuma hu:

Adam hannogea bo tame tumat arev. dichtiv (sham) vehannefesh hannogaat titma ad haarev, lefi shehu naase velad hattuma, vechol velad hattuma en bo ella tumat erev. aval chachamim gazru al hannogea bitme met beodo mechubbar lammet sheyyihye tame shiva:
En madlikin beshemen serefa beyom tov. tama dematnitin dilel kaamar, ma taam tenan velo beshemen serefa, lefi sheen madlikin beshemen serefa beyom tov, sheen sorfin kadashim beyom tov:
En madlikin beitran. pesolet shel zefet, verecho ra beyoter, umihu nimshach achar happetila yoter min hazzefet mippene shehu rach, hilkach ilmale mippene kevod shabbat hayu madlikin bo:
Shumshemin. kach shemo baaravi, vehu zera dak matok, uveeretz yisrael mimmennu harebe:
Shemen tzenonot. shemen hayyotze mizzera tzenon:
Pakkuot. delaat midbarit:

Neft. min zefet hu, velavan verecho ra. vahalacha kachachamim shemmadlikin bechol hashshemanim, chutz meotan happesulot shennimnu leel bematnitin, vechutz mishshemen afarsemon veneft lavan, shekkol echad mishshene ellu hashshemanim hu af vesoref, vechayshinan shemma yannichennu veyetze. veod yesh taam acher leesor beshemen afarsemon, gezera shemma yistappek mimmennu mippene chashivuto, vekayma lan hannoten shemen bener chayyav mishshum mavir, vehammistappek mimmennu chayyav mishshum mechabbe:

Hashshoel et happara veshaal bealeha immah. im hayu bealim shel para etzel hashshoel laasot melachto, ben shehayu sheulim etzlo o sechurim, ben beotah melacha shel para ben laasot melacha acheret, im meta fatur:
Shenneemar im bealav immo lo yeshallem. vehachi mashma, im baal hashshor immo, im hashshoel, shehu shaul o sachur lo laasot melachto beshaa shehishil lo parato, lo yeshallem:
Aval shaal et happara kulei. im haya immo bishat onasim velo haya immo bishat sheila, chayyav, delo have sheila babbealim leaftore ella im ken haya immo bishat sheila:
Shenneemar bealav en immo shallem yeshallem. vehachi ashmuinan kera, bealav en immo bishat sheila, af al pi shehaya immo bishat shevira umita, shallem yeshallem:

Hassocher et happoalim. eno rashshay lechofan. veaf al gav ditfa lehu aagrayhu mishshear poalim, lo matze amar lehu hay ditfay lechu aagraychu addata dimkaddemitu umechashshechitu bahaday, deamre leh hay ditfat lan addata deavdinan lach uvadta shappirta:
Bimtika. liftan:

Hakkol keminhag hammedina. hakkol laatoye duchete dinhige foalim lemechal ulemishte betzafra beveto shel baal habbayit kodem sheyyetzu limlachtam, dei amar lehu baal habbayit kaddimu laavidtaychu bassade veavi lachem maachalchem sham, amre leh, lo, ella atta nochal babbayit kodem shennetze hassade, keminhag hammedina:

Maase berabbi yochanan ben matya. baggemara meforash dachasure michassera vehachi katane, veim pasak lahem mezonot, mezonot ribba lahem, kelomar, kevan delo hava tzarich leatnuye shehare mimminhag hammedina hayu ochlim, veatne bahadayhu litten lahem mezonot, mezone yetere kaamar, umaase nammi berabbi yochanan vechulei:
Bishato. beet malchuto. demelech vehedyot hava:

Shehem bene avraham yitzchak veyaakov. useudato shel avraham gedola mishshel shelomo, deillu avraham shelosha farim lishlosha anashim, uvisudat shelomo yehuda veyisrael rabbim kechol asher al sefat hayyam:
Ad shello yatchilu vammelacha. deen kan ella devarim. deillu misheyyatchilu lo tuchal lachazor:
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer vechulei. vahalacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel:
Habbayit tame. kol ma shebbetocho tame, shehare maahil al hassear hamechubbar lammet:
Etzem sheyyesh alav kazzayit basar. haetzem necheshav yad labbasar:
Techuvim bide adam. shello haya habbasar mechubbar laetzem meikkaro, ella adam techavo lesham kederech shettochavim habbasar bashshappud:
Tefach al tefach al rum tefach. daf shehu rachav tefach al tefach vegavoah min haaretz tefach, umaahil al kazzayit min hammet veal hakkelim, mevi et hattuma al hakkelim:

Merubba. sheim haya rachbo pachot mittefach af al pi shehaya arko shene tefachim, lo amrinan sim ma sheyyater al arko verachbo verabbeehu, lehachi katane merubba, shetztzarich sheyyehe verachbo tefach uvearko tefach:
Ketzad. kelomar ketzad chotzetz bifne hattuma:
Biv shehu kamur. chafira bakkarka umekora, vehayenu kamur, vesham yordim shefachim shebbabbayit umishsham yotzim lirshut harabbim:
Yesh bo foteach tefach. dehaynu tefach al tefach berum tefach babbiv atzmo:
Uvitziato. befetach habbiv shemmimmennu yotzin hammayim lirshut harabbim:
Tuma vetocho. kazzayit min hammet betoch habbiv. dechazzayit min hammet pitcho betefach:
Habbayit tahor. shehattuma yotza derech petach habbiv hayyotze lirshut harabbim. vehayenu dekatane chotzetz bifne hattuma:
Tuma vabbayit ma shebbetoch habbiv tahor. deen derech tuma lehachenisah derech petach habbiv, shedderech hattuma lehotziah derech petach habbayit velo lehachenisah labbiv:

Veen bitziato poteach tefach tuma vetocho habbayit tame. detuma ola min habbiv labbayit kevan sheen lah derech latzet derech petach habbiv hayyotze lirshut harabbim, dechol pachut mittefach en hattuma yotza:

En bo foteach tefach veen bitziato foteach tefach. lechinnam nakat veen bitziato poteach tefach, dechevan deen bo poteach tefach, al yetziato lo chayshinan, dichillu en sham chalal kelal dame vahare habbiv nechshav kekarka habbayit, veamru chachamim kol asher baohel yitma, lerabbot karkaito shel bayit kamohu ad hattehom:
Echad chor shechararuhu mayim. hay poteach tefach shemmevi et hattuma, lo shena im naasa hachor hazze al yede mayim o shennikkevuhu sheratzim:
O sheachalattu mallachat. leshon eretz melecha. kemin afar lavan dome lemelach umitakkel venofel venaasa chor meelav:
Mirbach shel avanim. avanim gedolot aruchot usedurot zo al zo, ufeamim shehaachat sedura al gabbe shetayim vehattachtonot meforadot zo mizzo veyesh sham ohel tefach:
Sevar shel korot. korot aruchot zo al zo veomdot levinyan, ufeamim sheyyesh benehen ohel tefach:
Kol ohel sheeno asuy bide adam eno ohel. deyalef ohel ohel mimmishkan, ma lehallan bide adam af kan bide adam:
Bishkifim. targum seife hasselaim, shekife chefa:

Uvislaim. binkike hasselaim. ushekife unekike hasselaim echad hen, ella shezze naasa al yede matar veze naasa meelav. veaf al gav delo naasu vide adam mode vahem rabbi yehuda, delo yalef gezera shava deohel ohel mimmishkan ella lefoteach tefach bilvad, aval beyoter mittefach, kegon melo egrof, amrinan besukka [resh] perek hayyashen demode rabbi yehuda sheafillu naasa meelav mevi et hattuma. vechen bishkifim uvislaim. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Kol hametammein beohel. haamurim leel beresh perek 2:
Shennechleku. shiurehen lachatzain:
Vehichnisan. keshehen mechullakim:
Letoch habbayit. dehaynu letoch ohel echad:
Rabbi dosa ven harekinas metaher. desavar lo mitztarfe lechashshiur:

Hannogea bechishne chatzae zetim min hannevela. patach beohel umefaresh binvela, lomar lach dechi hechi disvira leh lerabbi dosa sheen mitztarfin letumat ohel, hachi nammi sevira leh deen mitztarfin letumat magga umassa, ben bemet ben binvela:

Hannogea bechachatzi zayit umaahil al kachatzi zayit. shehammaahil al hammet, tame keillu haya im hammet baohel. uvaggemara beferek haor veharotev moke hanach maahil deresha vetuma retzutza, sheen ben hattuma uven haohel poteach tefach, umishshum hachi chachamim metammein, dechullah negia hi. vesefa deamar aval hannogea bechachatzi zayit vedavar acher maahil alav vechulei‏ demodu rabbanan detahor, mayre chesheyyesh poteach tefach ben hattuma uven haohel, divha modu rabbanan deen mitztarfin, dingia veohel shene shemot hen, vechol shehen mishshene shemot en mitztarfin. verabbi dosa savar daafillu vetuma retzutza en mitztarfin, velo afillu lemagga umassa. veen halacha kerabbi dosa:

Amar rabbi meir af bezo rabbi dosa metaher vachachamim metammein. rabbi meir paleg attanna kamma deamar dichsheyyesh poteach tefach ben hattuma veohel modu rabbanan detahor veen mitztarfin, veamar ihu deaf bezo felige rabbanan al rabbi dosa veamre dingia veohel chad shema hu, hilkach mitztarfin lechashshiur umetammein. veen halacha kerabbi meir:
Chutz min hammagga im hammassa. kegon shennaga bachatzi zayit vehesit chatzi zayit:
Vehammassa im haohel. shehesit chatzi zayit veheehil al chatzi zayit:
Mishshem echad. kegon magga umagga, massa umassa, ohel veohel:

Migdal shehu omed baavir. migdal etz sheyyesh lo defanot vehaddefanot atzman yesh chalal beavyan kegon chorin hamefullashin petuchim lifnim velachutz ella sheen bahen poteach tefach, uregilim lehatzenia sham mechatin vetzinnoriyyot vechelim ketannim:
Shehu omed baavir. tachat avir hashshamayim, kegon dekae vechatzer:
Tuma vetocho. bachalal hammigdal atzmo:
Kelim shebbeavyo. boovi chalal haddefanot:

Mechetza lemechetza. mechetzyo shel ovi migdal velifnim kilfanim, mechetzyo velachutz kelachutz. ben shehattuma bammigdal vechelim beavyo, ben shehattuma beavyo vechelim bammigdal. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Tuma vetocho. betoch hammigdal:
Habbayit tame. af al pi sheddaltotav megufot. kedimfaresh taama shedderech hattuma latzet mishsham labbayit:

Tuma vabbayit ma shebbetoch hammigdal tahor. vehu sheddaltotav megufot. dei petuchot, lo gara mechallon shebben shene battim. vetaama dema shebbetoch hammigdal tahor, sheen derech lattuma shebbabbayit lehachenisah bammigdal:
Im yesh sham poteach tefach. ben shule hammigdal laaretz o ben dofen hammigdal lakkotel o ben gag hammigdal letikrat habbayit:
Temeim. mechamat tuma shebbabbayit. aval en sham tefach have migdal kelavud veen tumat habbayit nichneset sham:

Tuma sham habbayit tame. im hayta tuma ben shule hammigdal lekarka habbayit, o ben gag hammigdal legag habbayit, o ben dafnot hammigdal lechatle habbayit, af al pi sheen benehen poteach tefach, habbayit tame, sheen hammigdal matztzil al hattuma shettachtav betoch habbayit shello tetamme kol asher babbayit:
Mippene hashev aveda labbealim. shello yibbatel mimmelachto veyochal:
Amru, poalim ochlim bahalichatan meumman leumman. kesheggamru shura zo veholchim lehatechil bachavertah. veaf al gav dehahi shata lav sheat melacha hi, nicha leh levaal habbayit beha:
Vachamor keshehi foraket. bahalichatah ochelet mimmasseoy sheal gabbah ad shettehe foreket:
Neta revai. perot shel ilan bashshana harviit, sheenan neechalin ella birushalayim, o pode otan umaale haddamim lirushalayim:
Nitparsu iggulav. iggule devela shennitpardu vesachar poalim lechabberan, o chaviyyot shenniftechu vesachar poalim lesatman:
Hare ellu lo yochlu. shekkevar nigmeru melachtam vehukbeu lemaaser vahare hen tevel:
Metamme veloven. shehaish metamme veloven kidita bezavim (perek 2 mishna 1):
Umitattef kaanashim. shello yilbash simlat ishsha:
Aval lo nissa. mishshum dehabba alav keva al hazzachar (yevamot perek 8 mishna 6):
Veimmo yoshevet alav bedam tohar kaanashim. kezachar, velivsof arbaim leledato damah tame:
Veeno nizzon im habbanot. binchasim muatim, keditnan (bava batra perek 9) bizman shehannechasim muatim habbanot dochin oto etzel habbanim:
Vechayyav bechol hammitzvot kaanashim. afillu mitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama shehannashim peturot, hu chayyav:
Beyad beno. hammashil shillechah lashshoel beyad beno veavdo ushelucho shel mashil:

O veyad beno veavdo ushelucho shel shoel. patur im meta vadderech. vehay shelucho shel shoel ikka demoke lah (bava kamma daf 104) bischiro ulekito sheddar beveto. aval lo asao shaliach beedim, dei ikka edim deshaliach shavye, chayyav hashshoel beanseha mishshemmesarah lo. veikka deamre afillu asao shaliach beedim eno mitchayyev al yado boonasim, dehachi kaamar leh, eynash mehemana hu, i bait lishdure veyadeh shedar:

Amar lo hashshoel shallechah li vechulei. beyad avdecha, chayyav. hay avdecha beeved ivri kaamar, deillu eved kenaani yad eved keyad rabbo vehave keillu lo yatzat mershut mashil ucheillu hammashil atzmo holichah lo, ufatur hashshoel im neensa vadderech:

Vechen beshaa shemmachazirah. im shillach hashshoel beyad beno veavdo o shelucho o beyad beno veavdo ushelucho shel mashil, lo yatzat mershuto shel shoel ad shettavo leyad hammashil, veim neensa vadderech, chayyav. amar lo hammashil shallechah li, o sheamar hashshoel hareni meshallechah vechulei, veamar lo hammashil shelach, ushelachah veneensa vadderech, patur. umatnitin davka keshemmachazirah betoch yeme sheilatah shehu chayyav beanseha. aval im hechzirah leachar yeme sheilatah, din shomer sachar yesh lo [hoil venehena mimmenna] velo din shoel, veim shillechah beyad beno veavdo o shelucho, ben shello ben shel mashil, veneensa vadderech, patur:
Shehakkelim shelosha. kegon kelim shennagu bemet vechelim bakkelim veod kelim shelishim bashsheniyyim, kullan temein:
Vehaadam shenayim. kegon adam bemet veadam sheni beze haadam shennitma bammet. aval adam hashshelishi bashsheni, tahor:
Shehu vaemtza. kegon kelim veadam vechelim, deharvii ben adam ben kelim mittamme tumat erev, kidshaminan mimmatnitin dilel:
Kotzetz. littol maot velo yochal:
Al yede atzmo. bishvil atzmo:
Mippene sheyyesh bahen daat. veyaddee veka machale:
Velo toanin immo. al hachamor.
Velo magbihim. alav masseoy al ketefo, demechaze kimsayyeo leholich hammasseoy beshabbat:
Ella chede sheyyaggia lemakom karov. kelomar sheyyehe hammakom sherotze leholicho karov sheyyuchal lehaggia sham mibbeod yom:
Uvet hillel mattirin. kede sheyyetze mippetach beto mibbeod yom:
Shenniddakdeku. shennishchaku. leshon veshachakta mimmenna hadek (Shemot 30):
Rabbi shimon metaher. mikkol tuma. veenam metammein lo vemagga velo vemassa velo veohel:
Vachachamim metammein. bishlashtan, deha ikka rova:
Evar min hachay shennechelak lishnayim tahor. vaafillu chazar vechibbero. deen chibbure adam chibbur:
Nittal chatzaim. shennittal min hachay lachatzaim velo nittal mimmennu evar shalem keechad, delo hava beh shiura meolam. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Kol hayyotze min haetz en madlikin bo. laasot mimmennu petila:

Ella fishtan. deikkere etz, kedichtiv (Yehoshua 2) vattitmenem befishte haetz, vaafillu hachi madlikin biftila sheosin mimmennu. vekanbos vetzemer gefen lav yotzin min haetz ninhu, ella mine zera hen, hilkach madlikin bahen. ufishtan nammi min zera hu, velo itzterich leribbuye ella mishshum deikkere etz, dichtiv vattitmenem befishte haetz:
Eno mittamme tumat ohalim. im asa mehen ohel vehammet tachtav, have kishar bayit veeno taun hazzaa utevila, deohel atzmo eno mekabbel tuma, ella kelim shettachtav:

Ella fishtan. shehaohel atzmo tame, kedichtiv (Bamidbar 19) vehizza al haohel, veyalfinan ohel ohel mimmishkan, dichtiv beh (Shemot 40) vayyifros et haohel al hammishkan, velo haya beohel mishkan davar yotze min haetz ella fishtan, kedichtiv (sham 26) eser yeriot shesh mashzar:
Shekkippelah. kederech sheggodlin happetilot:
Hivhavah. al hashshalhevet kede shettihye mechorechet vetadlik yafe. uveveged sheyyesh bo shalosh etzbaot al shalosh etzbaot metzumtzamot askinan:
Temea hi. dekippulah eno mevattelah mittorat beged, hoil velo hivhavah:
Tehora hi. dekippulah bittelah mittorat beged vehi keillu en bah shalosh al shalosh, vechol pachot mishshalosh al shalosh tahor milletamme, lo bingaim velo betumat met:

Veen madlikin bah. beyom tov shechal lihyot beerev shabbat askinan, deshayyach beh issur muktze, veen massikin beshivre kelim shennishberu bo bayyom dahavu lehu nolad, aval bechelim massikin deha chazu letiltul, udechulle alma it lehu hammadlik tzarich lehadelik rov hayyotze min happetila chutz lanner kodem sheyyesallek yadav, hilkach tama derabbi eliezer deamar en madlikin bah, kasavar kippulah lo bittelah mittorat keli, vechi adlik bah pureta kevan deshalosh al shalosh metzumtzamot hayu hava leh shever keli, defachot mishshalosh al shalosh lav keli hu, vechi madlik bayyadayim lehashelim rov hayyotze nimtza shemmadlik beshever keli shennishbar beyom tov, dechi amrinan massikin bechelim, davka shello yigga bo achar shennifchat. verabbi akiva omer madlikin bah, kasavar kippulah bittelah mittorat keli mechi kippelah meerev yom tov, deen godlin petila beyom tov, venimtza sheen kan shever keli shennishbar beyom tov, hilkach madlikin bah. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:
Reviit dam. sheyyatza kullo leachar mita:
Ureviit dam tevusa. sheyyatza miktzat reviit mechayyim umiktzat leachar mita. ulekamman beferek 3‏ [mishna Adonai] mefaresh la:

Tevusa. leshon mitboseset bedamayich (Yechezkel 16). ureviit dam sheyyatza chullo leachar mita, deorayta, dichtiv bemet benefesh. aval dam tevusa eno ella midderabbanan. vetane deorayta vetane derabbanan:
Mimmet echad. velo mishshene metim. kasavre rabbanan yesh em lammasoret veal kol nafshot met lo yavo (Vayikra 21), nafshot ketiv chaser:

Rabbi akiva omer mishshene metim. chatzi reviit mimmet ze vachatzi reviit mimmet acher, metamme beohel. desavar yesh em lammikra, nafshot met, mashma shete nefashot veshiur echad, middelo kaamar nafshot metim. veen halacha kerabbi akiva:

Rabbi akiva omer kol shehu. keshem shettame baatzamot rov minyan verov binyan af al pi sheen bo rova hakkav shehu shiur hameyuchad laatzamot, kach tame vedam hakkatan sheyyatza chullo af al pi sheen bo reviit shehu shiur hameyuchad laddam:
Vachachamim omrim reviit. im amarta baatzamot shebbeyadua shekkullo lefanecha, tomar baddam sheani omer nishtayyera mimmenna tippa kol shehi velo yatza chullo. vahalacha kachachamim:
Kazzayit rimma. shennolda bivsar hammet:
