Metamme chivsaro. derimma hayyotza min hammet afillu chayya, kivsar hammet hi chashuva, mishshum deadam mechayyim ikkere rimma, dichtiv (Iyov 28) af ki enosh rimma:
Vachachamim metaharim. vahalacha kachachamim:
Efer serufim. adam shennisraf venaasa efer velo nitarev bo meefer etzim,
Shiuro berova. kav efer, metamme:
Vachachamim metaharim. vahalacha kachachamim:

Afar kevarot. afar shemmeorav bo dam velecha shel met. umelo tarvad veod tame, lefi shei efshar limlo tarvad veod shello yihye vo melo tarvad rakav deamar leel shehu tame. vehachi nammi mayre vemet shennikbar arom bearon shel shayish sheen afar acher meorav bo:
Rabbi shimon metaher. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Eno chibbur letuma. veim heehil al miktzato eno cheillu heehil al kullo. vechen leinyan magga:
Nishpach baavir. betoch habbayit:
Im haya mekomo ketafres. im hammakom shennishpach bo haddam haya midron:
Veheehil. adam al miktzato:
Tahor. diktafres eno chibbur:
Haya ashboren. makom hamechunnas kemo vetoch gumma:
O shekkarash. haddam vaafillu ketafres, have chibbur vetame, vaafillu heehil al ketzato:
Nishpach al haaskuppa. kemin itztabba shellifne petach habbayit:
Vehi ketafres ben mibbifnim. shemmeshappea letzad penim:
Ben mibbachutz. shemmeshappea letzad chutz:
Vehabbayit maahil. al miktzato: tahor. kol ma shebbabbayit mittumat ohel, af al pi shessofo shel dam lered lifnim, deeno chibbur:

Chutz min hashshinnayim vehassear vehatztzipporen. dichtiv (Bamidbar 19) veetzem, ma etzem shennivra immo veen gizo machalif, af kol shennivra immo veen gizo machalif. yatzu shinnayim shello nivreu immo, yatzu sear vetzipporen sheggizan machalif:
Bishat ledatan. bishat sakkana mezumman puranuta:
Uvachalla uvehadlakat hanner. lefi shetztzarche habbayit hen vehi metzuya babbayit, teluyin bah:
Veellu mehalachot. en polin veen korin leor hanner ditnan bematnitin:

Baaliyyat chananya ven chizkiyya. shebbikkeshu chachamim lignoz sefer yechezkel, sheddevarav nirim kesotrim divre tora, kegon kol nevela uterefa min haof umin habbehema lo yochlu hakkohanim (Yechezkel 44), kohanim hu delo achli ha yisrael achli, uchegon vechen taase beshiva bachodesh (sham 45), hechan nirmaz karban ze battora. venitman chananya ben chizkiyya baaliyya veyashav sham uferesh sefer yechezkel:

Ushemona asar devarim gazru vo vayyom. shennechleku bet shammay uvet hillel veamdu leminyan verabbu bet shammay ufasku kemotam, kedichtiv (Shemot 23) achare rabbim lehattot. vechullehu shemona asar devarim maytu lehu baggemara, veellu hen: haochel ochel shehu rishon lattuma o sheni lattuma, gazru sheyyehe naase gufo sheni lattuma, ufosel et hatteruma bemaggao, sheshsheni posel bitruma, hare ellu shete gezerot, ochel ochel rishon, veochel sheni. vehashshote mashkin temeim naase gam ken sheni lattuma ufosel et hatteruma, hare shalosh. vetama degazur behane, dezimnin deachel ochalin temeim veshade mashkin ditruma befumeh beod shehoochalim temeim befiv, ufasel lehu, vezimnin deshate mashkin temeim uveodan befiv shade ochalin ditruma befiv, ufasel lehu. vegazru al habba rosho verubbo leachar shettaval mittumato bo bayyom, bemayim sheuvim, veal tahor gamur shennaflu al rosho shelosha luggin mayim sheuvin, hare chamesh gezerot. vetama degazur tuma al hane letamme adam, lefi shehayu tovlin beme mearot seruchin vehayu notnin alehem achar kach mayim sheuvin lehaavir sirchon hammayim, hitchilu vaasaum keva lomar lo me hammearot metaharim ella hammayim sheuvim metaharim, amdu vegazru alehem tuma, dilma ate levittule torat mikve vetavle bishuvim. vehaggezera hashshishshit, sheyyihyu hassefarim shel kitve hakkodesh poslim et hatteruma bemagga, shebbitchilla hayu matzniin ochalin ditruma etzel sefer tora, amre hay kodesh vehay kodesh, kevan dechazu deka atu sefarim lide peseda, shehaachbarim hammetzuyin etzel hoochalin hayu mafsidin et hassefarim, gazru sheyyihyu hassefarim, dehaynu tora neviim uchetuvim, bemaggaan poslin et hatteruma. vehaggezera hashsheviit, gazru al setam yadayim shepposlot et hatteruma, mippene shehayyadayim askaniyyot hen venogot bivsaro bimkom hattinnofet, ugenay latteruma im yigga bah beyadayim mezohamot vehi nimeset al ochleha. vehaggezera hashsheminit, hoochalin shennitmeu bemashkin sheotan hammashkin nitmeu mechamat yadayim shennagu bahen kodem netila, gazru al hammashkin sheyyetammeu et hoochalin, shekkol haddevarim happoslim et hatteruma metammein et hammashkin lihyot techilla, gezera mishshum mashkin habbaim mechamat sheretz, deashkechan bahen shehen rishonim middeorayta. vehay degazur bechol tumat mashkin lihyot techilla velo gazur nammi boochalin gezera mishshum [ochalin] habbaim mechamat sheretz, hayenu tama deachmur rabbanan bemashkin mishshum daalulim lekabbel tuma, sheenan tzerichin tikkun hechsher lahavian lide kabbalat tuma kemo hoochalin shetztzerichin netinat mayim lehacheshiran lekabbel tuma. vehaggezera hatteshiit, kelim shennitmeu bemashkin shennitmeu hammashkim besheretz, af al pi shehem rishon lattuma deorayta en yecholin letamme adam vechelim, sheen adam vechelim mekabbelin tuma ella meav hattuma, velo mimmashkin shennitmeu besheretz shehem rishonim, verabbanan gazur alayhu sheyyetammeu kelim, gezera mishshum mashke dezav vezava, shehen rukko umeme raglav, shehen av hattuma umetammein kelim middeorayta. vehaggezera haasirit, sheyyehu benot kutiyyim niddot mearisatan, kelomar miyyom shennolda, shettinoket bat, yoma metammea benidda, vechutim let lehu midrash ze, vechi chazyan lo mafreshi lehu, hilkach gazur behu rabbanan. vehaggezera haachat esre, sheyyehu kol hammittaltelin meviin et hattuma beovi hammardea, vehu malmad habbakar, veyesh behekkefo tefach aval en beavyo tefach, veaf al pi shemmin hattora en ohel pachot mittefach, gazru rabbanan al kol hammittaltelim sheyyesh behekefan tefach sheim roshan echad heehil al hammet veroshan echad al hakkelim meviin lahem tumat ohel, gezera attu mi sheyyesh beavyo tefach shemmevi et hattuma min hattora. vehaggezera hashshetem esre, habbotzer anavim ledarchan baggat, hammashke hayyotze mehen bishat betzira machshiran lekabbel tuma, veaf al pi sheholech leibbud velo nicha leh, gezera shemma yivtzor bekuppot mezuppafot, deaz nicha leh bammashke hayyotze mehen shehare eno holech leibbud, umachshir min hattora. vehaggezera hashshelosh esre, sheyyihyu giddule teruma teruma, vaafillu bedavar shezzaro kale kegon tevua vekitnit, gezera mishshum teruma temea beyad kohen sheasura baachila uva lezarah, vegazur shettehe bishmah harishon vahare hi teruma temea, dechayshinan dilma mashhe la ad zeman zeria veate lemechla betuma. vehaggezera haarba esre, mi shehechshich lo badderech noten kiso lenachri, velo yetaltelennu pachot pachot mearba ammot. vehaggezera hachamesh esre vehashshesh esre, en polin veen korin leor hanner ditnan bematnitin. vehaggezera hashsheva esre, gazru al pittan shel ovde kochavim, veal shamnan veal yenan veal benotehen, vechullehu gezera chada hi, kidamrinan gazru al pittan mishshum shamnan veal shamnan mishshum yenan veal yenan mishshum benotehen veal benotehen mishshum davar acher, kelomar mishshum avodat kochavim. vehaggezera hashshemone esre, gazru al tinok oved kochavim sheyyehe metamme beziva, kede shello yehe tinok yisrael ragil etzlo bemishkav zachur:
Hassocher et haummanin. bekabbelanut, kach melacha bechach vechach maot:
Vechazru vahem. leachar sheasu miktzatah:

Yadan al hattachtona. im hukeru poalim veeno motze mi sheyyigmerenna besachar shehaya maggia leellu al heatid laasot, meakkev missecharam mimma sheasu, kol ma sheyyitztarech lehotzi ad shettiggamer melachto besachar sheppasak im ellu. veim huzelu poalim veyimtza mi sheyyigmerenna befachot, yashumu lahem ma sheasu veyitten lahem ma sheppasak, asu chetzyah yitten lahem chatzi secharan, veen yecholim lomar lo hare poalim acherim tachtenu ligmor melachtecha veten lanu kol secharenu chutz mimma sheyyittelu ellu:
Veim baal habbayit chozer bo yado al hattachtona. yitten lahem lefi ma sheasu, veim huzela melechet happoalim al karcho yitten lahem kemo sheppasak, chutz mimma shetztzarich lehotzi behashelamatah:

Kol hameshanne yado al hattachtona. kegon natan tzemer latztzabba letzavo adom utzevao shachor, im hashshevach yoter al hayetzia en noten lo secharo shalem ella deme yetziat etzim vesammanim, veim hayyetzia yetera al hashshevach noten lo et hashshevach:

Vechol hachozer bo yado al hattachtona. laatoye hammocher sade lachavero beelef zuz venatan lo mehem matayim zuz vechazar bo hammocher, yad lokeach al haelyona, ratza omer lo ten li meotay, ratza omer lo ten li karka keneged meotay. veim lokeach chozer bo, yad mocher al haelyona, ratza omer lo helach meotecha, ratza omer lo helach karka keneged meotecha:
Perek ze rubbo kechullo shanuy vattosefta. vezo hi nuschat haggera mivvilna zatzal (im havesapevat), im perush.
Hammashil omer sheula meta. veatta chayyav beanseha:
Eni yodea. shemma sechura meta, ufatur ani min hoonasim:

Chayyav. ha matnitin lo efshar leokma kemashmaah, deha kayama lan mane li beyadcha vehalla omer eni yodea yishshava shevuat hesset sheeno yodea ufatur. lehachi mokminan lah baggemara kegon sheyyesh esek shevua deorayta benehem, kegon deamar leh shete farot masarti lecha, chad yoma bishila vechad yoma bischirut, umetu tarvayhu beiddan sheila. veamar leh shoel, chada in, beiddan sheila meta, vachada lo yadana. vehave leh mode bemiktzat vechayyav shevua, umittoch sheeno yachol lishshava meshallem. vedamya lehach mane li beyadcha veamar leh hiach chamshin yadana vechamshin lo yadana, have leh mechuyyav shevua veeno yachol lishshava umittoch sheeno yachol lishshava meshallem:

Yishshava hassocher shessechura meta. ha nammi lo efshar leokma kemashmaah, deha kayma lan taano chittim vehoda lo bisorim patur af middeme seorim, vehacha nammi ma shehoda lo lo taano uma shettaano lo hoda lo, uma makom yesh lishvua zo. lehachi mokminan baggemara, dishvua zo al yede gilgul, deamar leh ishtabba li shevuat hashshomrim sheatta chayyav lishshava li dichdarkah meta, umiggo demishtava dichdarkah meta mishtava nammi al yede gilgul dischura meta:
Yachaloku. matnitin sumechos hi deamar mamon hammuttal besafek cholkim. veenah halacha. ella halacha hammotzi mechavero alav haraya, veyishshava hannitba sheeno yodea ufatur:

Ellu metammein beohel, hammet vechazzayit min hammet. vei kashya, kazzayit min hammet metamme met atzmo lo chol shekken, ha milleta mittartza baggemara benazir [daf 59], lo nitzrecha ella lenefel shello nitkashsheru evarav begidin sheen bo chazzayit basar:
Netzel. besar hammet shennimmoach venaasa chemin lecha serucha:
Melo tarvad. kaf. veshiuro melo chafnayim:

Rakav. gufo shel met keshekkala lachuto venaasa chemin afar. veen melo tarvad rakav metamme ella min hammet shennikbar arom bearon shel shayish umechusse bechissuy shel shayish, ad shennoda bevadday sheen bo taarovet rikkavon shel beged o shel etz o afar acher. aval met shennikbar bichsuto o vearon shel etz o veafar, en lo rakav. vechen met shennikbar chasar evar en lo rakav:
Hashshidra vehaggulgolet. af al pi sheen bahem basar metammeim beohel, lefi shetztzurat adam nikkeret bahem, dichtiv beetzem adam, etzem shennikkar bo shehu shel adam:
Evar min hammet veevar min hachay. dichtiv (Bamidbar 19) bachalal cherev o vemet, evar shehivdilattu hacherev min hachay hare hu chemet:
Verova atzamot. rova hakkav shel atzamot:
Merov hamminyan o merov habbinyan. rabbotay fershu, shehen muatin mihyot bahen rov minyan verov binyan, deaf al pi sheen bahen lo rov hamminyan velo rov habbinyan metammein:

Verov binyano verov minyano. rov binyan hagguf, o rov minyan haatzamot af al pi sheeno rov binyan hagguf, metammein, veaf al pi sheen bahen rova. verov binyano, kegon hashshokayim vehayerechayim vehatztzelaot [vehashshidra]. verov minyano, kegon rashe etzbeot hayyadayim veharaglayim vechayyotze bahen, uvilvad sheyyihyu mea esrim vachamishsha evarim, metammeim:
Tevat hammigdal. regilim laasot tevot ketannot betoch migdal shel etz, kede lehatzenia bahem kelim voochalin umashkim:
Sheyyesh bah poteach tefach. sheyyesh bachalalah poteach tefach, delo haveya tuma temuna:
Veen bitziatah. bechor pitchah en bo tefach:
Tuma vetochah habbayit tame. veaf al pi sheppitchah katan. kedimfaresh taama, mippene shedderech tuma latzet, al karchach sofah latzet derech petach ze, lefichach metamme miyyad derech yetziatah:
Ma shebbetochah tahor. hoil veen bitziatah poteach tefach eno mevi et hattuma:
Veen derech tuma likkanes. sheen sofo lehachenis lah met:
Verabbi yose metaher. deshemma en sofo latzet derech petach ze sheyyehe vah shiur tuma, shehare yachol lehotziah lachatzaim o lesarfah bimkomah. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Kol haummanin. kabbelanim shemmekabbelim alehem laasot melacha bevattehem:
Shomre sachar. lehitchayyev bigneva vaaveda. divhahi hanaa detafas leh aagra have aleh shomer sachar:
Vechullan sheamru tol et shellecha. shekkevar gemartiv veeni meakkevo letafso al sechari, umeachar shettolichennu tavi maot, hare hu mishsham vaelach shomer chinnam:
Shemor li veeshmor lach. shemor li hayyom veeshmor lecha lemachar. aval shemor li atta ze, vaani shomer lecha ze haacher bimkomo, vehakkol bizman echad, zo shemira bivalim hi ufatur:
Hannach lefanay shomer chinnam. aval hannach lefanecha, o hannach setam, afillu shomer chinnam lo have. delo kavil aleh netiruta kelal:

Kesefer tora. kelomar vesefer tora nammi have kemo bikkurim ledin ze devaal chov notel bechovo veishsha bichtubbatah. perush acher, vesefer tora, umuttar liknot bahem sefer tora. veaf al gav ditna behema temea, itztarich lemitne sefer tora, delo tema kol hanne nehi delo chazu laachila chazu lesachar sheyyavo lide achila, aval sefer tora delo chaze lesachar sheyyavo lide achila, lefi sheen mochrin sefer tora, ema lo, ka mashma lan:

En notnim ella lechaver betova. en hakkohen yachol litten habbikkurim ella lechohen chaver sheochel chullav betohora, venoten otam lo betova betorat chesed unedava, veeno rashshay liknot bahen davar, veaf lo littenan lechohen sheeno chaver, dechevan sheen osin bahen avoda chayshinan dilma lo mizdaher behu:
Notnim otam leanshe mishmar. uven chaver uven sheeno chaver mechallekin otam benehem:
Kekadshe mikdash. kishar kadshe mizbeach. veaf al pi sheen osin bahem avoda, hoil umachnisim otam laazara mizdahare vehu velo atu lemechlinhu vetuma. vahalacha kachachamim:
Leabbedan. meabbed haorot:
Mattirin im hashshamesh. beod shehachamma al haaretz kodem shettishka:

Etzem kasseora. metamme vemagga uvemassa. dichtiv (Bamidbar 19) veal hannogea vegomer, vesham lo neemar beetzem adam. lelammed al etzem kasseora shemmetamme vemagga af al pi sheeno nikkar shehu shel adam. aval beohel, adam ki yamut beohel ketiv. uveetzem leinyan tumat ohel, bainan sheyyehe nikkar shehu shel adam, shehare bemakom acher hu omer beetzem adam:

Veeretz haammim. kol chutz laaretz kare eretz haammim. vehacha mayre vegush afar shebba michutz laaretz shehu metamme vemagga uvemassa veeno metamme veohel. aval hannichnas leeretz haammim, afillu lo naga velo nasa, kegon shehaya rochev al sus, tame, deal avira shel eretz haammim nammi gazru:
Bet happeras. sade shennecherash bah kever venishberu atzmot hammet venadoshu vaafar oto sade. uferas milleshon perusa. halo paros laraev lachmecha (yeshaya noach):
Kamma hu chesron bashshidra. velo yetamme veohel, ella vemagga uvemassa:
Kimlo makdeach. melo rochav hannekev shennokvin bemartzea:
Kede sheyyinnatel min hachay veyamut. veshiaru chachamim bechesron kesela:
Bakkatan shel rofim. bemartzea katan sheharofim potchim bo hannegaim:
Baggadol shel lishka. veshiaru chachamim shehu nekev kefunedyon:
Afillu vedinar. afillu hi shava dinar:
Lo yochal poel yater al secharo. deamar kera kenafshecha, kischiruto, shealav hu moser et nafsho laalot bakkevesh velittalot bailan:
Melammedin. omrim lo derech etza hogenet. vetanna kamma paleg achachamim veamar en melammedin. vahalacha kachachamim:
Vihe sotem et happetach. sheyyimmanu millesachro:

Ketzad arbaa. kelim hannogim bemet, avi avot kemoto. veadam bakkelim, av hattuma. vechelim baadam, nammi av hattuma kaadam atzmo, dichtiv (Bamidbar lo) vechibbastem bigdechem bayyom hashshevii utehartem, ha lamadta shekkol adam hattame tumat shiva metamme hakkelim tumat shiva:

Harvii ben adam ben kelim. naasim rishonim. vehu haddin divchetzad shelosha hava matze lemitne adam hannogea bemet vechelim baadam temeim tumat shiva, hashshelishi ben adam ben kelim temein tumat erev. ella missefa arbaa temein bemet shaminan la, daafillu adam bechelim shennagu bemet vechelim baadam katane tumat shiva, kol shekken adam bammet atzmo vechelim beadam deikka tumat shiva:
Shappud. kemin ammud shel mattechet takua beemtza haohel uverosho koshrin haohel:

En haohel mitchashshev. lefi sheen haohel metamme hashshappud, lefichach eno necheshav beminyan seder hattumot, ella kol hammunnach beohel hammet kenogea bammet atzmo, veen kan ella arbaa. i nammi, afillu en hashshappud betoch haohel ella shennogea baohel mibbachutz afillu hachi en haohel mitchashshev beminyan seder mishnatenu. vehachi muchach lekamman beferek sagos ave bemishnat tavlayot shel etz:

Haleveni ad sheyyavo veni. dechevan sheyyesh lo, shappir dame. delo gazur rabbanan ella kesheen lo. vaafillu en lo ella sea achat, love aleha kamma chorin, dechol chada vachada amrinan zo tehe tachteha, shehare enah kenuya lammalve uveyad hallove lemachrah uleachlah, ucheshelove kol achat veachat love behetter:
Vechen haya hillel omer lo talve ishsha. veen halacha chehillel. ella halacha kachachamim sheomrim lovin setam uforin setam:
Siggefah. inna otah baraav o shehoshivah bakkayitz bachamma uvachoref batztzinna:
Alta lerashe tzukin. shettekafattu vealta lerashe harim gevohim:

Matne shomer chinnam lihyot patur mishshevua. vehay lav matne al ma shekkatuv battora hu, ella sheomer lo i efshi lihyot shomer lecha ella bechach. veshomer lo nachit lashshemira ad demashich labbehema, vehay ki mashach kevar peresh al menat sheen lo alav shevua, velo shibed nafsheh lered betorat shomrin ella lemiktzat, ulema sheyyarad yarad:
En shorin deyo. sammanim sheosim mehem deyo lichtiva:
Vesammanim. letzeva:

Vecharshinim. maachal behema, uregilim lishrot otan bemayim techilla, vekorin lahem baaravi 335, uvelaaz 406, vesavre bet shammay adam muzhar al shevitat kelim kemo al shevitat behemto, vehayenu tama deen notnin unin, vehayenu tama deen porsin metzudot. vener haddolek beshabbat ukedera sheal gabbe kira demodu behu bet shammay, [bidmafkar] afkore lechelim veshuv eno metzuvve al shevitatan:

Uvet hillel mattirin. mishshennatan hammayim mibbeod yom, af al pi shehen nishshorin veholchin beshabbat, desavre al shevitat behema adam muzhar, deit bah tzaar baale chayyim, aval lo al shevitat kelim:

Meatterim et habbikkurim chutz mishshivat hamminim. makkifim et hassallim shebbikkurim bahem mipperot naim umeshubbachim, veaf al pi sheenam mishshivat hamminim, kegon parish veetrog vechayyotze vahen, vehu haddin sheyyecholin leatter mipperot sheggadlu bechutz laaretz:
Rabbi akiva omer en meatterin habbikkurim ella mishshivat hamminim. mipperot sheggadlu baaretz shechayyavim babbikkurim. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:
Hashshidra vehaggulgolet mishshene metim. chatzi chulyot hashshidra mimmet ze vachatzi chulyot hashshidra mimmet acher. vechen haggulgolet:
Veevar min hachay mishshene anashim. chatzi evar nitlash mechay ze vachatzi evar kaze nitlash mechay acher, venirin keevar echad:
Vachachamim metaharin. mittumat ohel. aval metammein bemagga uvemassa mishshum etzem kasseora. vahalacha kachachamim:
Kede sheyyitztzolu. kemaachal ben derosay, vehu shelish bishshul, uvechach hu rauy laachila, vetu lekka lemigzar shemma yechte begechalim:
Charara. ugat retzafim:
Sheyyikremu. techillat afiyya osin kemo kerum:
Paneha. shehem kelappe avir hattannur:
Kede sheyyikrom hattachton. hammudbak lecheres hattannur, dehu neefa techilla kodem sheyyikremu happanim shekkelappe avir hattannur, uvehachi saggi. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:

Yetziot hashshabbat. hotzaot shemmershut lirshut haamurot etzel shabbat, vehachenasot nammi ka kare yetziot hoil umotzi mershut lirshut. vehay detane yetziot velo tane hotzaot, lishana dikra nakat, dichtiv (Shemot 16) al yetze ish mimmekomo, uminneh darshinan hotzaa, al yetze ish im hakkeli shebbeyado lilkot hamman:

Shetayim shehen arba. shetayim min hattora, hotzaa vehachenasa levaal habbayit haomed bifnim birshut hayyachid, veal shetayim ellu chayyav al shiggato chattat, veal zedono karet, veal hateraato sekila, kemo bechol shear melachot shel shabbat:

Shehen arba. middivrehem hosifu shetayim, leesor lechattechilla hecha shehammelacha naaset al yede shenayim ze oker veze meniach, dishnayim sheasauha peturim, shenneemar (Vayikra 4) baasotah achat mikkol mitzvot Adonai, haose et kullah velo haose miktzatah, vechen bechol melachot shel shabbat amrinan yachid sheasaah chayyav, shenayim sheasauha peturim:
Ushetayim shehen arba bachutz. shetayim min hattora, hotzaa vehachenasa leani haomed bachutz birshut harabbim:
Shehen arba. middivrehem hosifu shetayim leesor lechattechilla, keshezze oker veze meniach:

Pashat heani et yado. uvetochah kuppa o hassal shemmekabbel bo kikkerot mibbaal habbayit. ulehachi nakat hotzaa bilshon ani veashir, deaggav orcheh ka mashma lan demitzva habbaa baavera asura vechayyavin aleha:
Venatan letoch yado shel baal habbayit. deaved leh akira mershut harabbim vehannacha birshut hayyachid:
O shennatal mittochah vehotzi. hachefetz, veheniach birshut harabbim, deaved akira vehannacha:

Heani chayyav. sheasa melacha shelema. vahare shetayim min hattora laomed bachutz. veaf al gav devainan akira mimmakom sheyyihye bo arbaa tefachim al arbaa tefachim vehannacha bemakom sheyyihye bo arbaa al arbaa velekka, deyad heani uvaal habbayit en bah makom sheyyihye arbaa al arbaa, amrinan baggemara deyado shel adam chashuva kearbaa al arbaa, kevan shehi asuya lehaniach bah velittol mimmenna chafatzim, vaafillu gedolim harebe:
Uvaal habbayit patur. patur umuttar gamur, deha lav mide avad:
Pashat baal habbayit kulei‏ baal habbayit chayyav. hare shetayim min hattora laomed bifnim:
Pashat heani kulei. deaved heani akira mershut harabbim:
Venatal baal habbayit mittochah. veheniach bifnim, veaved leh baal habbayit hannacha birshut hayyachid:
O shennatan letochah. deaved leh baal habbayit akira mershut hayyachid:
Vehotzi. heani veheniach birshut harabbim:

Shenehem peturim. shello asa shum echad mehem melacha shelema. aval asurim laasot ken, shemma yavou kol echad bifne atzmo laasot melacha shelema beshabbat. hare shetayim middivrehem, achat leani bachutz veachat levaal habbayit bifnim. veha delo chashev shenayim lechol echad, akira leani vaakira levaal habbayit, hannacha leani vehannacha levaal habbayit, mishshum delo chashev ella akirot shehen techillat hammelacha veikka lemechash shemma yigmerenna, aval hannachot shehen sof hammelacha lo kachashev:
Vehevi aleha seorim. shehen kallim mechittin:
Chayyav. bekilkulah im hosif shelosha kabbin. velo amrinan hoil vehasseorim kallin yesh lo lehosif ad kede koved letech chittin shehu massa hachamor:
Mippene shehannefach kashe. labbehema kemasseoy. af al pi sheen massao kaved kemassa hachittin, hare nifchan kenefach hachittin, vehannefach kemasseoy:
Letech. chatzi kor. vehakkor sheloshim sein:
Sumechos omer vechulei. vahalacha kesumechos. veim hosif pachot mishshiur ze, patur im huzak hachamor, venoten sechar hattosefet bilvad:
Veellu im chasru tehorim. delet bahen kashshiur:
Kazzayit min hammet. shekken hu techillat yetzirato shel adam, bechazzayit:
Ureviit dam. hoil uvitchillat beriyyato shel katan en bo pachot merviit dam:

Veevar min hachay shechasar atzmo. afillu kulit gedola shechasar mimmenna etzem kol shehu lo metamme mishshum evar min hachay. aval im chasar mibbesaro, leolam hu metamme ad sheyyechesar mikkede lehaalot arucha. veevar min hammet, kazzayit basar happoresh mimmennu, tame. veetzem kasseora happoresh mimmennu nammi tame:
Pissat haregel. kaf haregel hi happarsa:
Shishsha vechol etzba. lechamesh etzbaot, hayenu sheloshim:
Kursal. targum keraayim, karsulin. mekom chibbur haregel vehashshok:
Katlit. lemala berosh hayyarech:
Bakkane. etzem hamechubbar layyad. milleshon kene hammidda, shebbo moddim haamma:
Marpek. 116 belaaz:
Mea veechad mizze. shekkol ma shemmana ad achshav mitztzad echad mehagguf hu, kegon yad echad veregel echad vedofen achat:
Mafteach shel lev. hu hechaze. shemmippene tenuat hechaze menashshev harea al hallev, nimtza hechaze poteach derech shemmimmennu yikkanes haavir veyetze lallev:
Binkavav. habbetzim vegid haamma:
Basar karauy. kede sheyyaale arucha veyavri, im haya mechubbar beadam chay:

Veen metammein beohel. lefi shettumat ohel enah ella o veadam shalem kedichtiv (Bamidbar 19) adam ki yamut beohel, o beevar haddome leadam kedichtiv (sham) beetzem adam, ma adam yesh bo basar vegidim vaatzamot umetamme veohel, af evar sheyyesh bo basar vegidim vaatzamot metamme veohel:
Veellu. poalim:
Ochlim min hattora. bema sheoskin bo:
Gemar melacha. keshettolshin oto. dichtiv (Devarim 24) veel kelyecha lo titten, beshaa sheatta noten lechelav shel baal habbayit atta ochel, dehaynu keshettolshin oto:

Uvetalush min hakkarka. veim mitassek bedavar hattalush ochel beoto davar ad shello nigmera melachto lemaaser, im hu bar maaser. o ad shello nigmera melachto lechalla, im hu bar challa. deamar kera (sham 25) lo tachsom shor bedisho, vemiddelo kaamar lo tadush bachasima, shema minna leakkushe chosem lenechsam venechsam lechosem, ma nechsam shehu shor ochel battalush kesheose bo melacha, kach chosem shehu adam ochel battalush kesheose bo melacha, uma chosem vechulei‏. uma dayish meyuchad, davar shehu giddule karka velo nigmera melachto lemaaser uvishat gemar melacha poel ochel bo, af kol davar shehu giddule karka velo nigmera melachto lemaaser keshehu bishat gemar melacha poel ochel bo. yatza hacholev vehamechabbetz vehamegabben, sheenan giddule karka. veyatza hammavdil hattemarim vehaggerogarot hammechubbarim yachad, shennigmera melachtam lemaaser. veyatza hammenakkesh beshumim uvivtzalim, shemmesir hakketannim sheenan gedelim leolam mibben haacherim leharechiv makom laggedolim, sheen zo sheat gemar melacha. shekkol ellu vechayyotze bahen en poel ochel bahen:
Haevarim. tzarich sheyyihye bahem basar vegidim vaatzamot, uvechach hu necheshav evar. umayre ben beevar shennitlash min hachay ben beevar min hammet:
Lo yetze hachayyat bemachto. afillu techuva lo bevigdo, shemma yishkach veyetze, veumman derech ummanuto chayyav, shedderech haummanim letochavan bivgadav kesheyyotzim lashshuk:
Shemma yishkach veyetze. mishshettechshach:
Hallavlar. hassofer:
Bekulemoso. hattachuv achore aznav kederech hassofrim:
Velo yefalle et kelav. mevaer kinnim mibbegadav. targum biarti hakkodesh palleti:

Velo yikra leor hanner. besefer, shemma yatte hanner lehavi hashshemen lefi happetila kede sheyyidlok yafe, venimtza mavir beshabbat, vaafillu haya hanner gavoah shetayim veshalosh komot, leolam asur likrot leor hanner ella im ken yesh immo adam acher leshamro, o im hu adam chashuv sheeno ragil leolam letakken hanner:
Hachazzan. melammed tinokot:
Mehechan hattinokot korin. mehechan yatchilu likrot, diviyyun muat ki hay lo gazrinan shemma yatte. vehattinokot korin lifne rabban leor hanner, sheemat rabban alehem:
Aval hu lo yikra. kol happarasha, mippene sheen ematan alav, ushemiratan lo haveya shemira. umehay tama nammi ikka leman deamar deishsha shomeret levaalah en shemiratah shemira, sheen ematah alav:
Kayyotze vo. laasot harechaka min haavera, amru lo yochal hazzav im ishto zava, veaf al pi sheshshenehem temeim:

Mippene hergel avera. shemmittoch shehem mityachadim yavo livol zava shehi becharet. vezav vezava lirvuta nakat, shehattashmish kashe lahen veikka lememar devadday lo yavou lide hergel avera, afillu hachi lo yochlu ze im zo:
Ad sheyyaase veyadav veraglav. ma shor beyadav uveraglav, af poel beyadav uveraglav, deha ittakkash chosem lenechsam. veen halacha kerabbi yose berabbi yehuda:
Metamme veodem. dedam ketiv beishsha (Vayikra 15), veishsha ki tihye zava dam. vachamishsha mine damim temeim baishsha:
Veeno cholek. bizman shehannechasim merubbim habbanim dochim [oto] etzel hannekevot (veayyen tosfot yom tov bava batra perek 9 mishna 2):
Veeno ochel. hayenu chattaot vaashamot umenachot, divchullehu ketiv (Vayikra 6) kol zachar bivne aharon yochlenna:
Veimmo yoshevet alav bedam tame. shevuayim, keyoledet nekeva:

Veim nival baavera. shebba alav echad mikkerovav, o mippesule chehunna, sheim hayta nekeva hayta nifselet min hatteruma, af haanderoginos nifsal, af al pi shehazzachar shennival lo nifsal kidita bivchorot (perek 7 mishna 7). veyesh mefarshim, afillu nival mikkol adam nifsal mitteruma, mishshum deviato baavera, veyesh legamgem, dahave tarte desatre, im atta mechashshevo kezachar eno nifsal beviat avera afillu min hakkehunna, veim atta mechashshevo kinkeva enah nifselet ki im beviat happesulim o beviat echad mikkerovim shehi erva:
Kele lavan. shehu kashe lechabbes, tzarich shelosha yamim, umachmirin al atzman kevet shammay. veen halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel, ella kevet hillel shemmattirin im hashshemesh:
Veshavin. bet shammay uvet hillel, shettoanin et hazzetim mibbeod yom bekorat bet habbad, leachar shettachanu hazzetim toanin alehem korot kevedim vehammashke zav veholech meelav kol hashshabbat:

Veiggule haggat. hanach degat kare iggulin, shehayu dappin avin asuyin beiggul, uveha modu bet shammay levet hillel, mishshum dei nammi aved lehu beshabbat lekka chiyyuv chattat, deen notnin kora al gabbe zetim ad shettochanan techilla barechayim, vechen baanavim dorchim otan baregel techilla, uvelav kora nammi mashke nafek mimmela, ella delo nafek shappir ki hasheta, hilkach lo dami ledash:
Hilvahu. maot:
Al hammashkon shomer sachar. ben hilvahu veachar kach mishkeno, ben mishkeno veachar kach hilvahu. umay sachar, sechar mitzva:
Hilvahu maot shomer chinnam. delet leh lerabbi yehuda sechar mitzva leinyan dina:
Hilvahu perot shomer sachar. dederech perot leharekiv. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Muttar adam lehasekir. laacherim:
Mashkono shel ani. shebbeyado:
Lihyot posek alav. sachar:
Veholech. tamid ufochet min hachov. vedavka bemashkon denafish agreh vezutar pachteh, kegon mara vekardom vechayyotze bahen. vechen halacha:
Unin. aguddot shel pishtan menuppatz, venotnin otan battannur umitlabbenim:
Sheyyahbilu. sheyyitchammemu sheyyaale bahem hahevel:
Layyora. shel tzevaim:
Ella chede sheyyiklot et haayin. sheyyiklot hatztzeva mibbeod yom:

Uvet hillel mattirim. letittan letocho mibbeod yom utehe koletet kol hallayla. velo sharu bet hillel ella beyora akura min haesh, sheim yesh tachteha esh beshabbat asur, gezera shemma yechte baggechalim. vetzarich nammi shettehe hayyora setuma vetucha betit, gezera shemma yagis vihappech bah beshabbat, vechayyav mishshum mevashshel:
Shomre ferot. shomre gittot vaaremot uferot telushim. aval shomre ginnot ufardesim, en ochlim lo mehilchot medina velo min hattora, deshomer lav keose maase dame:
Mehilchot medina. shekkevar nahagu chen:
Nishba al hakkol. al kol hammeoraot hakketuvot bishar shomrim lechiyyuv, nishba shekkach alta lo ufatur:
Meshallem et hakkol. geneva vaaveda veonasim:

Nose sachar vechulei. vechullehu nafka lan mikkerae parashat veelle hammishpatim. parasha rishona ki yitten ish el reehu vegomer‏ neemra beshomer chinnam, shekken patar bo geneva vaaveda. sheniyya, ki yitten ish el reehu chamor o shor o se, neemra beshomer sachar, shekken chiyyev bo geneva vaaveda, dichtiv bah im ganov yigganev meimmo yeshallem livalav, en li ella geneva, aveda minnayin, talmud lomar im ganov yigganev, mikkol makom. veod, kal vachomer, uma geneva shekkerova leones chayyav, aveda shekkerova lifshia lo kol shekken. vesocher, kevan sheen kol hanaa shello dino keshomer sachar. vehashshoel, meforash befarasha shelishit vechi yishal ish meim reehu venishbar o met bealav en immo shallem yeshallem:
Venochel lechol hannachalot. im en sham yoresh ella hu, yoresh hakkol, delo tema beriyya bifne atzmo hu velav bar yerushsha hu, ka mashma lan (bava batra sham):

Hammocher shifchato veyalda. deeved kenaani nikna bechesef, ucheshennatan hammaot niknet lo hashshifcha bechol makom shehi. veen yadua im ad shello yalda natan hakkesef vehaubbar shello, o leachar sheyyalda vehavvalad shel bealim. aval para enah niknet bechasef ella bimshicha, vechevan demashach meda yada i yalda kevar i lo yalda, lehachi itzterich lemitne hammachalif, deal yede chalifin kevan shemmashach haechad nikna haacher bechol makom shehu, lefichach en yadua im yalda im lo yalda:
Yachaloku. umatnitin sumechos hi, velet hilchata kevateh:

Ze omer gadol veze omer katan. ze omer deme eved gadol veze omer deme eved katan. deillu eved mammash, ha kayma lan deen nishbain al haavadim. veod, ma shetteano lo hoda lo uma shehoda lo lo teano, velo haya kan makom lishvua:

Kazzayit min hammet pitcho vetefach. hammet bevayit velo petachim harebe, kol hakkelim hammunnachim bachalal happetachim tachat hammashkof shel petach mibbachutz, af al pi shehappetachim neulim veyesh hefsek ben ohel hammet leohel hakkelim, kullan temein. degazru chachamim tuma al hammakom shehu derech yetziat tuma shessofo shel met latzet derech sham, uchesheen yodim beeze makom yotziuhu, kullan temein. veim yesh kazzayit min hammet bevayit vechashav lehotzio bechallon sheyyesh bo poteach tefach, matztzil al kol happetachim hanneulim, kevan sheyyodea hammakom shessofah shel tuma latzet derech sham. veim hu met shalem vechashav lehotzi derech challon sheyyesh bo arbaa, matztzil al kol happetachim hanneulim, divshiur arbaa tefachim shiaru chachamim sherauy lehotzaat hammet:
Aval lehotzi et hattuma befoteach tefach. afillu met shalem tuma yotza derech challon kol zeman shehu patuach, umetamme hakkelim shebbabbayit shebbetziddo im yesh bachallon poteach tefach:
Gadol mikkazzayit kammet. davka kazzayit metzumtzam pitcho vetefach. aval yoter mikkazzayit dino keillu haya met shalem, veen matztzil al happetachim hanneulim ad sheyyehe bo arbaa:
Rabbi yose omer hashshidra vehaggulgolet. shebbabbayit, dino chemet shalem, veim chashav lehotzian derech challon, en matztzil al happetachim hanneulim ad sheyyehe vo arbaa. vechen halacha:
Melo tarvad rakav. daamaran leel beresh perek 2‏ shehu metamme veohel:
Shennitpazzer letoch habbayit. venitarev bo afar kol shehu:

Verabbi shimon metaher. desavar sofo kitchillato, ma techillato im nikbar hammet betachrichim o vearon shel etz, en lo rakav, devainan shello yihye davar niglal immo, af sofo leachar shennaasa rakav im nitarev immo davar acher eno metamme. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:

Im mitkabbeset hakkesut veyotze mimmenna reviit dam. vechetzad meshaarin otah, mevi mayim bemidda umechabbesah bahen, umevi mayim acherim kemiddatan venoten bahen reviit dam, im haya marehen shave hare zo temea, veim lav tehora:
Bamme madlikin. ner shel shabbat, bamme osin petilot ushemanim lehadelik:
Lo velechesh. kemin tzemer yesh baerez ben hakkelippa laetz vekaruy lechesh:
Bechosen. pishtan sheeno menuppatz:
Bechalach. pesolet shel meshi:
Biftilat haidan. kemin tzemer yesh [baarava] ben hakkelippa laetz:
Biftilat hammidbar. ale esev aroch sheggodlin otam umadlikin bahen:
Biroka sheal pene hammayim. kemin tzemer sheggadel bedafne hassefina sheshshahata zeman merubbe bammayim. ad kan pesul petilot, mikkan vaelach pesul shemanim:
Lo vezefet velo veshaava. shello yitten zefet names veshaava nittechet banner bimkom shemen veyadlik, aval laasot kemin petila arukka shergilin laasot mishshaava share:

Velo veshemen kik. shemen hayyotze miggarinim shebbetoch hatztzemer gefen shekkorin 171. veyesh mefarshim kikayon deyona, vehu esev shealav gedolim venikra baaravi 296, vehashshemen hayyotze mimmennu av beyoter. ufetilot sheamru chachamim en madlikin bahem, ma taam, mippene shehaur mesachsechet bahem, kelomar sheen haur nichneset toch happetila [ella] saviv mibbachutz. ushemanim sheamru chachamim en madlikin bahem, lefi sheen nimshachim achar happetila, umittoch sheen hanner doleket yafe chayshinan shemma yatte hashshemen al pi hanner venimtza mavir. i nammi shemma yanniach hanner veyetze, vaanan kayma lan dener shel shabbat chova:

Velo veshemen serefa. shemen shel teruma shennitma. veammay kare leh shemen serefa, hoil velisrefa omed, shehare asur baachila. uveyom tov shechal lihyot beerev shabbat askinan, shekkeshemmadlik hanner mibbeod yom nimtza soref shemen tame shel teruma beyom tov, vaanan kayma lan en sorfin kadashim beyom tov, dichtiv (Shemot 12) vehannotar mimmennu ad boker baesh tisrofu, vedarshinan kera hachi, vehannotar mimmennu ad boker rishon, ad boker sheni amod vetisrefennu, sheen sorfim hannotar beyom tov. vehu haddin lechol shear kadashim hatteunim serefa:

Vachachamim omrim echad mevushshal veechad sheeno mevushshal en madlikin bo. vetanna kamma nammi amar velo bechelev, kol chelev bemashma. ella ikka ben chachamim letanna kamma dechad minnayhu savar deshare lehadelik bechelev mevushshal keshemmeorav bo shemen kol shehu, vechad oser afillu al yede taarovet shemen. velo nitbarer lechachme hattalmud mi mishshenehem haoser umi hammattir. vahalacha kachachamim:
Tzelochit. keen tzelochiyyot shel zechuchit shellanu sheyyesh lahen tzavvar aroch:
Shennittal piha. shennittal tzavvarah:
Uvigdola. sheenah yechola linnatel beyado achat ella vishte yadav keruya gedola, vesheyyechola linnatel beyado achat keruya ketanna:
Shel palyaton. shel shemen afarsemon:
Tehora. detu lo chazya limlachtah:
Mippene shehi sorachat et hayyad. habba latet yado letochah lakachat min happalyaton lehariach bo, yado nisrechet venisretet venikraat, sorachat, kemo sorechet bechaf, leshon sircha:
Leginin gedolim. kemo chaddin gedolim:
Metakkenan lichvashim. shekkovshim bahen yarak bemelach uvechometz umannichin otan sham lehitkayyem:

Afarkes. keli asuy larechayim, sherachav millemala vekatzar millematta veshulav, venotnim bo chittin harebe befaam achat vehen yordim meat meat letoch harechayim venitchanim sham. vedugmato matzinu beresh chagiga (daf 3) ase aznecha kaafarkeset, shemmachnis harebe umotzi kima:
Ashrayich kelim. massechet kelim:
Shennichnast betuma veyatzat betohora. matchelet baavot hattumot umesayyemet haafarkes shel zechuchit tehora:
Ezehu dam tevusa. ammatnitin dilel deferek 2‏ [mishna 2] kae, dekatane reviit dam tevusa tame, vekamfaresh hacha ezehu dam tevusa:
Sheminit bechayyav usheminit bemoto. mitztarfim lirviit:
Reviit bechayyav ureviit bemoto. shennitarvu venatal min hattaarovet reviit, zehu dam tevusa. aval sheminit bechayyav usheminit bemoto, lo:
Ze vaze. derabbi akiva uderabbi yishmael:
Kammayim. veenan metammein:
Veezehu dam tevusa. shettame:
Tzaluv sheddamo shotet. veyored belo hefsek, mippene shettippa shel mita meorevet bo. aval notef, sheyyored tippa achar tippa, kamma kamma batel vetahor:
Rabbi yehuda omer lo chi. kelomar lo chen haddavar:
Ella hashshotet tahor. sheani omer otah tippa shehanneshama teluya vah amda lah al gabbe haetz shehu taluy bo, veen bedam ze otah tippa acharona shel mita:
Vehamenattef tame. velo amrinan kamma kamma batel, desavar rabbi yehuda en dam mevattel dam. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:
Shefoferet shel betza. hakkelippa hakkasha haelyona shehabbetza munnachat betochah:
Bishvil shettehe menattefet. tippa tippa letoch hanner, vetama gezera shemma yistappek mimmennu, vechevan shehiktzahu lener chayyav mishshum mechabbe:
Vaafillu hi shel cheres. demais, afillu hachi gazrinan, shekkevan sheen happetila haddoleket betoch hakkeli sheyyesh bo hashshemen, ate leistappuke minneh, desavar en kan mishshum mechabbe:
Verabbi yehuda mattir. delo gazar dilma ate leistappuke minneh, shehare hu roe hashshemen notef al happetila shettachtav:
Im chibberah hayyotzer mittechilla kulei. vehu haddin im chibberah baal habbayit besid o becharsit meerev shabbat lekka lemechash, demishshum issura deshabbat badel minneh:

Veyitten rosh happetila. shehu yotze min hatztzad lishov hashshemen venimshach derech happetila larosh haddolek. veashmeinan matnitin pelugta derabbi yehuda verabbanan bishfoferet shel betza, uvecheres, uvikara. dei ashmeinan shefoferet shel betza, beha kaamri rabbanan, dechevan delo meisa ate leistappuke minna, aval shel cheres demais ema modu leh lerabbi yehuda. vei ashmeinan shel cheres, beha kaamar rabbi yehuda, aval behahi ema mode lehu lerabbanan. vei ashmeinan hane tarte, beha kaamar rabbi yehuda, mippene shehashshefoferet shel betza vehacheres munnachim betoch chalal hanner lemala, velo mafsik mide ben hanner uvenam, velekka lemigzar shemma yistappek, devadel minneh, aval bikara demafseka, shehare etzel hanner munnachat veyesh kan hefsek velekka lememar gufeh hu, ema mode denigzor. vei ashmeinan behahi, behahi kaamri rabbanan, aval behanach tarte modu lerabbi yehuda, tzericha. vahalacha kachachamim:

Bahar veholichah babbika babbika veholichah bahar. berosh hahar. veaf al pi shehadderech chalak veyashar, chayyav keshemmeta mechamat avira shello huchleka velo huchamma, dehoil veshinna bah yachol lomar lo lo meta zo ella mechamat shello hayta lemuda baavir har vekashe lah, o lo hayta lemuda baavir bika vekashe lah. umishshum hachi lo mefalleg hacha ben huchleka lehuchamma kemo dimfalleg bassefa:
Im hechelika patur. shebbahar hi reuya lehachelik yoter, sherosh hahar chad umeshuppa litzdadin:
Veim huchamma chayyav. shehabbika maala hevel lefi sheheharim sevivah veen avir sholet bah, veim huchamma mechamat haalotah bahar, chayyav, shehammaala garma lah, vehu shinna leholichah bahar:
Vehivdika. nismet baddok shebbaayin. perush acher, hitliu ragleha:
O shennaaset angarya. shennilkecha laavodat hammelech:

Omer lo hare shellecha lefanecha. vedavka kesheamar lo chamor ze, usecharo lemasseoy. aval im secharo lirkov alav, afillu amar lo chamor ze, eno yachol lomar lo hare shellecha lefanecha, shemma tippol tachtav baggesher o tashlichennu beachat happechatim. vechen im hiskir lo chamor setam afillu lemasseoy, eno yachol lomar lo hare shellecha lefanecha, ella chayyav lehaamid lo behema acheret. veim eno maamid lo behema acheret, eno chayyav litten lo kelum mikkol sechar hadderech shehalach immo:
Meta o nishbera chayyav. hammaskir limkor haor vehannevela lakkelavim ulehosif maot ulehaamid lo chamor. o yiskor lo acher bidme hannevela, shehare chamor ze shibed lo. o yachazir lo secharo:

En sorfin teruma vechulei. im raa loven levad o odem levad, mishshum dahave safek, keditnan bemassechet zavim (perek 2 mishna 1). aval im raa loven veodem keachat, sorfin, shehu tame mimma nafshach. ayyen benidda (daf koach):
Veen chayyavin alav al biat mikdash. afillu raa loven veodem keachat, mishshum dichtiv (Bamidbar 5) mizzachar vead nekeva, zachar vadday unekeva vaddait:
Veeno nimkar beeved ivri vechulei. mishshum dahave safek nekeva, uchetiv (Shemot 22) venimkar bignevato, velo vignevatah (sota perek 3 mishna 8):
Velo channashim. sheav mocher et bitto hakketanna leamma, vehaanderoginos safek zachar, veen av mocher et beno leeved:
Veeno neerach. dezachar unekeva amurim befarashat arachim (Vayikra 27), sheyyehe zachar vadday o nekeva vaddait:
Aval tumtum vechulei. uvattosefta haggirsa, aval tumtum eno chen, ella o safek ish o safek ishsha:
Mippene ovde kochavim. kegon parsiyyim sheen mannichin lehadelik or beyom edam ella bevet avodat kochavim shellahem:
Mippene listim. shello yiru sheyyesh sham adam veyavou alav:

Mippene ruach raa. hashshora alav, uchesheeno roe noach lo. verambam peresh ruach raa, min mimmine hacholi habba levaale hammara hashshechora, shello yanuchu ella kesheyyeshvu bachoshech uvehastara mibbene adam:

Veim bishvil hachole sheyyishan patur. hay chole, chole sheyyesh bo sakkana hu, deillu mechabbe bishvil chole sheen bo sakkana chayyav lemay desavar hay tanna dimlacha sheenah tzericha legufah chayyav aleha. vechen mippene ovde kochavim, mippene listim, mippene ruach raa, kullehu it behu sakkana. uvedin hu delitne muttar, ella mishshum devae lemitne sefa chayyav, tana resha patur:

Kechas al happetila chayyav. veaf al gav deeno tzarich leguf hakkibbuy ella letzorech davar acher, shello tidlak happetila o shello yifka hanner, chayyav, dimlacha sheenah tzericha legufah chayyav aleha:

Poter bechullan chutz min happetila. sheen lecha kibbuy hatztzarich legufo, ella kibbuy shel pechamim, vechibbuy shel hivhuv petila, sheose hakkibbuy lehaachiz haur maher kesheyyirtze lehadeliko. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Shehu osah pecham. shehu mitkavven laasotah achshav bechibbuy ze pecham, shettehe mehuvehevet lehair yafe:
Haggolel. even gedola urechava shessotmim bah pi hakkever millemala. milleshon vegalalu et haeven (Bereshit 29):
Vehaddofek. shete avanim gedolot achat mitztzad ze veachat mitztzad ze shehaggolel nishan alehen:
Metammein bemagga uveohel. dichtiv (Bamidbar 19) veal hannogea baetzem o vechalal o vammet o vakkaver, ma met metamme vemagga uveohel, af kever metamme vemagga uveohel:
Veenan metammein bemassa. dedarshinan vechol asher yigga al pene hassade (sham), lerabbot golel vedofek, uchetiv vechol asher yigga, mishshum magga hu metamme veeno metamme mishshum massa:
Im yesh tachtehen afar kevarot. metamme keshemmesitan, mishshum afar hannissat immahen dimtamme bemassa mishshum tefusa shel met. vahalacha kerabbi yehoshua:
Dofek dofkin. etzel even haddofek mannichin lifamim even acheret lehachazikah veen haggolel nishan aleha, vehi nikret dofek dofkin:
Meshalshelin et happesach. hattannurim shellahen pihen lemala, umoridin hatztzeli letocho, lehachi tane meshalshelin:
Im chashecha. veaf al gav divalma en tzolin kidamran, hacha share, divne chavura zerizin hen umadkeri ahadade velo atu lechattoye baggechalim:
Umaachizin et haur. meat, baetzim shel medurat bet hammoked, velo chayshinan shemma yavou hakkohanim lehaveirah mishshettechshach, dechohanim zerizin hen:
Bet hammoked. lishka gedola hayta baazara shemmassikin bah medura tamid, vehakkohanim mitchammemim sham, lefi sheholchim yechefim al haritzpa shel shayish:
Uvaggevulin. tzarich haadam lehaveir medurato mibbeod yom, kede shetteechoz haur berubbah, vechamma berubbah, kede shettehe shalhevet ola meeleha veenah tzericha lekismin dakkin tachteha lehaveirah:

Af befechamin kol shehu. ki hechi devimdurat bet hammoked mekilinan, bevet hammoked lakkohanim, kemo chen bimdurat pechamim mekiyinan lechol adam, veeno tzarich lehaachiz bahen haur ella kol shehu, sheen darkah lihyot kava veholechet, velo atu lechattoye behu. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda, delekka man defaleg aleh:
Nakkesh immi. hayyom vaanakkesh immecha lemachar. nikkush hu akirat haasavim haraim haggedelim battevua:
Ador. chafor:
Lo yomar lo nakkesh immi veedor immach. peamim shezzo kasha mizzo, veyesh kan agar natar:
Kol yeme garid echad. velo chayshinan im yom echad gadol mechavero. vechen kol yeme revia echad. umuttar lomar ador immi yom ze shel garid, vaani eedor immecha yom acher shel garid. vechen barvia:
Garid. yemot hachamma:
Revia. yemot haggeshamim:
Vaani echerosh immecha barvia. sheyyeme revia kashim lammelacha shebbassadot:

Kelim hannogim bemet vechulei. ben kele mattachot ben kele shetef uvegadim mittammein kammet atzmo, dichtiv (sham) bachalal cherev o vemet, cherev hare hu kammet, vehu haddin lishar kol hakkelim. hilkach kelim hannogim bemet naasim avi avot, vechelim bechelim av hattuma, dilolam en hakkelim sheniyyim naasim karishonim:
Hashshelishi ben adam ben kelim. naasim rishonim umittammein tumat erev:
Hassocher et happara lacharosh vechulei. vechol kele hammachresha levaal happara, unearav holchim im behemto vechorshim bah:
Nishbar hakkankan. yated hammachresha shebbo habbarzel:
Chayyav. sheharim kashim lacharosh min habbika mippene hasselaim sheyyesh sham:
Vedash battevua. patur im hechelika:
Zeev echad eno ones. venose sachar vesocher chayyavin alav. dichtiv hatterefa lo yeshallem, yesh terefa shehu meshallem veyesh terefa sheeno meshallem:
Bishat mishlachat zeevim. keshechayya raa meshullachat kofetzet hi al adam echad. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda velo keyaddua habbavli:
Hallistim. chad listim hare ze ones:
Ad shettetze nafsho. dichtiv (Bamidbar 19) kol hannogea bemet benefesh haadam asher yamut. limmedcha hakkatuv sheeno metamme ad sheyyamut:
Meguyyad. mechuttach. leshon goddu ilana (Daniel 4):
Zokek layyibbum. kol zeman shehu goses yevimto asura lehinnase:
Ufoter min hayyibbum. im met vehinniach ben goses, ishto petura min hachalitza umin hayyibbum:
Umaachil batteruma. et immo, im hi bat yisrael shennisset lechohen:
Ufosel. et immo min hatteruma, im bat kohen leyisrael hi:
Vechen behema vechayya en metammein. tumat nevelot, ad shettetze nafsham:
Kiznav halletaa. kelomar lema pirkus ze dome, liznav halletaa:

Kol hammatne al ma shekkatuv battora tenao vatel. kullah matnitin rabbi meir hi desavar hammatne al ma shekkatuv battora afillu bedavar shebbemamon tenao batel. veenah halacha. ella bedavar shebbemamon afillu shehitna al ma shekkatuv battora, tenao kayyam:

Kol tenay sheyyesh bo maase mittechilla. shehikdim maase sheyyesh alav laasot litnay shehu mevakkesh mimmennu, kegon hare maase ze shellecha im taase davar peloni, delo dame litnay bene gad uvene reuven im yaavru unetattem hayenu tenay kodem lammaase:
Tenao vatel. vehave maase kayyam veaf al pi shello kiyyem baal hattenay et hattenay:
Vechol sheefshar lo lekayyemo vesofo. vehaya tenay kodem lammaase:
Tenao kayyam. aval i efshar lo lekayyemo, hattenay batel vehammaase kayyam, sheeno ella kemaflig bidvarim, sheen belibbo leshum tenay ella lehakenit bealma marchik vedoche et chavero bidvarim:

Ovrim mishshum lo titten vechulei. malve over bechullan. love over mishshum bal tashich, shehu leshon mafil laacherim, lo tigrom sheachicha yishshoch, veover al (Devarim 23) uleachicha lo tashich, velifne ivver lo titten michshol. arev veedim ovrim al lo tesimun alav neshech bilvad:

Veim enah baa min haaretz. kegon sheheviu hattosefet meever layyarden, ditnan leel shemmeviim mishsham bikkurim af al pi sheenah eretz zavat chalav udevash. i nammi matnitin rabbi shimon hi deamar leel meatterim et habbikkurim chutz mishshivat hamminim, vehu haddin mipperot sheggadlu bechutz laaretz, vechi hechi deallibbeh meatterim beferot chutz laaretz, hachi nammi hattosefet baa mipperot chutz laaretz. veka mashma lan hacha shehattosefet sheenah min haaretz enah kabbikkurim:
Habbikkurim. ikkar habbikkurim, teena shebbikkera o eshkol shebbikker:
Tosefet habbikkurim. bishat lekitat habbikkurim mosif alehem mishshear teenim o mishshear anavim:
Ittur. happerot hannaim shemmakkif sevivot hassal lehiddur mitzva:
Min besheeno mino. meatter hassal shel bikkure anavim bitenim, veshel bikkure teenim baanavim, vaafillu beferot sheenam mishshivat hamminim ledivre rabbi shimon disvira leh kach leel:
Ufeturim min haddemay. im lekachan hakkohen meam haaretz shehevi bikkurim:
